works.caption: Gérôme stages the Circus Maximus at full gallop, chariots blurred with dust while the crowded stands and Egyptian obelisk anchor the vast architectural sweep.
works.title: Chariot Race

works.caption: Heade's waxy white blossoms glow against near-black velvet, every petal and vein rendered with hallucinatory precision.
works.title: Magnolias on Light Blue Velvet Cloth

works.caption: Mondrian tilts his grid onto a diamond, the primary-color blocks balanced against a field of white with quiet, exacting tension.
works.title: Lozenge Composition with Yellow, Black, Blue, Red, and Gray

works.caption: A young painter turns to meet the viewer's gaze, his loaded palette catching the only bright color in an otherwise somber, deeply shadowed composition.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Two mounted warriors clash in a swirl of dust and drapery, their rearing horses and flashing blades charged with Romantic violence and movement.
works.title: The Combat of the Giaour and Hassan

works.caption: A young aristocrat poses with cool self-possession against emerald drapery, the crisp linear precision of his features and sword hilt set off by lush, painterly greens.
works.title: Amédée-David, the Comte de Pastoret

works.caption: Tilted perspectives and a rumpled white cloth hold a basket of apples in restless tension, Cezanne's faceted brushwork turning still life into architecture.
works.title: The Basket of Apples

works.caption: A mother tips her daughter's feet into a basin, the intimacy of the gesture set against Cassatt's flattened, Japanese-inflected patterning of stripes and florals.
works.title: The Child's Bath

works.artist: Francisco José de Goya y Lucientes
works.artistSort: Lucientes, Francisco José de Goya y
works.caption: A wide-eyed child in ruffled finery rides a bell-collared ram, Goya balancing courtly costume against a loose, atmospheric landscape.
works.title: Boy on a Ram

works.caption: Cockscombs and maize stalks rise in sparse, asymmetric rhythm across a shimmering gold-leaf ground, the six-panel screen's emptiness as eloquent as its plant forms.
works.medium: Six-panel screen; ink, color, and gold on paper
works.title: Maize and Cockscombs

works.caption: A woman glimpsed from behind at her dressing table dissolves into feathery, near-abstract strokes of silvery white and blue, intimacy rendered as pure brushwork.
works.title: Woman at Her Toilette

works.caption: Long strips of poem paper dangle like calligraphic rain from a gnarled maple's autumn canopy, the gold-ground screen glowing behind scattered red leaves.
works.medium: Six-panel screen (one of pair); Ink, colors, gold leaf, and gold powder on silk
works.title: Autumn Maples with Poem Slips

works.caption: A milliner's model turns a straw hat in gloved hands, the shop's confectionery pinks and creams built from loose, buttery strokes around her sober olive dress.
works.title: The Millinery Shop

works.caption: A woman absorbed in a magazine sits before dappled greenery, her black hat and coat cut in broad, confident strokes against the sketchy garden behind her.
works.title: Woman Reading

works.caption: Fishing boats beached on shingle anchor a wide grey-and-turquoise seascape, the clouded sky given as much weight as the water below it.
works.title: The Beach at Sainte-Adresse

works.caption: A woman and child pause under a red parasol atop a wildflower-choked chalk cliff, sailboats scattered across the glittering channel beyond.
works.title: Cliff Walk at Pourville

works.caption: Two sisters pose on a riverside terrace, the elder's vivid red hat and the basket of yarn and oranges anchoring a shimmering screen of foliage behind them.
works.title: Two Sisters (On the Terrace)

works.caption: The armored saint lances the dragon's throat as his white charger rears, gold tooling catching the light across a jewel-bright chivalric landscape.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: A circus performer balances on a cantering white horse under the ringmaster's whip, sketchy pastel and charcoal strokes capturing the blur of motion under gaslight.
works.title: Equestrienne (At the Cirque Fernando)

works.caption: A young man's clasped, ringed hands anchor a spare portrait set against deep blue, his gaze angled off in the taut, glassy realism of the Burgundian court style.
works.title: Portrait of Jean Gros (recto); Coat of Arms of Jean Gros (verso)

works.caption: Gabriel kneels before Mary in a jewel-toned interior, his sweeping green robe and raised gold scepter balanced against her folded red mantle and open psalter.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Terracotta rooftops and a factory's plume of smoke give way to a broad band of cobalt bay and hazy mountains, built from Cezanne's characteristic parallel strokes.
works.title: The Bay of Marseille, Seen from L'Estaque

works.caption: Soldiers jeer at a seated, thorn-crowned Christ against near-total blackness, the composition's flattened, almost collaged figures scandalizing Manet's own contemporaries.
works.title: Jesus Mocked by the Soldiers

works.caption: Lily pads drift across a mirrored pond where sky, cloud, and willow reflection dissolve into a single continuous field of violet and green.
works.title: Water Lilies

works.caption: Steam and smoke billow beneath the iron-and-glass train shed as a locomotive idles at the platform, the whole scene rendered in a haze of blue-grey vapor.
works.title: Arrival of the Normandy Train, Gare Saint-Lazare

works.caption: Umbrella-bearing Parisians cross a rain-slicked intersection of wedge-shaped buildings, the wet cobblestones and converging perspective giving the canvas an almost photographic clarity.
works.title: Paris Street; Rainy Day

works.caption: Christ buckles beneath the weight of the cross as two men crowd close behind him, a hazy landscape and distant crowd glimpsed through a window at right.
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: The Virgin smiles down at two infants nestled in her lap and at her knee, a trellised orchard and hazy blue hills opening behind her in classic High Renaissance balance.
works.title: Virgin and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Two fishermen haul a herring-laden net over the gunwale of a pitching dory, the heaving grey-green swell and lowering sky conveying real physical danger.
works.title: The Herring Net

works.caption: Christ stretches in his carpenter's workshop at day's end, his shadow falling across the tool rack as a cross, the painting's obsessive Pre-Raphaelite detail turning a genre scene into prophecy.
works.title: The Shadow of Death

works.caption: The Holy Family gathers around the swaddled Christ child, Joseph and an elderly Elizabeth leaning in from either side in warm, deeply modeled Baroque flesh tones.
works.title: The Holy Family with Saints Elizabeth and John the Baptist

works.caption: Bathers recline on a saturated pink shore before a towering green idol, Gauguin flattening the Tahitian beach into bold, unmodulated fields of color.
works.title: Mahana no atua (Day of the God)

works.caption: A woman rests her head on crossed arms beside a goldfish bowl, the decorative wrought-iron pattern behind her locking the whole canvas into a taut, patterned grid.
works.title: Woman before an Aquarium

works.caption: Two elongated, mask-like faces float above swaths of near-abstract color — Lipchitz's tall grey collar and Berthe's white lace framing the picture's warmest passage.
works.title: Jacques and Berthe Lipchitz

works.caption: Tilted perspective and clashing complementary blues and ochres turn a simple bedroom into a vibrating field of color, the red coverlet the single hot note.
works.title: The Bedroom

works.caption: Eakins' unflinching realism picks out every crease of a weathered face against near-total darkness, the white collar the sole bright anchor.
works.title: Portrait of Mary Adeline Williams

works.caption: A Renaissance nobleman in sumptuous black velvet stands full-length beside his spaniel, the checkerboard floor and crisp white collar sharpening an otherwise somber palette.
works.title: Gian Lodovico Madruzzo

works.caption: A sacrificial procession winds beneath a cliffside temple bathed in golden late light, Claude's atmospheric perspective dissolving the distant hills into hazy blue.
works.title: View of Delphi with a Procession

works.caption: Vivid blue and red hoop skirts pop against a dark screen of trees as a foursome pauses mid-game, Homer's crisp figure drawing carrying the whole composition.
works.title: Croquet Scene

works.caption: Constable's turbulent, scumbled sky dwarfs a village church tower, the working farm cart and grazing cattle below rendered in thick, flickering paint.
works.title: Stoke-by-Nayland

works.caption: A billowing sail cuts through churning surf as storm clouds break to blue, Turner dissolving boats and figures into pure light and atmosphere.
works.title: Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish

works.caption: A hazy gold moon hovers over a nearly monochrome blue-grey harbor, Whistler reducing boats and shoreline to whispered silhouettes in a meditation on tonal harmony.
works.title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold—Southampton Water

works.caption: Poussin's meticulous classical order arranges tumbled masonry, distant temples, and rolling hills around a lone reading saint, every plane balanced with architectural calm.
works.title: Landscape with Saint John on Patmos

works.caption: Caravaggesque light rakes across pinned-down Cupid, his bow and wings scattered, while two allegorical figures pin him with theatrical violence against near-total darkness.
works.title: Cupid Chastised

works.caption: A brick castle tower crumbles beside still water under a brooding, cloud-massed sky, Ruisdael's dramatic tonal contrasts giving ordinary ruins real weight.
works.title: Landscape with the Ruins of the Castle of Egmond

works.caption: Ghoulish green-lit faces crowd a cropped Parisian nightclub table, Toulouse-Lautrec's acid palette and off-kilter framing capturing modern nightlife's uneasy glamour.
works.title: At the Moulin Rouge

works.caption: Cezanne builds his wife's form from flat planes of maroon and ochre against cool grey-blue, the yellow chair's pattern the only decorative flourish in an otherwise architectural portrait.
works.title: Madame Cezanne in a Yellow Chair

works.caption: Two wheat stacks glow pink and mauve against a lavender hillside, Monet capturing a fleeting moment of late-day light in loose, vibrating touches of color.
works.title: Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)

works.caption: Bold black-outlined shapes in red, orange, and blue collide in dynamic near-abstraction, Hartley's thick impasto and heraldic symbols pulsing with kinetic energy.
works.title: Movement

works.caption: Sargent's loose, sun-dappled brushwork turns the marble fountain and the painter's white-clad companions into a shimmering study of light and shadow.
works.title: The Fountain, Villa Torlonia, Frascati, Italy

works.caption: Church stages a snow-capped volcano behind a plunging waterfall, the tropical foreground foliage and tiny figures giving scale to an operatic South American panorama.
works.title: View of Cotopaxi

works.caption: Zurbarán isolates the crucified Christ in near-total darkness, the raking light carving the anatomy into sculptural relief against an almost black void.
works.title: The Crucifixion

works.caption: Botticelli's tender embrace between mother and child is set against a fine landscape glimpsed through an arched window, with linear grace typical of his mature style.
works.title: Virgin and Child with an Angel

works.caption: Van Gogh's pointillist-inflected brushstrokes vibrate across the coat and background while his steady, appraising gaze anchors the composition.
works.medium: Oil on artist's board, mounted on cradled panel
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Delacroix whips riders, rearing horses, and snarling lions into a single writhing mass of struggle beneath a churning, storm-lit sky.
works.title: Lion Hunt

works.caption: Manet blurs the racehorses into onrushing streaks of paint, flattening the crowd along the rail into a dark frieze that heightens the sense of speed.
works.title: The Races at Longchamp

works.caption: A solitary woman under a tree gazes across the Seine, its still surface doubling the riverside village in soft, mirrored color.
works.title: On the Bank of the Seine, Bennecourt

works.caption: Game birds hang like pendulums beside a cut melon and cabbage in a dark stone niche, Sánchez Cotán's austere geometry and raking light making the mundane feel sacred.
works.title: Still Life with Game Fowl

works.caption: A red-roofed watermill spills white foam beneath towering, wind-tossed trees, Hobbema's billowing Dutch clouds giving the whole scene an expansive, breathing scale.
works.title: The Watermill with the Great Red Roof

works.caption: A potted geranium's loose green fronds spill over a cluttered tabletop of statuettes and pitchers, Matisse's Fauvist blues and pinks flattening the whole still life into pattern.
works.title: Still Life with Geranium

works.caption: The Virgin ascends in swirling blue and crimson robes above astonished apostles, El Greco's electric color and elongated, flame-like figures charging the whole canvas with visionary energy.
works.title: The Assumption of the Virgin

works.caption: Two disciples' faces catch a warm inner glow against near-black shadow, Tanner's spiritual chiaroscuro turning a gospel scene into an intimate study of quiet urgency.
works.title: The Two Disciples at the Tomb

works.caption: Cascading planes of blue, red, and gold dissolve cannons and riders into pure rhythm and color, Kandinsky pushing figuration to the very edge of abstraction.
works.title: Improvisation No. 30 (Cannons)

works.caption: Autumn foliage frames a distant Niagara Falls beneath brooding storm clouds cracked open by golden light, Cole staging the sublime scale of the American wilderness.
works.title: Distant View of Niagara Falls

works.caption: A plumed velvet cap, steel gorget, and heavy gold chain glint from deep shadow, Rembrandt's warm chiaroscuro dignifying an aged, weathered face with theatrical costume.
works.title: Old Man with a Gold Chain

works.caption: Cavalry horsemen wheel through a sun-baked canyon under gunfire, Remington's crisp desert light and taut, muscular horses charging the scene with narrative tension.
works.title: The Advance-Guard, or The Military Sacrifice (The Ambush)

works.caption: A peacock-blue silk gown pools across the floor as she rests against an ornate chair, Chase's virtuoso brushwork matching the dress against gilded, patterned wallpaper and a porcelain vase.
works.title: Portrait of Dora Wheeler

works.caption: A skeletal jockey whips a phantom horse around a darkened track, the thick, moon-lit clouds pressing down like a held breath. Ryder's tar-heavy paint and eerie stillness make this one of American art's great visions of mortality.
works.title: The Race Track (Death on a Pale Horse)

works.caption: Abraham grips Isaac's hair as an angel swoops in to stay the blade, the boy's twisting nude body a display of virtuoso Mannerist figure drawing. Acid greens and a blazing red mantle heighten the tension of the moment.
works.medium: Hanging scroll painting; ink, color, gold, and silver on silk
works.title: Medicine Master Buddha and the Twelve Divine Generals

works.caption: Flames engulf the Houses of Parliament across the Thames, their molten orange smeared into a churning sky and doubled in the water below. Turner turns catastrophe into pure incandescent spectacle.
works.title: The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons, 16 October 1834

works.caption: A richly dressed gentleman leans on a balustrade and gestures out past the frame, gold chain and dagger hilt catching the light against a stormy blue sky. The turned pose and searching gaze give the portrait real psychological electricity.
works.title: Portrait of a Man, Possibly Girolamo Rosati

works.caption: An old man clasps his hands in anguish beside a lantern and a watchful rooster, his weathered face the only bright note in an engulfing darkness. La Tour's candlelit realism turns a simple genre scene into raw emotional theater.
works.title: Saint Peter Repentant

works.caption: Faceted strokes of blue and orange build Mont Sainte-Victoire out of pure structure, pine boughs framing the peak like a proscenium. Cézanne's patchwork of color planes turns landscape into architecture.
works.title: Mount Sainte-Victoire

works.caption: A single white morning glory fills the entire canvas, its ribbed petals flaring out from a pale green throat against a sliver of shadowed leaf. O'Keeffe's radical close-up scale makes the flower monumental.
works.title: Morning Glory with Black

works.caption: Courtiers on horseback and in a boat spear stags driven into a river, a fairy-tale castle floating on the horizon above the melee. Cranach packs dozens of tiny, vivid figures into a dense forest panorama without losing clarity.
works.medium: oil, originally on wood, transferred to masonite
works.title: Hunting near Hartenfels Castle

works.caption: A scaly dragon writhes out of a swirling ink mist on one screen while a crouched, spotted tiger eyes a bamboo grove on the other. Bold tonal washes and sudden bursts of fine linework give both beasts real menace.
works.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink on paper
works.region: Japan, Muromachi period (1392–1573) to Momoyama period (1573–1615)
works.title: Dragon and Tiger

works.caption: Lily pads drift across a mauve and green sheet of water that dissolves any horizon, reflection and surface fusing into pure atmosphere. Monet's late, near-abstract handling makes the pond feel boundless.
works.title: Water Lilies (Agapanthus)

works.caption: A young woman in a diaphanous white gown pauses on a garden terrace beside a live peacock, a single rose held out toward the viewer. Silvery, feathery brushwork unites her gauzy dress with the bird's shimmering tail.
works.title: Portrait of Catherine Grey, Lady Manners

works.caption: Florence spreads below a hilltop terrace, Brunelleschi's dome and the Palazzo Vecchio's tower rising through golden evening haze. Cole balances grand panoramic sweep with small, intimate figures resting in the foreground shade.
works.title: View of Florence

works.caption: A smirking, winged Cupid leans back against a sleeping Psyche on a richly carved daybed, crimson drapery pooling around them. David's cool, sculptural precision gives the embrace an oddly knowing, unsentimental edge.
works.title: Cupid and Psyche

works.caption: A gnarled, hollow-trunked tree arches over a winding blue stream and drifts of white chrysanthemums, all set against a flat gold ground. The tree's dark, twisting silhouette gives structure to an otherwise pure decorative surface.
works.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink and color on gilded paper
works.title: Paulownias and Chrysanthemums

works.caption: Two kneeling nuns receive a ragged pilgrim at a cloister door while a radiant vision of saints bursts open in gold above them. Sassetta's fine linear precision and glowing punched-gold halo make the miracle feel weightless.
works.title: St. Catherine of Siena and the Beggar

works.caption: A green-skinned Tara sits enthroned within a jewel-red shrine niche flanked by rearing deer and elephants, foliage crowding the dark ground above. Dense, jewel-toned ornament frames a figure of serene, weightless calm.
works.medium: thangka; gum tempera, ink, and gold on sized cotton; mount: silk
works.title: Green Tara

works.caption: The infant Christ reaches up to touch his mother's face while the young Baptist looks on in quiet wonder, all set within a perfect tondo. Botticelli's flowing linear rhythm turns drapery into pure melody around the figures.
works.title: Virgin and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Danaë arches back on white and gold sheets, catching Jupiter's shower of gold coins as a startled cupid recoils. Dramatic chiaroscuro and the luminous flesh against near-black drapery give the myth real erotic charge.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: In a curtained bedchamber a new mother receives visitors while an old man by the fire writes at a lectern, the infant swaddled in white at the room's center. Meticulous rendering of green velvet, brass, and tile floor grounds the sacred scene in convincing domestic space.
works.title: The Birth and Naming of John the Baptist

works.caption: A steep, angular view down a city alley reduces rooftops and walls to flat planes of salmon, cream, and deep shadow. Precisionist clarity turns ordinary architecture into a taut geometric composition.
works.title: Church Street El

works.caption: The Holy Family gathers on a classical stone platform, children reaching toward each other beneath a portico and a brilliant blue sky with billowing clouds. Poussin's cool, architectural clarity gives the tender gestures a monumental, timeless calm.
works.title: The Holy Family on the Steps

works.caption: Two oarsmen strain against their blades in a slender racing scull, a blue pennant snapping overhead against a hazy river lined with spectators. Eakins' crisp, sunlit precision captures the exact mechanics of the stroke.
works.title: The Biglin Brothers Turning the Stake

works.caption: A courtesan in a sweeping, densely patterned kimono glances back beside a folding screen painted with a moonlit cloud and pines. The tumbling red-lined hem and layered textile designs turn the whole figure into a cascade of pattern.
works.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, gold, and silver on silk
works.title: Hell Courtesan

works.caption: A fiddler plays for two seated white men in a barn doorway while a Black laborer leans outside, jug and axe at his feet, listening intently. Mount's warm light and careful social staging give a simple scene layered, unresolved tension.
works.title: The Power of Music

works.caption: Christ hangs against gold, his ribcage and elongated torso lined in fine dark strokes, tiny narrative scenes from the Passion crowding the arms of the cross-shaped panel. Byzantine-derived linear stylization gives the figure a haunting, otherworldly stillness.
works.title: Crucifix with Scenes of the Passion

works.caption: A gentleman in severe black poses with a crisp millstone ruff and a single embroidered cuff, one glove held loosely in hand. The confident, almost sly half-smile animates an otherwise sober, formal Dutch likeness.
works.title: Portrait of Tieleman Roosterman

works.caption: The Virgin presses her cheek to the Christ Child's, his small hand raised in blessing, against a worn field of gold leaf. The tender, close embrace softens the icon's otherwise severe, elongated linear style.
works.region: Republic of Venice, Kingdom of Candia, Candia (Heraklion, Crete, Greece) or Byzantine Empire, Constantinople (Istanbul, Turkey)
works.title: Icon of the Mother of God and Infant Christ (Virgin Eleousa)

works.caption: A mother cradles a drowsy toddler while an older boy sprawls asleep across her lap, a distant domed church glowing through the trees behind them. Bouguereau's polished academic finish gives the tired, sun-warmed group an almost sculptural calm.
works.title: Rest

works.caption: A trapper, his son, and a chained black cat glide across glassy water under a hazy dawn sky, their still reflections doubling the canoe's quiet geometry.
works.title: Fur Traders Descending the Missouri

works.caption: A storm-blackened wilderness on the left gives way across the great bend of the river to a sunlit, cultivated valley on the right — Cole's before-and-after of the American land in a single sweeping view.
works.title: View from Mount Holyoke, Northampton, Massachusetts, after a Thunderstorm—The Oxbow

works.caption: A colossal stone goblet brimming with its own lake and tiny sailboats erupts from an Italianate landscape — Cole's strangest, most surreal invention.
works.title: The Titan's Goblet

works.caption: A boy on a stone plinth dangles a gold chain before his pet squirrel, Copley's razor-sharp rendering of pink silk and pale skin set against a deep, columned shadow.
works.title: Daniel Crommelin Verplanck

works.caption: Three men huddle over a chessboard in a cluttered, lamplit parlor, Eakins carving each absorbed face out of a rich, almost Rembrandt-dark interior.
works.title: The Chess Players

works.caption: A breaking wave curls white against slate-green swells while black rock shoulders into the foreground — Homer distilling the Maine coast to water, stone, and weather.
works.title: Cannon Rock

works.caption: A lone reaper swings his scythe through a golden wheat field, the discarded jacket and cropped military cadence quietly recasting the Grim Reaper as a Civil War elegy.
works.title: The Veteran in a New Field

works.caption: A pale profile and plunging black gown scandalized Paris — Sargent's razor-precise silhouette against a bare brown ground remains one of portraiture's boldest exercises in restraint.
works.title: Madame X (Virginie Amélie Avegno Gautreau)

works.caption: The unfinished Athenaeum-type Washington emerges from a dark ground with just enough modeling to fix the face that became the template for a nation's currency.
works.title: George Washington

works.caption: A woman plucks a kithara while a child peers over a chair back, painted life-size against a saturated red ground — one of the great surviving portraits of daily life from before Vesuvius.
works.title: Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale

works.caption: Concentric squares and circles of blazing red, orange, and teal spiral toward a tiny central deity, the mandala's cosmic architecture as hypnotic as any abstract composition.
works.title: Mandala of Jnanadakini

works.caption: A monumental Maitreya, heavy with pearl and turquoise jewelry, fills the cloth almost edge to edge, ranked bodhisattvas and teachers reduced to a small frame around his bulk.
works.title: The Bodhisattva Maitreya, Buddha of the Future

works.caption: A dark green-bodied Amoghasiddhi sits enthroned in a striped nimbus of red and gold, flanked by symmetrical rows of bodhisattvas painted in the archaic Pala-derived style.
works.title: Buddha Amoghasiddhi with Eight Bodhisattvas

works.caption: A Chakrasamvara mandala unfolds in concentric rings of architecture and charnel-ground figures around a tiny embracing deity pair at the center, a rare and complete example from around 1100.
works.title: Chakrasamvara Mandala

works.caption: Guo Xi's ink handscroll dissolves rocks, gnarled trees, and a distant pavilion into atmospheric mist, a founding statement of the Northern Song monumental landscape tradition.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: Old Trees, Level Distance

works.caption: A jagged crystalline mountain range dissolves into misty river flats, the brushwork shifting from crisp angular peaks to soft washed distance.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: Summer Mountains

works.caption: Two finches perch among ink bamboo on a handscroll traditionally linked to Emperor Huizong, the birds and leaves rendered with the meticulous, courtly precision of Song academy painting.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: Finches and bamboo

works.caption: The calligrapher Wang Xizhi leans from a garden pavilion to watch geese on the water, Qian Xuan's fine blue-and-gold linework evoking an archaic, jewel-toned elegance.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink, color, and gold on paper
works.title: Wang Xizhi watching geese

works.caption: Saint John writes his gospel beneath a hovering vision of the Virgin on a crescent moon, Baldung's saturated red robe and crisp Danube-school landscape giving the scene startling clarity.
works.medium: Oil, gold, and white metal on spruce
works.title: Saint John on Patmos

works.caption: Joan of Arc stares transfixed into the garden air as ghostly saints materialize among the trees behind her, Bastien-Lepage suspending her mid-gesture between peasant reality and vision.
works.title: Joan of Arc

works.caption: The Magi kneel before the Virgin in a crumbling stone stable, Bosch packing the wings and background with the hallucinatory, minutely observed detail that makes this an essential Northern Renaissance altarpiece.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A dying, emaciated Saint Jerome receives his final communion, Botticelli's angular draperies and taut linear rhythm giving the deathbed scene an austere, almost Gothic intensity.
works.title: The Last Communion of Saint Jerome

works.caption: A knight and an angel flank a maiden playing a chamber organ amid tulips, Burne-Jones dissolving Arthurian romance into a hushed, jewel-toned reverie.
works.title: The Love Song

works.caption: Canaletto lays out the full sweep of Piazza San Marco in crisp perspective, the campanile and basilica anchoring a bustling crowd rendered in confident, sunlit detail.
works.title: Piazza San Marco

works.caption: Four youths tune lutes and violins amid grapes and sheet music, Caravaggio's early masterpiece fusing tender adolescent flesh with the meticulous still-life passages of his Roman years.
works.title: The Musicians

works.caption: Two hermit saints flank a standing, wounded Christ amid classical ruins and a wide Umbrian landscape, Carpaccio balancing devotional intensity with luminous topographical detail.
works.title: The Meditation on the Passion

works.caption: Four Provençal peasants huddle over cards in near silence, Cézanne reducing the tavern scene to blocky, architectural stillness that anchors modern painting.
works.title: The Card Players

works.caption: Cézanne's wife sits rigid in a red dress against a mismatched blue wall, her face built from flat, deliberate planes that hold the whole restless composition together.
works.title: Madame Cézanne (Hortense Fiquet, 1850–1922) in a Red Dress

works.caption: Apples tumble across a rumpled white cloth beneath a potted primrose, Cézanne's tilted table and shifting color planes turning a simple still life into a study of pure structure.
works.title: Still Life with Apples and a Pot of Primroses

works.caption: A boy leans over a wall to blow a giant soap bubble, a smaller child peeking up in wonder, Chardin freezing the fragile globe at its most luminous instant.
works.title: Soap Bubbles

works.caption: A reclining nude raises a parrot on her hand, her tumbling hair and rumpled sheets given the same sensuous, tactile weight as her body, Courbet at his most frankly physical.
works.title: Woman with a Parrot

works.caption: Cranach stages the three goddesses as slender, jewel-necklaced nudes before a fantastical rocky landscape, the drowsy knight below and Cupid asleep in the clouds giving the scene its droll, courtly wit.
works.title: The Judgment of Paris

works.caption: Crivelli's crystalline devotion to surface — the beaded halo, brocade sleeve, and trompe-l'oeil fly and crack on the ledge — makes this Madonna a jeweler's exercise in illusion as much as piety.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: Daumier dissolves a crowded third-class carriage into somber ochres and umbers, isolating a nursing mother, a basket-clutching grandmother, and a sleeping boy in a silence that feels monumental despite the sketch-like handling.
works.title: The Third-Class Carriage

works.caption: Gerard David frames the Virgin and Child in an arched niche with music-making angels, the crowning gesture overhead and glimpsed walled garden giving the composition a serene architectural order.
works.title: Virgin and Child with Four Angels

works.caption: David marshals Neoclassical rigor into high drama, Socrates reaching for the hemlock while pointing skyward, his composed body a study in stoic geometry against the grief of the disciples around him.
works.title: The Death of Socrates

works.caption: Degas fractures the dance studio with mirror reflections and a violinist's angular bowing arm, the tulle skirts dissolving into powdery brushwork that anticipates his pastel dancers.
works.title: The Dancing Class

works.caption: Ducreux paints herself mid-performance at the harp, striped silk gown catching the light as she turns to meet the viewer with an easy, confident smile.
works.title: Self-Portrait with a Harp

works.caption: Dürer packs three generations into a tight pyramid against flat green, Saint Anne's searching direct gaze and the sleeping Christ Child's tumbled pose giving the devotional group real psychological warmth.
works.title: Virgin and Child with Saint Anne

works.caption: Van Dyck poses the collector Lucas van Uffel beside a classical bust and a globe, the sitter's twisting glance and rumpled sleeve giving Baroque swagger to an image of connoisseurship.
works.title: Lucas van Uffel (died 1637)

works.caption: The young Van Dyck paints himself with tousled hair and an appraising sidelong glance, one hand at his chest, the black cloak's fluid sheen already showing his mastery of Baroque bravura.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Fuseli conjures a ghastly night-hag looming over a corpse-pale infant, a spectral witches' ride glimpsed in the murk behind her, the whole scene lit like a fever dream.
works.title: The Night-Hag Visiting Lapland Witches

works.caption: Gauguin flattens a Tahitian veranda into bold planes of pink, yellow-green, and orange, the women's languid poses and patterned cloth turning an afternoon rest into a decorative, dreamlike frieze.
works.title: The Siesta

works.caption: Gentileschi stages Esther's fainting collapse before Ahasuerus with theatrical chiaroscuro, the queen's swooning gold silk pooling against the king's startled, leaning-forward alarm.
works.title: Esther before Ahasuerus

works.caption: Ghirlandaio sets the weathered banker in profile against a luminous panoramic landscape, his grandson's upward gaze of trust threading tenderness through an otherwise stately double portrait.
works.title: Francesco Sassetti (1421–1490) and His Son Teodoro

works.caption: Giotto builds the Nativity and Adoration into one gold-ground scene, the sleeping Virgin's weighty blue mantle and the kings' hushed procession showing his new gravity of form and gesture.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Van der Goes sets the sitter's clasped, praying hands and steady three-quarter gaze against a glimpsed window landscape, the oval format concentrating attention on quiet Flemish naturalism.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: Van Gogh crams a chipped white pitcher with cobalt irises whose thick, urgent impasto strokes electrify the flat, chalky ground — pure vibrating color as subject.
works.title: Irises

works.caption: Van Gogh flattens Madame Ginoux against searing chrome yellow, her pensive chin-in-hand pose and stack of yellow novels rendered in bold outline and jabbing brushstrokes.
works.title: L'Arlésienne: Madame Joseph-Michel Ginoux (Marie Julien, 1848–1911)

works.caption: Van Gogh whips the sky into rolling, rope-thick swirls behind a flame-like cypress, wheat field and cloud rendered with the same restless, coiling energy.
works.title: Wheat Field with Cypresses

works.caption: Goya poses two majas in gold-trimmed white against a wrought-iron rail, their teasing complicity set off by the shadowy, cloaked men lurking behind them.
works.title: Majas on a Balcony

works.caption: El Greco erupts the Cardinal's rose-magenta silk into jagged, electric folds, spectacles and cool appraising eyes giving the sitter an intensity that outshines the pomp of his office.
works.title: Cardinal Fernando Niño de Guevara (1541–1609)

works.caption: El Greco isolates a bald, bearded head against near-black shadow, the starched ruff and searching eyes carrying the whole psychological weight of the portrait.
works.title: Portrait of an Old Man

works.caption: El Greco turns Toledo into a visionary silhouette beneath a churning, storm-lit sky, the hilltop city glowing an eerie green-grey against near-black clouds.
works.title: View of Toledo

works.caption: El Greco's late visionary style dissolves Revelation into a phosphorescent turmoil of writhing bodies and unearthly color, Saint John's upraised arms conducting the storm of drapery below.
works.title: The Vision of Saint John

works.caption: Hals catches a raised wineglass and a burst of laughter mid-gesture, the couple's flushed cheeks and feathered hat brim rendered in loose, virtuoso brushwork that seems to move.
works.title: Young Man and Woman in an Inn

works.caption: Haverman packs an arched niche with an extravagant tumble of tulips, roses, and grapes, a snail and butterfly adding quiet incident to the dense, dark-ground bouquet.
works.title: A Vase of Flowers

works.caption: Holbein sets a crisp, gold-inscribed sitter against pure ultramarine, the fur-trimmed black coat and clasped prayer book rendered with a precision so exact it reads almost photographic.
works.title: Hermann von Wedigh III (died 1560)

works.caption: Ingres renders porcelain skin and a cascading gold chain with crystalline precision, the sitter's poised half-smile and richly patterned shawl anchoring a masterclass in Neoclassical portraiture.
works.title: Madame Jacques-Louis Leblanc (Françoise Poncelle, 1788–1839)

works.caption: Klimt dissolves the girl's white dress into a mosaic of floral confetti against violet, letting the pattern nearly swallow the sitter's composed, direct gaze.
works.title: Mäda Primavesi (1903–2000)

works.caption: A single sweep of iridescent white satin carries the whole portrait; look at how loosely brushed drapery still reads as weighty, luminous fabric.
works.title: Serena Pulitzer Lederer (1867–1943)

works.caption: A ring of thieving hands closes on the oblivious young dandy while the fortune-teller's gaze holds his; La Tour's cool, sculptural lighting and covert pickpocketing make this a masterclass in narrative misdirection.
works.title: The Fortune-Teller

works.caption: Firelight glances off the skull and the woman's folded hands, the candle itself hidden so only its reflected glow models her face; a hushed, single-source composition of rare intensity.
works.title: The Penitent Magdalen

works.caption: Lawrence lets the fur-trimmed cloak billow into the landscape, the sitter caught mid-turn with a knowing half-smile against a wind-scudded sky.
works.title: Elizabeth Farren (born about 1759, died 1829), Later Countess of Derby

works.caption: Lippi's Madonna bends over a sleeping Christ Child on a velvet cushion, a sunlit loggia and townscape opening behind her in crystalline Florentine light.
works.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: Note the illusionistic conceit of the man's head poking through the window frame at left, and the crisp profile of the woman in brocaded crimson against a distant view of a walled town.
works.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Man at a Casement

works.caption: A glowing gold-ground altarpiece where Lippi sets soft, individualized faces of kneeling donors against flat, radiant pattern and rose-and-blue drapery.
works.title: Saint Lawrence Enthroned with Saints and Donors

works.caption: Cupid's bow ties a bell to a garland while Venus reclines in jeweled diadem and scattered rose petals; Lotto's cool porcelain flesh tones play against the deep red curtain.
works.title: Venus and Cupid

works.caption: Manet's Spanish singer strums against a bare brown ground, the still-life of onions and jug at his feet painted with the same blunt, confident economy as the figure.
works.title: The Spanish Singer

works.caption: A cross-dressed toreador stares out with flat, matter-of-fact composure, the bullfight behind her rendered as a loose, almost collaged vignette.
works.title: Mademoiselle V. . . in the Costume of an Espada

works.caption: Cropped tight and radically flattened, the boater and his companion float against slabs of turquoise water; the composition's audacious cropping was itself scandalous in 1874.
works.title: Boating

works.caption: Shepherds crowd in from the right while a marble Madonna kneels in near-monochrome stone-colored drapery; Mantegna's tempera-on-canvas surface gives every fold a carved, sculptural edge.
works.medium: Tempera on canvas, transferred from wood
works.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: A laden table of melon, grapes, bread, and copper vessels catches raking light against a distant blue landscape; Meléndez's precision makes every rind and crumb tactile.
works.title: The Afternoon Meal (La Merienda)

works.caption: A merchant and his wife kneel in perpetual prayer, their hands and faces rendered with such crystalline precision that the diptych still functions as a private devotional mirror.
works.title: Tommaso di Folco Portinari (1428–1501); Maria Portinari (Maria Maddalena Baroncelli, born 1456)

works.caption: Three towering haystacks loom over a flock crossing the plain beneath a bruised, stormy sky; Millet's silhouetted shepherd anchors the scene's quiet monumentality.
works.title: Haystacks: Autumn

works.caption: The winged sphinx presses against Oedipus's bare chest, claws sunk into his thigh, while a scattering of severed limbs at the base names the stakes of the riddle.
works.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx

works.caption: St. Jerome kneels before his rock-cut grotto in the central panel while the Baptism and a monk-donor flank him; the real subject is the vast, jagged blue-grey mountain landscape swallowing all three scenes.
works.title: The Penitence of Saint Jerome

works.artist: Piero di Cosimo (Piero di Lorenzo di Piero d'Antonio)
works.artistSort: d'Antonio), Piero di Cosimo (Piero di Lorenzo di Piero
works.caption: A frieze of hybrid satyrs and colossal humans battles wild boars and lions across a scorched, fire-lit forest — a startlingly savage vision of prehistory for a domestic furniture panel.
works.medium: Tempera and oil transferred to Masonite
works.title: A Hunting Scene

works.caption: A woman climbs a sunlit path past a walled village tucked into rolling farmland; Pissarro's high vantage and layered greens give the hillside real depth and air.
works.title: Jalais Hill, Pontoise

works.caption: A bird's-eye view down the boulevard turns carriages and pedestrians into a scatter of quick dark strokes against wet, silvery pavement — one of Pissarro's great Parisian series views.
works.title: The Boulevard Montmartre on a Winter Morning

works.caption: The blind giant Orion strides toward the rising sun with tiny Diana perched in the clouds above; Poussin's mythic landscape dwarfs its figures beneath an immense, atmospheric sky.
works.title: Blind Orion Searching for the Rising Sun

works.caption: Romulus's raised cloak signals the ambush as chaos erupts across the piazza; trace how Poussin choreographs dozens of wrestling, grasping figures into distinct, legible pairs.
works.title: The Abduction of the Sabine Women

works.caption: Enthroned above kneeling saints, the Madonna's tender downward glance anchors a monumental altarpiece capped by God the Father and flanking angels — Raphael's architectural clarity organizes the whole crowded field.
works.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints

works.caption: The carver's weathered hand rests on a cane, his broad-brimmed black hat throwing deep shadow over a face full of quiet, individualized character.
works.title: Herman Doomer (ca. 1595–1650)

works.caption: A blind of shadow swallows the room while Rembrandt's raking light finds Aristotle's hand resting on Homer's marble brow — a meditation on fame painted almost entirely in umber and gold.
works.title: Aristotle with a Bust of Homer

works.caption: The fur-trimmed hat and gold sash catch the only strong light, while Rembrandt's loaded, dragged brushwork turns embroidery and flesh alike into pure paint.
works.title: The Standard Bearer (probably Floris Soop, 1604–1657)

works.caption: Rembrandt's final self-portrait as an old master: a single beam models the ravaged, unflinching face while the beret and robe dissolve into shadow.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Three ruddy-cheeked infants clamber over an allegorical mother in Reni's cool, porcelain palette — tenderness rendered with an almost sculptural polish.
works.title: Charity

works.caption: The Virgin rises weightless against a furnace of golden cloud, her rose and blue robes and the flanking angels arranged with Reni's characteristic clarity and poise.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception

works.caption: A tall, self-possessed young officer leans against his horse under a wind-tossed tree, Reynolds' scarlet coat blazing against somber greens and grays.
works.title: Captain George K. H. Coussmaker (1759–1801)

works.caption: Ribera softens his usual tenebrism into warm, close-observed intimacy — note the still-life basket of fruit glowing in the lower left against the deep shadow.
works.title: The Holy Family with Saints Anne and Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: Memling stages the Annunciation inside a sumptuous crimson bedchamber, the angel's brocade robe and the distant walled city rewarding minutes of close looking.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Rubens paints his own family as a garden idyll — himself, his young wife Helena, and their son, with a macaw and fountain adding flashes of exotic color.
works.title: Rubens, Helena Fourment (1614–1673), and Their Son Frans (1633–1678)

works.caption: Venus clings to a departing, red-draped Adonis while his hounds strain at the leash — Rubens builds the whole drama from the collision of warm flesh and cool landscape.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: A churning, full-throttle hunt: horses, hounds, and wolves lock together in a diagonal tangle of violence that Rubens choreographs across the whole canvas.
works.title: Wolf and Fox Hunt

works.caption: Ruisdael gives two-thirds of the canvas to a towering sky of piled cumulus, the wheat fields below rendered almost as an afterthought beneath that drama.
works.title: Wheat Fields

works.caption: Andrea del Sarto arranges four figures and a glowing globe into a pyramid of cool, saturated color — pink, gold, and blue silk set against deep olive drapery.
works.title: The Holy Family with the Young Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: A shaft of candlelight isolates Matthew's writing hand and the angel's blue-violet wing from an almost total surrounding darkness — Savoldo's signature nocturnal drama.
works.title: Saint Matthew and the Angel

works.caption: Seurat's pointillist dots resolve, at a distance, into gaslit sideshow performers frozen mid-gesture — a deliberately airless, hieratic take on popular entertainment.
works.title: Circus Sideshow (Parade de cirque)

works.caption: A crowded garden party spills across the canvas in a riot of incident — musicians, children, a caged owl — all rendered with Steen's easy narrative wit.
works.title: Merry Company on a Terrace

works.caption: Two half-length figures, one bare-chested and pleading, the other richly dressed in red satin, embody Sweerts' unusual blend of Caravaggesque charity and cool Northern restraint.
works.title: Clothing the Naked

works.caption: An early, tender Titian: the infant's weight sags convincingly into his mother's red sleeve while a blue mantle and distant seascape frame the intimacy.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: A red-bearded gentleman turns to meet the viewer's gaze, his ruff and dark doublet dissolving into shadow so that only the illuminated face and hand truly hold focus.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: Venus grips a fleeing Adonis by the arm, her bare back turned fully to the viewer — late Titian at his loosest and most urgent, paint applied almost like drapery itself.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: Two women flank a top-hatted dandy under electric cabaret light — Toulouse-Lautrec flattens the scene into bold outline and caricature-sharp color.
works.title: The Englishman (William Tom Warrener, 1861–1934) at the Moulin Rouge

works.caption: A ghost ship dissolves into fog and spray, Turner reducing masts and sails to a few pale, wind-scraped strokes almost swallowed by the surrounding atmosphere.
works.title: Whalers

works.artist: Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez)
works.artistSort: Velázquez), Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y
works.caption: Velázquez's portrait of his enslaved assistant, painted with such directness of gaze and economy of brush that it reportedly stunned contemporaries who saw it exhibited in Rome.
works.title: Juan de Pareja (ca. 1608–1670)

works.artist: Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez)
works.artistSort: Velázquez), Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y
works.caption: The young infanta's elaborate lace-wired hairstyle spreads like wings around her small, solemn face — Velázquez renders the artifice with almost abstract, flickering brushwork.
works.title: María Teresa (1638–1683), Infanta of Spain

works.artist: Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez)
works.artistSort: Velázquez), Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y
works.caption: A three-quarter turn and a flash of white collar are all that interrupt the deep, smoky brown ground — possibly Velázquez looking at himself.
works.title: Portrait of a Man, Possibly a Self-Portrait

works.caption: A servant dozes over an untouched table of fruit and wine, sunlight slicing through a doorway beyond — Vermeer's early mastery of interior light and psychological suspension.
works.title: A Maid Asleep

works.caption: An unfinished-looking tronie, the sitter's face luminous against near-total black — Vermeer strips away narrative to leave pure, uncanny presence.
works.title: Study of a Young Woman

works.caption: Cool north light falls across brass, linen, and a Turkish carpet in one of Vermeer's most perfectly balanced compositions of domestic stillness.
works.title: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher

works.caption: Veronese piles up sensuous incident — a rearing gray horse, putti, silk drapery in rose and gold — around the embracing lovers with his customary theatrical bravura.
works.title: Mars and Venus United by Love

works.caption: An oval format tightens the focus on Vigée Le Brun's sitter, her powdered curls and pale blue sash set glowing against pure black, a folded letter caught mid-gesture in her hand.
works.title: Madame Grand (Noël Catherine Vorlée, 1761–1835)

works.caption: Vigée Le Brun poses her sitter in a broad-brimmed hat and cascading black ribbon against emerald velvet — informal, direct, and remarkably fresh in handling.
works.title: Comtesse de la Châtre (Marie Charlotte Louise Perrette Aglaé Bontemps, 1762–1848)

works.caption: A young girl kneels in prayer between rose-pink curtains, her plain sewing cushion and scattered wildflowers grounding Zurbarán's otherwise devotional stillness in domestic realism.
works.title: The Young Virgin

works.caption: Flame-shaped cypresses twist upward against a swirling turquoise sky — van Gogh's brush turns still trees into something almost combustible.
works.title: Cypresses

works.caption: A seated laborer in a plain hat and coat, blocked out in Cézanne's characteristic slabs of muted color and rebuilt, faceted brushwork rather than smooth modeling.
works.title: Seated Peasant

works.caption: Three sisters cluster around a piano, violin bow and sheet music in hand — Renoir arranges white dresses and warm interior tones into an effortlessly buoyant family scene.
works.title: The Daughters of Catulle Mendès, Huguette (1871–1964), Claudine (1876–1937), and Helyonne (1879–1955)

works.caption: The queen stands beside a crown resting on a velvet cushion, her cascading lace sleeves and pearl-trimmed bodice painted with Van Dyck's characteristic silvery elegance.
works.title: Queen Henrietta Maria

works.caption: A darkened Confederate raider looms behind a small boat's russet sail, Manet compressing naval history into a flat, almost abstract arrangement of turquoise sea and dark hulls.
works.title: The "Kearsarge" at Boulogne

works.caption: Carracci packs the mourners into a dense triangular knot around Christ's pallid body, the whole scene lit as if by a single guttering torch just outside the frame.
works.title: The Burial of Christ

works.caption: Two tiny silhouettes stand dwarfed beneath a gnarled, half-dead oak, their backs to us as they gaze at a sliver of moon — Friedrich's Romantic sublime distilled to near silence.
works.title: Two Men Contemplating the Moon

works.caption: A lion locks its jaws on a leopard amid an improbable, jewel-toned jungle of banana leaves and lotus blooms — naive painting turned into pure nocturnal menace.
works.title: The Repast of the Lion

works.caption: Follow the ancient plum's gnarled black trunk as it lunges across four gold-leaf panels, pale blossoms scattered like stars against the glowing ground.
works.medium: Four sliding-door panels (fusuma); ink, color, gold, and gold leaf on paper
works.title: Old Plum

works.caption: Kōrin reduces the sea to pure abstract rhythm: coiling silver-grey breakers and a single stylized claw-wave against gold, decades ahead of their time.
works.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink, color, and gold leaf on paper
works.title: Rough Waves

works.caption: Ni Zan's dry, spare brushwork builds a rock outcrop and bare autumn trees over empty space, the epitome of Yuan-dynasty literati restraint.
works.title: Woods and Valleys of Mount Yu

works.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)
works.artistSort: Grazia), Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di
works.caption: God reaches into a jewel-like concentric globe of creation while Adam, Eve, and the expelling angel float weightlessly through an orchard of golden fruit.
works.title: The Creation of the World and the Expulsion from Paradise

works.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)
works.artistSort: Grazia), Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di
works.caption: Christ crowns his mother beneath a canopy of overlapping haloed heads, Giovanni di Paolo's crowd rendered as a shimmering wall of gold and pattern.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Petrus Christus fills every inch of the goldsmith's cluttered stall with coral, rings, and pewter, a convex mirror in the corner slyly reflecting the street outside.
works.title: A Goldsmith in his Shop

works.caption: One girl leans over her sister at the keyboard to turn the page, Renoir bathing the whole scene in the soft pinks and blues of late-afternoon light.
works.title: Two Young Girls at the Piano

works.caption: Wu Bin renders the legendary Luohans with wildly inventive, individualized features and gnarled, otherworldly trees, the ink line moving between flesh, bark, and drapery with the same wiry energy.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
works.title: The Sixteen Luohans

works.caption: A vast panoramic ascent up Mount Tai unfolds in blue-green washes, with tiny figures, temples, and processions threaded through the folds of rock in Wang Hui's synthesis of court grandeur and landscape mastery.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: The Kangxi Emperor's Southern Inspection Tour, Scroll Three: Ji'nan to Mount Tai

works.caption: A Roman-Egyptian boy gazes out with startling directness, his encaustic portrait built up in thick, luminous strokes meant to mark his mummy in the afterlife.
works.title: Portrait of the Boy Eutyches

works.caption: A father gestures amid globes, busts, and a memento mori skull while his large family gathers close, Le Brun weaving portraiture and vanitas into one dense, shadowed interior.
works.title: The Jabach Family

works.caption: A shepherd crouches in anguish among rocks while a procession of nude figures drifts along the horizon above, Hodler's flattened, symbolist landscape turning grief into pattern.
works.title: The Dream of the Shepherd (Der Traum des Hirten)

works.caption: Gleaming fish and salmon steaks crowd a market table while a bustling town scene recedes through the archway behind, Beuckelaer fusing still life with genre panorama.
works.title: Fish Market

works.caption: A guitarist glances up from her instrument, her exposed shoulder and rumpled red drapery caught in a single raking light against total darkness, Vouet at his most Caravaggesque.
works.title: Woman Playing a Guitar

works.caption: A precise geometric mandala unfolds in concentric squares and circles, tiny painted deities lining every border in a display of exacting devotional order.
works.title: Mandala of Raktayamari

works.caption: Mahakala looms black and fanged against a blaze of red and orange flame, his skull crown and bone ornaments rendered with a jeweler's exactness.
works.title: Mahakala, Protector of the Tent

works.caption: A tight bouquet of roses, tulips, and narcissus glows against a near-black ground, each petal and dewdrop picked out with jewel-like precision, Peeters at the height of her powers.
works.title: A Bouquet of Flowers

works.caption: The Daoist immortal soars through billowing cloud on a wave of pure brushwork, ink alone conjuring speed and weightlessness.
works.title: Daoist Master Fei Zhangfang

works.caption: Poplars line the riverbank in quick, sunlit strokes, their reflections breaking apart on the Seine's surface in one of Sisley's most buoyant Impressionist views.
works.title: The Seine at Bougival

works.caption: A mother leans back against a great tree trunk as her children press close, Reynolds using the deep shadow of the foliage to set off the glow of pink silk and pale skin.
works.title: Lady Elizabeth Delmé and Her Children

works.caption: Van Gogh sets himself against a churning field of blue brushstrokes, the same restless rhythm animating both his coat and the space around him.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: A young girl in black cape and white satin reaches toward a rose bush, Reynolds balancing the solemnity of her dark dress against a bright, breezy sky.
works.title: Lady Caroline Howard

works.caption: A crowded feast of gods in a shadowed grove, finished by Titian after Bellini's death; watch the light strike the blue and white robes among the trees.
works.title: The Feast of the Gods

works.caption: Constable's family estate under a vast, roiling sky, cattle at the water's edge and swans gliding by; the clouds do as much work as the land below.
works.title: Wivenhoe Park, Essex

works.caption: El Greco elongates horse and rider into a flame-like silhouette against storm-lit clouds, the beggar's bare torso a cool foil to the saint's gilded armor.
works.title: Saint Martin and the Beggar

works.caption: A bullfighter lies flat and foreshortened on bare ground, the wound almost an afterthought; Manet strips the death of all theater.
works.title: The Dead Toreador

works.artist: Andrea Mantegna or Follower (Possibly Giulio Campagnola)
works.artistSort: Mantegna, Andrea or Follower (Possibly Giulio Campagnola)
works.caption: Watch the collision of pattern and flesh: the gold-fringed pink tent canopy sets off Judith's cool blue-and-white drapery and the servant's unflinching gaze into the sack.
works.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes

works.caption: The girl's frank, dimpled smile leaning on the sill plays against the older woman's half-hidden laugh behind her veil, framed by warm, worn wood.
works.title: Two Women at a Window

works.caption: Note the tender weight of the Child's grip on his mother's shoulder against her serene, downcast calm, all rendered in Raphael's crystalline sfumato.
works.title: The Small Cowper Madonna

works.caption: A brooding sky presses down on the lit windmill and quiet river below, Rembrandt's chiaroscuro turning a humble landscape into a meditation on weather and light.
works.title: The Mill

works.caption: The sitter's turned pose and level, appraising gaze cut through the flat green ground, his blue robe glowing against black shadow.
works.title: Bindo Altoviti

works.caption: A near-monochrome study in whites — dress, curtain, and carpet — punctuated only by red hair and the snarling wolf-skin rug underfoot.
works.title: Symphony in White, No. 1: The White Girl

works.caption: The empty scale balances against the Last Judgment painting behind her, Vermeer's raking window light turning a quiet domestic moment into meditation.
works.title: Woman Holding a Balance

works.caption: Church positions the viewer at the very brink of Horseshoe Falls, the water's curve and a faint rainbow drawing the eye endlessly downward.
works.title: Niagara

works.caption: A red-capped youth turns his shoulder but not his eyes from us, Botticelli's black background making every strand of curling hair and vein of skin sing.
works.title: Portrait of a Youth

works.caption: Magdalene's head falls back in rapture, throat bared and eyes shut, Gentileschi turning penitence into a study of pure physical abandon.
works.title: Mary Magdalene in Ecstasy

works.caption: Mother and child fill a perfect tondo against a serene river valley, Raphael's pyramidal composition making the circular format feel inevitable.
works.medium: oil on panel transferred to canvas
works.title: The Alba Madonna

works.caption: The infant Christ reaches to caress his mother's face, Raphael's blue-green backdrop and porcelain flesh tones giving the tenderness a jewel-like finish.
works.title: The Niccolini-Cowper Madonna

works.caption: Saint George's lance snaps as his white horse rears over a fallen dragon, the small kneeling princess watching from a hushed, sunlit distance.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: A catboat heels hard as young sailors lean to keep it upright, Homer's salt spray and taut canvas capturing the exact instant before the wind wins.
works.title: Breezing Up (A Fair Wind)

works.caption: Ingres renders black silk taffeta with such crackling precision that it nearly outshines the sitter's cool, appraising stare and rose-crowned hair.
works.title: Madame Moitessier

works.caption: Laocoon and his sons writhe among serpents on a bare hill above a spectral view of Toledo, El Greco setting classical myth in his own adopted city.
works.title: Laocoön

works.caption: A woman collapses into a sofa in a shimmering ivory wrap, Sargent's slashing, confident brushwork turning exhaustion into pure luxury of paint.
works.title: Nonchaloir (Repose)

works.caption: Leyster turns to the viewer mid-stroke, brush raised, a fiddling figure taking shape on her easel; a rare, confident record of a woman at work.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: A gentleman skater glides past in profile, arms folded, black silhouette crisp against a frozen Scottish loch; Stuart turns a portrait into pure motion.
works.title: The Skater (Portrait of William Grant)

works.caption: Venus checks her reflection while two cupids attend her, Titian's warm flesh and crimson velvet drapery among the most sensuous passages he ever painted.
works.title: Venus with a Mirror

works.artist: Fra Angelico and Fra Filippo Lippi
works.artistSort: Angelico, Fra and Fra Filippo Lippi
works.caption: A vast, crowded Adoration spills across a circular panel, peacock and ruined arch presiding over kings, horses, and a hillside procession of pilgrims.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: The Farnese boy stands stiffly in a Maltese cross-emblazoned cloak, Titian's touch turning a child's discomfort into a study of inherited authority.
works.title: Ranuccio Farnese

works.caption: Mary holds her restless infant before a red curtain opening onto a distant castle, Durer's crystalline detail extending from face to far horizon.
works.title: Madonna and Child [obverse]

works.caption: Cardinal Bembo's red robes fill the frame in a blaze of thick, unblended color, Titian's late touch as much the subject as the sitter's severe face.
works.title: Cardinal Pietro Bembo

works.caption: Henrietta Maria towers over her diminutive court dwarf and his monkey, Van Dyck's silvery blue satin and orange curtain a triumph of surface.
works.title: Queen Henrietta Maria with Sir Jeffrey Hudson

works.caption: Giuliano de' Medici is shown in profile after his assassination, a dove and dead branch behind him; Botticelli turns portraiture into elegy.
works.title: Giuliano de' Medici

works.caption: Two tiny figures fish from boats beneath a screen of towering trees, Carracci's idealized grove framing a hazy, sunlit town on the far shore.
works.title: River Landscape

works.caption: A rare, damaged-canon Giorgione: shepherds kneel in a cave mouth while a luminous Venetian landscape unrolls behind them, the light doing as much storytelling as the figures.
works.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: A girl turns her back on us to watch a train's steam rise beyond an iron fence, while her companion's blank, direct gaze makes Manet's modern-life scene both intimate and estranging.
works.title: The Railway

works.caption: Gabriel and Mary meet inside a jewel-box Romanesque church whose floor tiles, stained glass, and gilded brocade are rendered with a jeweler's precision that rewards endless close looking.
works.medium: oil on canvas transferred from panel
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Napoleon stands mid-stride at 4:13 a.m., candle guttered and papers strewn, David turning an official portrait into a study of a workaholic emperor caught between night and dawn.
works.title: The Emperor Napoleon in His Study at the Tuileries

works.caption: Titian's late, slashing brushwork dissolves the doge's ceremonial robes into golden impasto while the sitter's hooded eyes hold onto sharp psychological presence.
works.title: Doge Andrea Gritti

works.caption: Marchesa Doria's silvery satin gown and towering ruff catch the light with almost photographic brilliance, Rubens turning textile description into pure virtuoso display.
works.title: Marchesa Brigida Spinola Doria

works.caption: A girl in buttery yellow silk absorbs herself in a book, Fragonard's rapid, confident strokes making the fabric and flesh feel freshly, almost recklessly painted.
works.title: Young Girl Reading

works.caption: A woman glances up mid-sentence, quill poised, pearls catching the light — Vermeer distills an entire interior world into a few square feet of hushed, silvery paint.
works.title: A Lady Writing

works.caption: A father rows while a mother steadies a squirming baby, Cassatt cropping the boat's sharp diagonal oar and yellow hull into a daringly graphic, almost Japanese composition.
works.title: The Boating Party

works.caption: Two women lounge on a purple-pink shore under a twisting black tree, Gauguin flattening Tahiti into arbitrary, saturated color fields that owe more to invention than observation.
works.title: Fatata te Miti (By the Sea)

works.caption: Gauguin paints himself haloed against blood-red and mustard grounds, apples dangling like forbidden fruit beside a coiled green serpent — a self-mythologizing icon.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: A young Arlésienne in a striped jacket sits against flat turquoise, van Gogh's directional brushstrokes turning fabric and skin alike into vibrating fields of color.
works.title: La Mousmé

works.caption: A ragged troupe of Parisian street performers and beggars stares out at the viewer, Manet flattening them into a frieze that reads as both genre scene and social document.
works.title: The Old Musician

works.caption: A little girl in a lace-trimmed navy pinafore waters a garden path, Renoir dissolving foliage and dress alike into a shimmer of dappled, sun-warmed brushwork.
works.title: A Girl with a Watering Can

works.caption: Petrus Christus sets the Nativity within an elaborate carved stone portal decorated with tiny Old Testament reliefs, the framing device as inventive as the tender scene it encloses.
works.title: The Nativity

works.caption: Daniel prays amid a den of lions rendered with ferocious anatomical specificity, Rubens turning a crowded menagerie into a single coiled arc of tension.
works.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den

works.caption: A tropical river dissolves into blinding, sun-struck haze at the horizon, Church's Ecuadorian landscape a masterclass in atmospheric light over botanical detail.
works.title: El Rio de Luz (The River of Light)

works.caption: Ginevra's pale, unsmiling face is set against a spiky juniper bush — a pun on her name — with Leonardo's soft sfumato modeling already announcing a new kind of portraiture.
works.title: Ginevra de' Benci [obverse]

works.caption: A noblewoman's folded hands and lowered eyes sit beneath an origami-crisp white hennin, Rogier van der Weyden distilling her presence into pure, austere geometry against deep blue.
works.title: Portrait of a Lady

works.caption: Crowds, carriages, and a tricolor flag animate a sunlit Parisian bridge, Renoir stacking tiny, precisely placed figures against the broad blue Seine and sky.
works.title: Pont Neuf, Paris

works.caption: A woman alone at a café table rests her chin on her hand beside an untouched glass of plum brandy, Manet's flat pink and maroon planes conveying a mood of quiet drift.
works.title: Plum Brandy

works.caption: A hot palette of acid green and pink stages a Tahitian myth of temptation, the crouching figure's masked face and the serpentine curves in the foreground giving the scene its unsettling charge.
works.title: Parau na te Varua ino (Words of the Devil)

works.caption: A single candle flame reduces the world to a few glowing planes, La Tour using the skull and the Magdalen's shadowed profile to stage a meditation on mortality.
works.title: The Repentant Magdalen

works.caption: An infant's face barely surfaces from an avalanche of patterned blankets, Klimt's late, loosened brushwork turning swaddling cloth into a riot of unrelated textiles.
works.title: Baby (Cradle)

works.caption: A towering, sun-shot cloudbank dwarfs the crowded river traffic below, Cuyp's golden light turning an ordinary harbor scene into something monumental.
works.title: The Maas at Dordrecht

works.caption: The vermilion hat's soft halo of light against deep blue satin is a masterclass in Vermeer's optical, almost photographic handling of color and texture.
works.title: Girl with the Red Hat

works.caption: A wall of black-coated men crowds around masked women in a dense, almost claustrophobic sea of top hats, Manet's rapid brushwork capturing the anonymity of Parisian nightlife.
works.title: Masked Ball at the Opera

works.caption: A child sprawls across a sea of turquoise chintz armchairs, Cassatt's bold cropping and unposed slouch giving the scene a startlingly modern, snapshot feel.
works.title: Little Girl in a Blue Armchair

works.caption: Wind-whipped clouds and grass echo the billowing parasol and skirt, Monet's broken brushwork making the whole canvas seem to move in the same breeze as his figures.
works.title: Woman with a Parasol - Madame Monet and Her Son

works.caption: The costumed harlequin's diamond-patterned suit is built from Cezanne's characteristic constructive brushstrokes, the figure's flat, mask-like face standing apart from the loosely painted curtain behind.
works.title: Harlequin

works.caption: Bodies and horses tumble diagonally out of a shaft of light in full baroque tumult, Rubens choreographing the plunging chariot with a dancer's sense of mass and momentum.
works.title: The Fall of Phaeton

works.caption: Restless green brushstrokes swirl behind a heavy jug of white roses, Van Gogh's late still life vibrating with the same nervous energy as his skies.
works.title: Roses

works.caption: Rembrandt confronts his own aged face with unsparing directness, thick impasto catching light on the brow while the surrounding darkness swallows everything else.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Lucretia's raised dagger and unfocused, tear-brimmed gaze catch the instant before her suicide, Rembrandt building the tragedy from thick, glowing strokes of gold brocade and pearl.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: A magnificent fur hat and gold chain of office catch raking light against deep shadow, Rembrandt lavishing exotic costume detail on an invented Eastern-European type.
works.title: A Polish Nobleman

works.caption: Velazquez lets a bare shoulder and absorbed downward gaze carry the intimacy of this working woman, the sewing itself rendered in a few economical, unfinished strokes.
works.title: The Needlewoman

works.caption: Layers of translucent gauze and ribbon float over the marquesa's gown, Goya's virtuoso handling of sheer fabric set against a jaunty pug and dappled park light.
works.title: The Marquesa de Pontejos

works.caption: A discarded violin and a slumped, exhausted dancer in the foreground puncture the tutu-clad grace of the rehearsal beyond, Degas finding drama in the unglamorous backstage moment.
works.title: The Dance Lesson

works.caption: A pale, direct face emerges from an almost total black ground, Goya's flickering brushwork on the striped mantilla and shawl the only bright incident in an austere composition.
works.title: Señora Sabasa Garcia

works.caption: A cloud of unruly curls and diaphanous fichu sit against a windswept, feathery landscape, Gainsborough's silvery brushwork blurring the line between sitter and setting.
works.title: Mrs. Richard Brinsley Sheridan

works.caption: A dark, painterly thundercloud presses down over a sunlit stone bridge and quiet boaters, Rembrandt's rare landscape turning weather into the real subject.
works.title: The Stone Bridge

works.caption: A wrecked ship pitches in violent surf beneath towering, sunlit storm clouds, Nuijen staging the human wreckage on the beach against a romantic sublime sky.
works.title: Shipwreck off a Rocky Coast

works.caption: Smoke and battle haze roll across a churned field crowded with mounted officers and fallen soldiers, Pieneman staging the historic moment with sweeping panoramic ambition.
works.title: The Battle of Waterloo

works.caption: A weathered profile with wind-tossed silver hair stands crisp against a serene blue Tuscan landscape, Piero di Cosimo's hard-edged Flemish-influenced realism giving the sitter real physical presence.
works.title: Giuliano & Francesco Giamberti da Sangallo Piero di Cosimo (1462–1522)

works.caption: A shaft of light picks a golden-clad lieutenant and the ghostly girl in yellow out of the militia's swirling dark ranks, Rembrandt turning a group portrait into pure theatrical drama.
works.title: The Night Watch Militia Company of District II under the Command of Captain Frans Banninck Cocq

works.caption: The direct, interrupted gazes of the six syndics and Rembrandt's mastery of black cloth against a warm gold wall reward long looking.
works.title: The syndics: the sampling officials (wardens) of the Amsterdam drapers

works.caption: A weathered tronie built from thick, glinting strokes of paint describing the folds of a white turban and a searching, deep-set gaze.
works.title: An oriental

works.caption: Look at the man's golden sleeve and the tenderness of the two hands resting on the woman's chest, painted with astonishing thickness and warmth.
works.title: Isaac and Rebecca, Known as ‘The Jewish Bride’

works.caption: Rembrandt at about twenty, his tangle of curls picked out in golden highlights against a bare plaster wall, already commanding attention.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: An intricate lace collar and steady, appraising gaze anchor this quietly assured portrait set in a shadowed archway.
works.title: Portrait of a woman, possibly Maria Trip

works.caption: The prophet slumps beside gleaming gold vessels while a burning city glows faintly in the distance, grief rendered through posture alone.
works.title: Jeremiah Lamenting the Destruction of Jerusalem

works.caption: A single shaft of light falls across an illuminated page and a pair of worn, careful hands turning it.
works.title: Old Woman Reading, Probably the Prophetess Anna

works.caption: Rembrandt looks out past the viewer, sword hilt and manuscript pages caught in warm light, questioning and unguarded at once.
works.title: Self Portrait as the Apostle Paul

works.caption: Soaring white piers and a hanging organ case demonstrate Saenredam's uncanny precision in rendering perspective and pale interior light.
works.title: Interior of the Church of St Bavo in Haarlem

works.caption: A stark, whitewashed nave recedes under heavy timber beams, tiny worshippers giving scale to the austere architecture.
works.title: Interior of the Sint-Odulphuskerk in Assendelft

works.caption: A vast, muted panorama of cliffs and river valley by one of Dutch landscape's most unusual and influential figures.
works.title: River valley

works.caption: Plaster casts and a flayed figure litter the floor of a shadowy academy where students draw from posed sculpture.
works.title: A Painter’s Studio

works.caption: A raucous village dance spills across the floor around a hidden egg, Aertsen's earthy genre painting at its liveliest.
works.title: The Egg Dance

works.caption: A mute swan rears up with wings flared and beak agape in furious defense of its nest, one of Dutch painting's most theatrical animal portraits.
works.title: The Threatened Swan

works.caption: Skaters, sledges, and huddled figures animate a frozen river beneath pale winter light in one of the founding images of the genre.
works.title: Winter Landscape with Skaters

works.caption: Vulcan clamps Prometheus's chains shut while Mercury looks on with an unsettling grin, the composition built on straining, twisted anatomy.
works.title: Prometheus Chained by Vulcan

works.caption: A solitary toddler in white satin and a straw handbag stares out from an unbroken black void, ter Borch's masterful handling of fabric giving the tiny figure real presence.
works.title: Helena van der Schalcke

works.caption: Candlelit intimacy of a soldier, a woman drinking, and a standing figure in luminous silver satin — ter Borch's quietly ambiguous genre scene rewards close, patient looking.
works.title: Gallant Conversation, Known as ‘The Paternal Admonition’

works.caption: A ship pitches violently under a torn sail as a squall darkens the sky, van de Velde's dramatic contrast of churning water and light making the tempest palpable.
works.title: A Ship on the High Seas Caught by a Squall, Known as ‘The Gust’

works.caption: Vermeer's milkmaid pours with monumental stillness, the pointillist highlights on the bread crust and the pure cobalt of her apron among the most quietly perfect passages in Dutch painting.
works.title: The Milkmaid

works.caption: Framed through a doorway past a broom and discarded slippers, a woman receives a letter from her maid, Vermeer turning a domestic threshold into quiet psychological theater.
works.title: The Love Letter

works.caption: Vermeer's weathered brick facades and whitewashed doorway hold two women at quiet domestic tasks, the whole scene built from perfectly calibrated planes of color and texture.
works.title: View of Houses in Delft, Known as The Little Street

works.caption: A woman absorbed in a letter stands beside a wall map, Vermeer's ultramarine jacket and pearly light distilling an entire private world into stillness.
works.title: Woman Reading a Letter

works.caption: A garland of pomegranates, grapes, and peaches hangs from a blue ribbon, de Heem's razor-sharp rendering of ripe and split fruit almost tactile against the black ground.
works.title: Festoon of Fruit and Flowers
