works.caption: An overflowing bouquet of crown imperials, roses, and tulips towers beside a stone urn and classical statue, a bird's nest tucked at the base — van Huysum's opulent still life at its peak.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers

works.caption: Broken strokes of lavender and ochre trace a coastal road curling beneath a cliff, Monet's brushwork loosening the Mediterranean light into pure color.
works.title: La Corniche near Monaco

works.caption: A glinting silver ewer and a golden-crusted pie anchor a lavish spread, every reflection and crumb rendered with jeweler's precision.
works.title: Still Life with Turkey Pie

works.caption: A single bundled sheaf of white asparagus glows against near-total darkness, Coorte reducing still life to one object and one beam of light.
works.title: Still Life with Asparagus

works.caption: A writhing tangle of muscular soldiers and slaughtered infants spirals across the foreground, Cornelisz. pushing Mannerist anatomy to violent extremes.
works.title: The Massacre of the Innocents

works.caption: Adam and Eve stand rigid among an implausible menagerie of monkeys, cats and owls, their elongated, marble-smooth bodies typical of Haarlem Mannerism.
works.title: The Fall of Man

works.caption: Dozens of tiny figures swarm a panoramic hillside execution, the crucified Christ dwarfed by the sheer crowded busyness of the crowd and landscape around him.
works.title: Calvary

works.caption: Geertgen crowds an intricate ruined stable with kneeling kings and a procession winding through a fantastical rocky landscape beyond.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Loose, almost impatient brushwork builds a black coat and red-lined collar around a face caught mid-thought, Goya's late portrait style at its most economical.
works.title: Portrait of Don Ramón Satué

works.caption: Loose, flickering brushstrokes build a starched lace collar and a knowing half-smile, Hals capturing motion in what should be a static pose.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: A married couple lounges informally on a garden terrace, their relaxed intimacy and confident half-smiles breaking sharply from the era's stiff portrait conventions.
works.title: Portrait of a Married Couple, Likely Isaac Abrahamsz Massa and Beatrix van der Laen

works.caption: A flushed, laughing face and raised hand catch a fleeting moment mid-toast, Hals's rapid brushwork making the whole figure seem to shift as you look at it.
works.title: The Merry Drinker

works.caption: Look at the raking light along the pewter jug and gilt standing cup, and the crumpled white cloth that anchors this glittering breakfast display.
works.title: Still Life with a Gilt Cup

works.caption: A pelican's outsized bill anchors a crowded menagerie of exotic waterfowl, each feather and reflection in the pool rendered with naturalist precision.
works.title: A Pelican and other Birds near a Pool, Known as ‘The Floating Feather’

works.caption: The fiddler's gap-toothed grin and raised wine glass, set against a richly patterned oriental carpet, exemplify the Utrecht Caravaggisti at their most direct.
works.title: The Merry Fiddler

works.caption: Sunlit brick and a glimpsed doorway draw the eye past the seated drinkers to the quiet figure emptying a jug at the well beyond.
works.title: Figures in a Courtyard behind a House

works.caption: Watch the pale winter light fall across the checkered floor as the maid hands down a stoneware jug to the small girl reaching up for it.
works.title: Woman with a Child in a Pantry

works.caption: A green curtain drawn back like a stage prop reveals the soaring white piers of the Oude Kerk, where worshippers and a strolling dog animate the vast interior.
works.title: Interior of the Oude Kerk in Delft

works.caption: Candlelight glances off a silver ewer's scrolling handle and a porcelain bowl heaped with citrus, the composition sinking into near-total darkness beyond.
works.title: Still Life with a Silver Jug

works.caption: Revelers dance around the calf in the central panel while smoke rises from Moses's approach on the mountain, the two wings continuing the same rocky, sunlit landscape.
works.title: Worship of the Golden Calf

works.caption: A mother's hand steadies the pale, listless child on her lap, the small clay cup on the stool beside them the only note of ordinary domestic life.
works.title: The Sick Child

works.caption: Against flat black, the young duke's pale face and jeweled chain of office emerge with startling clarity, the brocade sleeve rendered in obsessive, jewel-like detail.
works.title: Portrait of Philip the Fair, Duke of Burgundy

works.caption: A sunlit canal recedes past a procession of gabled merchant houses, the still water doubling every brick and chimney in a masterclass of Dutch architectural perspective.
works.title: The ‘Golden Bend’ in the Herengracht, Amsterdam, Seen from the West

works.caption: A modest glass holds an improbable spring bouquet of narcissus, peony, and forget-me-not, a butterfly and ladybird alighting on petals painted with jeweler's precision.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers in a Glass

works.caption: The elderly preacher rests a steady hand on his chest, Rembrandt building his careful, worn face out of warm impasto against an almost bare, atmospheric ground.
works.title: Johannes Wtenbogaert

works.caption: A churning cascade tumbles over boulders beneath windswept oaks, Ruisdael piling dramatic cumulus clouds into a sky that seems to move faster than the water itself.
works.title: Landscape with waterfall

works.caption: Hands folded and eyes closed, an old woman gives thanks over a humble meal of bread and porridge while a cat's paw creeps toward the fish on her table.
works.title: Old Woman Saying Grace, Known as ‘The Prayer without End’

works.caption: Lit from one side beneath a broad black hat, the physician's weathered face and starched white collar emerge from deep shadow with Rembrandt's characteristic psychological intensity.
works.title: Portrait of Ephraim Bueno

works.caption: A Dutch man-of-war heels violently under a towering black squall while smaller ships founder around it — Bakhuysen's turbulent seas and torn sails convey real peril.
works.title: Warships in a Heavy Storm

works.caption: A family strolls a wooded path past a laden carriage and grazing sheep, van de Velde's naturalistic light and relaxed poses elevating a routine portrait genre.
works.title: Portrait of a Couple with Two Children and a Nurse in a Landscape

works.caption: A gloved hand points toward ships in a harbor below as a heraldic banner billows overhead — van Dyck's confident brushwork and cool palette give the sitter effortless authority.
works.title: Portrait of a Nobleman, possibly Adriaan van der Borcht

works.caption: Poppies, irises, and roses spill from a stone urn in a dazzling arrangement, Mignon's crisp highlights and lurking insects rewarding close inspection.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers and a Watch

works.caption: A dense bouquet of iris, poppy, rose and carnation glows against near-black shadow, each petal and dewy insect picked out with jeweler's precision.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers on a Marble Tabletop

works.caption: Dou paints himself leaning from a shadowed niche with pipe and sketchbook, a trompe-l'oeil green curtain and brass rod pulled aside as if to reveal the scene.
works.title: Self Portrait

works.caption: An elderly woman in a fur-trimmed cloak and fur hat pores over a large illuminated volume, Dou's candlelit realism rendering every wrinkle and printed page.
works.title: Old Woman Reading

works.caption: A silk merchant in a starched millstone ruff turns to meet the viewer's gaze, Fabritius modeling the pale wall behind him with the same tonal subtlety he'd later bring to Delft.
works.title: Portrait of Abraham de Potter, Amsterdam Silk Merchant

works.caption: De Hooch builds a deep perspective through an open door to sunlit rooms beyond while a mother tends her child's hair in the golden foreground light, a cat watching from the tiled floor.
works.title: A Mother Delousing her Child’s Hair, Known as ‘A Mother’s Duty’

works.caption: Split pomegranates spill seeds beside piled grapes, oysters and a gilt ewer, Mignon massing an almost excessive baroque abundance under a dark curtain.
works.title: Still Life with Fruit and Oysters

works.caption: A row of powdered-wig regents lines a grand carpeted dais under a carved proscenium, Troost staging the group portrait like a scene from the theater he loved.
works.title: Regents of the Aalmoezeniersweeshuis Orphanage in Amsterdam, 1729

works.caption: De Hooch opens a deep sequence of rooms from a linen-filled cupboard through to a sunlit canal street, two women folding sheets in the warm middle-ground light.
works.title: Interior with Women beside a Linen Chest

works.caption: Alma-Tadema drenches a lamplit Egyptian death-chamber in flickering candlelight, the grieving mother's slumped weight over her child's body giving the archaeological detail real emotional stakes.
works.title: The Death of the Pharaoh’s Firstborn Son

works.caption: Rembrandt renders Soolmans full-length in shimmering black silk and lace so tactile it seems to catch the studio light, the rakish bow on his shoe a final flourish of bravado.
works.title: Portrait of Marten Soolmans

works.caption: Steen turns St Nicholas's morning into a riot of delighted and devastated children, a shoe stuffed with switches in the foreground the punchline to a scene built entirely from small human reactions.
works.title: The Feast of St Nicholas

works.caption: Oopjen's ivory satin and pearl-trimmed gloves are painted with a jeweler's exactness, the black fan and shadowed gown letting Rembrandt's virtuoso whites carry the whole canvas.
works.title: Portrait of Oopjen Coppit

works.caption: Klimt drapes Flöge in a shimmering mosaic gown of ovals and swirls, her painted face the only naturalistic anchor in a field of decorative pattern.
works.title: Portrait of Emilie Flöge

works.caption: Van Gogh's yellow café awning glows against a star-flecked cobalt sky, the cobblestones rendered in thick, restless strokes that pull the eye down the receding street.
works.title: Café Terrace at Night

works.caption: Pollaiuolo freezes Apollo's grasp and Daphne's transformation mid-motion, her fingertips already sprouting laurel leaves against a luminous, distant landscape.
works.title: Apollo and Daphne

works.caption: Late Titian at his roughest and most powerful, torchlight raking across the mockers' faces while Christ's body seems to dissolve into shadow and impasto.
works.title: The Crowning with Thorns

works.caption: Camille swirls in a red kimono embroidered with a fierce warrior figure, Monet surrounding her with a wall of Japanese fans in a deliberately theatrical Orientalist fantasy.
works.title: Madame Monet wearing a kimono

works.caption: A shoal of nudes with fish-like tails drift through cold green water, Klimt's gold-flecked scales and loose hair turning an odd mythological subject into pure decorative pattern.
works.title: Goldfish

works.caption: Seurat builds a sunlit riverbank almost entirely from tiny dots of pure color, the stiff, silhouetted figures giving the scene a strange, monumental stillness.
works.title: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte

works.caption: A black lace veil pulled half across her face, Roslin's wife peers out with a knowing half-smile, the fan and glove in her hands rendered with astonishing textile precision.
works.title: The Lady with a Fan, The Artist's Wife

works.caption: A dandy expires theatrically on a chaise while mourners in jewel-toned robes attend without alarm, von Dardel's flat, saturated color turning death into stylish tableau.
works.title: The Dying Dandy

works.caption: Gentileschi gives Saint Catherine a palm branch and a direct, unposed gaze, the rose and white drapery painted with a weight and confidence that outshines the modest landscape backdrop.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: Masaccio's crucified Christ hangs against a flat gold ground with startling sculptural weight, the mourners' sharply foreshortened grief unusually raw for its date.
works.title: Crucifixion

works.caption: Gentile da Fabriano crams a bejeweled royal procession, hunting dogs, and gilded halos into a single glittering panel, rewarding endless close-up inspection of costume and pattern.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Filippo Lippi stages the Annunciation inside a luminous marble loggia, with donor portraits crowded into the foreground as unusually direct witnesses to the sacred scene.
works.title: Annunciation with Two Kneeling Donors

works.caption: A landmark of early Renaissance naturalism, with the sinewy, luminous figure of Christ and the celebrated angel long attributed to the young Leonardo.
works.title: The Baptism of Christ

works.caption: One of Klimt's final portraits, the sitter's face floating amid a riot of gilded peacocks and lotus blooms in his most decoratively saturated late style.
works.title: Woman With a Fan

works.caption: Millais paints every reed and blossom with obsessive botanical precision around the drowning Ophelia, her open mouth and floating arms caught between song and death.
works.title: Ophelia

works.caption: Survivors cling to wreckage beneath a towering, sunlit wave, Aivazovsky dissolving water and light into an almost translucent glow of pink and gold.
works.title: The Ninth Wave

works.caption: A fallen angel scowls back at the viewer from beneath folded dark wings while a host of luminous angels departs overhead, Cabanel's academic finish giving the sulk real psychological bite.
works.title: Fallen angel

works.caption: Rembrandt freezes the sacrifice at its most violent instant, the angel's hand still gripping Abraham's wrist as the dropped knife hangs in midair.
works.title: Abraham's Sacrifice

works.caption: Klimt dissolves a lakeside manor into a shimmering mosaic of green dabs, its reflection breaking apart in the still water below.
works.title: Water Castle

works.caption: Velázquez juxtaposes a bored kitchen maid grinding garlic in the foreground with the sacred scene glimpsed through a window behind her, blurring the line between genre painting and theology.
works.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary

works.caption: Painted almost entirely in grisaille, Bruegel's crowd presses in around Christ and the accused woman, the chalked inscription on the ground becoming the picture's quiet moral center.
works.title: Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery

works.caption: Velázquez renders the king's silver-embroidered costume in dazzling, almost abstract flickers of paint that resolve into pattern only at a distance.
works.title: Philip IV in Brown and Silver

works.caption: Seurat's proto-pointillist riverbank scene turns bathers and boats into flattened, geometric silhouettes bathed in hazy summer light.
works.title: Bathers at Asnières

works.caption: Renoir dissolves a bustling riverside bathing spot into flickering strokes of blue and green, the crowded pontoon a study in fashionable Parisian leisure.
works.title: La Grenouillère

works.caption: A faceless firing squad levels its rifles at a man flinging his arms wide in a pose of martyrdom, the lantern's harsh light making his white shirt the painting's unbearable focal point.
works.title: The Third of May 1808

works.caption: Piero della Francesca's cool, geometric clarity gives the Madonna and attendants an almost architectural stillness, the coral necklace on the Christ child the only vivid note of color.
works.title: Madonna di Senigallia

works.caption: Raphael surrounds Saint Cecilia with discarded musical instruments as she gazes upward toward a choir of angels, earthly harmony yielding to the celestial.
works.title: The Ecstasy of Saint Cecilia

works.caption: A late, devotional Botticelli shows Christ bound and crowned with thorns, tiny mourning angels bearing the instruments of the Passion woven into the halo behind him.
works.title: The Man of Sorrows

works.caption: Veronese expands the modest gospel supper into a grand Venetian banquet crowded with children, dogs, and finely dressed onlookers, architecture receding into a sunlit distance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: An early Botticelli allegory, Fortitude sits enthroned in armor and flowing red drapery, her steady gaze and firm grip on her staff embodying resolute strength.
works.title: Fortitude

works.caption: Pontormo's Visitation compresses four women into a tight, luminous cluster of clashing silks, their embrace charged with an almost hallucinatory intensity of color.
works.collection: Rectory of Saints Michael and Francis
works.title: Visitation of Carmignano

works.caption: Rembrandt casts himself as the prodigal son, raising a glass with Saskia on his lap, the tavern scene's warm shadow and self-mocking swagger unmistakably autobiographical.
works.title: Rembrandt and Saskia in the parable of the Prodigal Son

works.caption: Perugino frames Saint Bernard's vision within a serene arcaded loggia opening onto a hazy Umbrian landscape, the architecture as calming as the mystical event itself.
works.title: The Vision of Saint Bernard

works.caption: Caravaggio's Knight of Malta stares out with world-weary directness, the white Maltese cross cutting a stark geometric shape across his black robe.
works.title: Portrait of Fra Antonio Martelli

works.caption: Velázquez isolates the court jester in an undefined gray void, his confident stride and cast shadow the only anchors in an otherwise radically empty composition.
works.title: Portrait of Pablo de Valladolid

works.caption: The Count-Duke of Olivares rears on horseback in gleaming armor, baton raised as if commanding a distant battle glimpsed in the smoky landscape below.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares

works.caption: Monet's poppy field dissolves into loose red dabs beneath a wide, cloud-streaked sky, tiny figures wandering half-hidden among the blooms toward the village beyond.
works.title: Poppy Field near Vétheuil

works.caption: A court jester stares out with unguarded melancholy, his motley pink and black costume rendered with Velázquez's characteristic loose, breathing brushwork against a bare, atmospheric ground.
works.title: The Jester Named Don John of Austria

works.caption: A canopy of blue umbrellas unifies a crowded Parisian street scene, while the girl with the hoop in crisp Impressionist-turning-toward-line style marks Renoir's pivotal stylistic shift caught mid-canvas.
works.title: The Umbrellas

works.caption: Sun-dappled greenery frames a whirling couple, the woman's red bonnet and floral dress catching the light in quick, confident Impressionist strokes.
works.title: Dance in the Country

works.caption: A shaft of unnatural light pierces the gloom as tumbling angels and shepherds converge on the Christ child, El Greco's elongated bodies caught mid-motion in an almost molten palette.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Grief compresses the mourners into a single sculptural knot around Christ's body, the crown of thorns held aloft like an accusation against a bare, cracked stone niche.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ with Saints

works.caption: A soaring Roman triumphal arch, gilded with narrative reliefs, towers over the mob avenging Lucretia below, Botticelli treating architecture as theatrical stage set.
works.title: The Story of Lucretia

works.caption: The sleeping Christ child rests across his mother's lap while a crow perches in a bare tree above, Bellini's luminous Veneto landscape unfolding in patient, silvery detail behind them.
works.title: Madonna del Prato

works.caption: A pyramid of wild strawberries glows against a bare tabletop, Chardin pairing the fruit with a single carnation and a water glass in an exercise of pure optical restraint.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Le Panier de fraises des bois

works.caption: A single raking light picks out Christ's pale torso amid the tormentors' raised staves, Caravaggio compressing the violence into a tight, almost claustrophobic cluster of bodies.
works.title: The Crowning with Thorns

works.caption: The postman's magnificent beard and gold-lettered cap fill the frame against a flat turquoise ground, Van Gogh's thick, directional brushwork turning a friend's portrait into pure pattern and warmth.
works.title: Postman Joseph Roulin

works.caption: An empty rush-seated chair and a smoking pipe stand in for the absent artist, Van Gogh charging a humble corner of his room with the weight of a portrait.
works.title: Van Gogh's Chair

works.caption: Mary and Christ appear as Tahitian women in flat, sonorous fields of red and yellow-green, a heap of tropical fruit doing devotional duty as an altar offering.
works.title: Ia Orana Maria

works.caption: A vast panoramic valley of tiny villages and rivers unfolds beneath a gallows where a magpie perches, Bruegel setting mortality against an expansive, almost aerial world.
works.title: The Magpie on the Gallows

works.caption: The emperor rides alone into a smoldering dawn sky, lance leveled, Titian fusing Renaissance grandeur with a mood of solitary, almost melancholic resolve.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Charles V

works.caption: Christ kneels alone on a rocky outcrop as dawn breaks over a winding valley road where soldiers approach in the distance, Bellini's tender pink-gold light suffusing the whole landscape with foreboding.
works.title: Agony in the Garden

works.caption: Christ's body slumps in an elegant chain of hands and drapery, chubby airborne angels overhead, Bronzino's cool, porcelain-smooth figures turning grief into pure design.
works.collection: Musée des Beaux-Arts et d'Archéologie de Besançon
works.title: Deposition of Christ

works.caption: Mourners crowd into the lower third of a vast, brooding empty wall as gravediggers strain over the saint's small body, Caravaggio using bare space itself as an instrument of desolation.
works.title: The Burial of Saint Lucy

works.caption: Ursula stares down at the arrow in her chest with quiet disbelief, faces crowding out of near-total blackness in Caravaggio's final, thickly worked canvas.
works.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Ursula

works.caption: A ring of convicts trudges in lockstep through a claustrophobic brick courtyard, Van Gogh's sickly green-and-ochre palette turning the prison walls into a vertiginous trap.
works.title: Prisoners Exercising

works.caption: Crimson robes trimmed in ermine bind the Vendramin men together before a family relic, Titian arraying three generations across the canvas with quiet dynastic authority.
works.title: Portrait of the Vendramin Family

works.caption: A forest of upright lances asserts Spanish order at right against the smoking, disorganized background of the defeated Dutch, while the vanquished governor bows before a gracious, restraining victor.
works.title: The Surrender of Brea

works.caption: A court dwarf's small feet dangle above the ground as he grips a playing card, Velázquez granting him the same dignified, unflinching frontal gaze as any nobleman.
works.title: Portrait of Francisco Lezcano

works.caption: Sardanapalus reclines impassive atop a pyre of slaughtered concubines and treasure, Delacroix whipping the whole tumbling composition into a torrent of red, gold, and flesh.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Death of Sardanapalus

works.caption: The young prince sits astride a rearing pony against a vast mountain panorama, Velázquez granting a child's portrait the full pictorial machinery of royal power.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Prince Balthasar Charles

works.caption: Susanna twists away in alarm as two leering elders close in, Rubens building the confrontation from taut, luminous flesh against near-black surrounding foliage.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: Armored horsemen ransack a snowbound Flemish village as villagers plead and scatter, Bruegel disguising biblical atrocity as a scene of contemporary winter violence.
works.title: The Massacre of the Innocents

works.caption: God the Father spreads his arms atop the four apocalyptic beasts in a small blaze of golden cloud, Raphael compressing cosmic vision into a tight, muscular whirl of figures.
works.title: Ezekiel's Vision

works.caption: Poussin's shepherds trace the carved letters on a tomb in an ideal Arcadian light, turning mortality itself into a subject for classical contemplation.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Et in Arcadia ego

works.caption: Leonardo's early Madonna glows with soft sfumato modeling; watch the tender exchange of hands as mother and child study a small flower together.
works.title: Benois Madonna

works.caption: Mantegna surrounds the Madonna with a chorus of cherub heads pressed against golden clouds, their expressions ranging from awe to alarm.
works.title: Madonna of the Cherubim

works.caption: Van Eyck's sitter turns from a painted parapet inscribed 'LEAL SOUVENIR,' his skin rendered with the jeweler's precision the Northern master is famous for.
works.title: Léal Souvenir

works.caption: Goya's late 'Black Painting' strips myth to raw horror: wild eyes, bloodied flesh, and a void of shadow that swallows everything but the act itself.
works.title: Saturn Devouring His Son

works.caption: Hasegawa Tohaku dissolves pine trunks into mist with nothing but ink and blank silk, proof that suggestion can outdo description.
works.title: Pine Trees

works.caption: Monet dissolves the pond's surface into violet and green brushwork, the lilies floating almost weightless above their own painted reflections.
works.title: Nymphéas en fleur

works.caption: Courbet crowds his own studio with a cross-section of French society, the painter himself glowing at the canvas's center beside a nude model and a curious boy.
works.title: The Painter's Studio

works.caption: Wright of Derby turns a scientific demonstration into candlelit drama, each face lit differently to register wonder, fear, or cool detachment as the bird gasps.
works.title: An Experiment on a Bird in the Air Pump

works.caption: Renoir crowds a riverside terrace with friends mid-conversation, sunlight dappling glassware and straw hats in loose, breathing brushwork.
works.title: Luncheon of the Boating Party

works.caption: Rembrandt catches the king mid-turn as fiery Hebrew letters blaze on the wall, gold brocade and startled faces lit from an unseen, otherworldly source.
works.title: Belshazzar's Feast

works.caption: Honthorst's single candle throws every face into sharp chiaroscuro, the accused Christ's calm stillness set against the priest's jabbing finger.
works.title: Christ before the High Priest

works.caption: Van der Weyden's altarpiece unfolds Christ's judgment across ten panels, the saved and damned separated with terrifying clarity along a single golden arc.
works.title: The Last Judgment (Beaune Altarpiece)

works.caption: Vermeer's hushed music room, its perspective and pearly light rendered with uncanny stillness, remains famous today largely for having vanished in the 1990 Gardner heist.
works.title: The Concert

works.caption: Rembrandt's sitter leans on a painted stone ledge as if peering from an actual window, the trompe-l'oeil frame heightening the portrait's startling presence.
works.title: Girl in a Picture Frame

works.caption: Durer crowds pope, emperor, and townsfolk beneath a rose-garlanded Madonna, his own steady gaze meeting the viewer's from the crowd's edge.
works.title: Feast of the Rosary

works.caption: Van Gogh sets a gabled house glowing under a halo-like moon, its swirling brushwork turning an ordinary evening walk into something otherworldly.
works.title: White House at Night

works.caption: Georges de La Tour's candlelit woman is caught in an unguardedly intimate moment, the single flame carving her form out of near-total darkness.
works.title: Woman Catching Fleas

works.caption: Barocci crowds Christ and the Madonna above a swirling throng of the faithful, his sfumato color anticipating the emotional pitch of the Baroque to come.
works.title: Madonna of the people

works.caption: Murillo's Virgin rises weightless on a crescent moon amid a soft haze of cherubs, blue and white drapery catching golden, ethereal light.
works.title: Immaculate Conception of El Escorial

works.caption: Bilinska-Bohdanowicz paints her sitter with frank, dignified directness, gold jewelry and pale drapery set against a flat ochre ground.
works.title: Black Woman

works.caption: Ribera renders the saint's bound, aged body with unsparing anatomical realism, the crowd's raised torch the only source of light in the gloom.
works.title: Martyrdom of Saint Andrew

works.caption: Memling sets Sebastian's martyrdom against a meticulously detailed panoramic city and river, violence and idyllic landscape sharing the same quiet clarity.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Martyrdom of St Sebastian

works.caption: Candlelight from an open casement picks out lace, brass, and burnished copper across a dim nursery interior, the fijnschilder's obsessive finish turning humble domestic clutter into a jeweled still life.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Young Mother

works.caption: Two seated Tahitian women in flat coral and lavender fields anchor a dreamlike beach, Gauguin's decorative color patches flattening depth into a tapestry of unease.
works.title: Sacred Spring: Sweet Dreams (Nave nave moe)

works.caption: A gaunt returning exile freezes in the doorway as a startled household turns to look, the wallpapered parlor's ordinary light making the moment of recognition almost unbearably intimate.
works.title: They Did Not Expect Him

works.caption: Diagonal slashes of rain rake across a terraced hillside near Auvers, Van Gogh's insistent brushwork turning weather itself into the painting's true subject.
works.title: Rain

works.caption: A miser counts coins by candlelight amid teetering stacks of ledgers and cloth bales, the single flame carving his face and jeweled chain out of a cavern of shadow.
works.title: The Parable of the Rich Fool

works.caption: A pale green horse drinks from a shadowed pool while riders pass behind in dappled sunlight, Gauguin's arbitrary color turning a simple pasture scene into pure decorative harmony.
works.title: The White Horse

works.caption: A gaunt figure in a black cape and top hat stands isolated against a bare wall, Manet's flattened tonal masses and empty bottle at his feet already announcing modern painting.
works.title: The Absinthe Drinker

works.caption: Six blind men lurch and fall in a diagonal chain across a village landscape, Bruegel's unsparing observation of each man's ruined eyes turning proverb into devastating tragedy.
works.title: The Blind Leading the Blind

works.caption: A cardsharp slips an ace from his sash while a maid pours wine and a courtesan signals across the table, La Tour staging deception in glowing, sculptural half-light.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Cheat with the Ace of Diamonds

works.caption: The Virgin, infant Christ, and angel form a pyramid of gesture and gaze amid a grotto of jagged rock, Leonardo's sfumato dissolving every edge into soft, breathing shadow.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Virgin of the Rocks

works.caption: Musicians and dancers crowd a sunlit Moroccan courtyard, Delacroix building the scene from dense, jewel-toned costume against whitewashed walls in one of his great Orientalist set pieces.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Jewish Wedding in Morocco

works.caption: A scowling face assembled entirely from a plucked fowl, fish, and stacks of legal briefs skewers the venality of judges, Arcimboldo's composite portraiture at its most pointed.
works.title: The Jurist

works.caption: A couple locked in an embrace on a stone stairway, the man's face hidden entirely beneath his hat, Hayez condensing an entire era's political and romantic longing into one anonymous kiss.
works.title: The Kiss

works.caption: Courtiers, cherubs, and marble fountains crowd a sun-dappled garden, Rubens weaving real and mythological lovers together in a swirling, autumnal celebration of love.
works.title: The Garden of Love

works.caption: A weathered soldier's face emerges from deep shadow beneath an ornate golden helmet, the armor's tooled relief catching light with a sculptural intensity that has made this image iconic.
works.title: The Man with the Golden Helmet

works.caption: St. Ursula sleeps in an ornate curtained bed as an angel enters her sunlit chamber to announce her martyrdom, Carpaccio filling the Renaissance interior with exquisitely observed furniture and light.
works.title: The Dream of St. Ursula

works.caption: Four cobalt-blue horses huddle in a tight, fractured cluster against fields of orange and yellow, Marc's expressionist color turning animal bodies into a single pulsing, prophetic mass.
works.title: The Tower of Blue Horses

works.caption: A jagged snow-capped Alpine peak rises beyond a foreground of lichen-crusted boulders and wind-bent pines, the eye traveling from mossy rock to icy summit in one sweeping diagonal.
works.title: The Watzmann

works.caption: A teeming crowd of peasants scrambles over each other for free wine, a chaotic pyramid of grasping arms and tumbling bodies rendered with Brueghel's characteristic satirical bite.
works.title: The Wine of Saint Martin's Day

works.caption: A single gnarled oak stands sentinel over a misty pasture of grazing sheep, distant blue mountains dissolving into a vast, quiet sky.
works.title: Solitary Tree

works.caption: Bacchus leaps mid-air from his leopard-drawn chariot toward the startled Ariadne, a whirl of pink drapery and revelers set against a brilliant cobalt sky and sea.
works.title: Bacchus and Ariadne

works.caption: A grinning reveler in a lace-collared costume is flanked by raucous carnival companions, Hals's slashing brushwork capturing the flushed, drunken energy of the crowd.
works.title: Merrymakers at Shrovetide

works.caption: A snow-blanketed Flemish village swallows the biblical procession into its everyday bustle, falling snow rendered as flecks of white scattered across every rooftop and figure.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi in a Winter Landscape

works.caption: Samson thrashes in agony as a soldier gouges his eye, Delilah fleeing with the shorn hair still in her grip, the violence erupting from near-total darkness into a shaft of light.
works.title: The Blinding of Samson

works.caption: A veiled lady meets the viewer's gaze with cool composure, her white gloves and lace cuffs the only bright notes against Velázquez's masterfully controlled dark palette.
works.title: The Lady with a Fan

works.caption: Sailboats at rest mirror in still river water beneath a railway bridge's arches, Monet dissolving reflections and foliage into shimmering, broken strokes of light.
works.title: The Railway Bridge at Argenteuil

works.caption: Three women recline amid jewel-toned textiles in a lamplit harem interior, Delacroix building an intoxicating harmony of pattern, ornament, and languid pose.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Women of Algiers

works.caption: Venus drifts on the swell, her loosened hair pooling into the waves as a flurry of tumbling cherubs fills the sky, academic polish pushed to its most sensuous extreme.
works.title: The Birth of Venus

works.caption: A serene architectural interior of receding Renaissance columns frames the distant flagellation, while three enigmatic bystanders dominate the foreground in mathematically precise perspective.
works.title: Flagellation of Christ

works.caption: Two richly dressed envoys flank a table crowded with scientific instruments, an anamorphic skull stretched across the marble floor beneath them like a warning.
works.title: The Ambassadors

works.caption: Christ's slack body is lowered onto the stone slab under raking light, mourners' raised arms and Caravaggio's engulfing darkness turning grief into stark theater.
works.title: The Entombment of Christ

works.caption: Christ's body is borne upright between mourners, its sculptural musculature and the unfinished blank patch at lower right laying bare Michelangelo's underlying anatomical study.
works.title: The Entombment

works.caption: Harvesters bearing baskets of vegetables descend a rutted road past a rocky outcrop, Brueghel's panoramic countryside receding through village, hills, and hazy river valley.
works.title: The Hay Harvest (early summer June/July)

works.caption: Blindfolded and guided by hand to the block, Jane Grey's radiant white gown and pale skin glow against the executioner's straw and Delaroche's theatrical gloom.
works.title: The Execution of Lady Jane Grey

works.caption: Two children charge forward past a towering sunflower and a baby in a toy cart, Runge's crisp German Romantic detail giving ordinary play an almost emblematic intensity.
works.title: The Hülsenbeck children

works.caption: A Gothic village church twists upward under a swirling deep-blue sky, van Gogh's thick impasto strokes turning stone and cloud alike into pure rhythmic motion.
works.title: The Church at Auvers

works.caption: Dr. Gross pauses mid-surgery, bloodied scalpel in hand, before an amphitheater of students, Eakins staging clinical realism with an almost Rembrandt-like fall of light.
works.title: The Gross Clinic

works.caption: Silhouetted figures and beached ships face a glowing amber sunset over a still sea, Friedrich turning a simple shoreline gathering into a meditation on life's passage.
works.title: Life stages

works.caption: A nude figure balances an urn on her shoulder as water streams down beside her, the pose distilled to a single graceful, sculptural contrapposto curve.
works.title: The Source

works.caption: A lone fisherman hauls a halibut through heaving swells, straining to spot his distant schooner through advancing fog, Homer's dark palette conveying real maritime peril.
works.title: The Fog Warning

works.caption: A lacemaker bends in total absorption over her threads, Vermeer's tight, jewel-like focus and softly blurred foreground turning quiet handwork into a study of concentration itself.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lacemaker

works.caption: A striking woman in a plumed hat and fur-trimmed coat regards the viewer with cool, enigmatic self-assurance from an open carriage against a wintry Petersburg skyline.
works.title: Portrait of an Unknown Woman

works.caption: An allegorical procession of Envy, Deceit, and naked Truth unfolds beneath a vaulted gilt-relief hall, Botticelli's architectural perspective as dazzling as its moral drama.
works.title: Calumny of Apelles

works.caption: A winged angel kneels among wildflowers before the Virgin at a carved marble lectern, Leonardo's hazy blue mountains dissolving behind a screen of dark cypress trees.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: A burning city and swarming demons besiege the kneeling saint at the triptych's center, Bosch packing every inch with fantastical, nightmarish invention.
works.title: Temptation of Saint Anthony

works.caption: A lion sniffs at a sleeping gypsy under a full moon, Rousseau's flat, dreamlike desert and stripe-patterned robe creating an eerie, storybook stillness.
works.title: The Sleeping Gypsy

works.caption: A music teacher leans over his pupil's shoulder as she pauses mid-lesson to meet the viewer's eye, Vermeer's dim, silvery light picking out the sheet music and jug.
works.title: Girl Interrupted at her Music

works.caption: Delaroche strips away David's heroic pageantry to show Napoleon exhausted on a mule, wrapped in a plain grey coat against the snow.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bonaparte Crossing the Alps

works.caption: David compresses the entire coronation into one gesture — Napoleon crowning Josephine — while a frieze of silk, gold braid, and courtly witnesses fills the canvas.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Coronation of Napoleon

works.caption: A peasant caught mid-bite, spoon halfway to his mouth, glares out from a still life of bread, onions, and wine rendered with startling directness for 1580.
works.title: The Bean Eater

works.caption: Krøyer's Skagen crowd gathers at night around a soaring bonfire, the flame's orange glow set against a deep blue midsummer sky and a pale moon.
works.title: Midsummer Eve Bonfire on Skagen Beach

works.caption: Andrea del Sarto's Madonna stands on a sculpted pedestal ringed by harpies, her sfumato drapery in blue and gold flanked by saints in a dark, spare setting.
works.title: Madonna of the Harpies

works.caption: Veronese splits the canvas between a celestial tribunal above and the chaos of galleys and cannon smoke at Lepanto below.
works.title: Allegory of the Battle of Lepanto

works.caption: A gladiator stands over his fallen opponent awaiting the crowd's verdict; Gérôme's polished academic realism turns the arena's turned thumbs into pure suspense.
works.title: Pollice Verso

works.caption: Titian's sitter turns to meet the viewer's eye over his shoulder, the quilted blue satin sleeve painted with a tactile richness that anchors the whole portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Gerolamo (?) Barbarigo

works.caption: Degas seats his absinthe drinker at an angle, boxed in by empty tabletops, her blank stare capturing Parisian café isolation better than any narrative could.
works.title: L'Absinthe

works.caption: Velázquez pins the Pope's suspicious, calculating gaze against blazing cardinal red, a portrait so unsparing the sitter reportedly called it 'troppo vero.'
works.title: Portrait of Innocent X

works.caption: Durand places two tiny figures on a rock ledge above Kaaterskill Falls, dwarfed by luminous, layered mountains that define the Hudson River School's grandeur.
works.collection: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
works.title: Kindred Spirits

works.caption: The risen Christ glows with an inner light at the supper table, Rembrandt using deep shadow and a single haloed face to stage the moment of recognition.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Pilgrims of Emmaus

works.caption: The sfumato smile and the hazy, imaginary landscape behind her have made this the most scrutinized face in Western painting.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Mona Lisa

works.caption: Europa is swept out to sea on the bull's back as her companions cry out from the shore; Rembrandt's gilded, gnarled carriage anchors the fantastical scene in solid Dutch detail.
works.title: The Abduction of Europa

works.caption: Klimt's unfinished last portrait sets a young woman's pale face against a searing red ground and an unresolved swirl of floral fabric.
works.title: Portrait of Fräulein Lieser

works.caption: A ploughman, a shepherd, and a fisherman go about their work while, almost unnoticed in the corner, Icarus's legs vanish into the sea.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus

works.caption: Mondrian's final, unfinished canvas trades solid black lines for a syncopated grid of colored tape and tiny squares, diamond-tilted like a city seen from above.
works.collection: Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands Art Collection
works.title: Victory Boogie Woogie

works.caption: Three generations of women sit in a church pew absorbed in their prayer books, Leibl's unflinching realism giving each face and fabric equal, patient attention.
works.title: Three Women in Church

works.caption: Gainsborough lets his feathery brushwork dissolve the woodland behind the strolling couple, their silk and lace catching light as their spaniel bounds ahead.
works.title: Mr and Mrs William Hallett ('The Morning Walk')

works.caption: Ingres enthrones Napoleon in flat, hieratic majesty — ermine, gold laurel, and orb rendered with an almost Byzantine frontality that startled his contemporaries.
works.title: Napoleon I on his Imperial Throne

works.caption: Gros catches Bonaparte mid-charge at the bridge, flag and sword raised, windblown hair and smoke conveying revolutionary momentum in a single freeze-frame.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bonaparte at the Pont d'Arcole

works.caption: Bouguereau crowds a swarm of cherubs and tritons around Venus on her shell, her porcelain flesh and cascading hair the calm center of the commotion.
works.title: The Birth of Venus

works.caption: Boucher surrounds the Marquise with the paraphernalia of her salon — books, letters, a lapdog — her teal silk gown rendered in cascading, sculptural folds.
works.title: Portrait of Madame de Pompadour

works.caption: Sargent lets Mrs. Hammersley's red dress and restless, twisting pose electrify an otherwise sober brown interior — bravura brushwork built for movement.
works.title: Mrs. Hugh Hammersley

works.caption: Loose, glowing brushwork models the model's face out of the surrounding gloom, a tronie study of remarkable psychological warmth.
works.title: Head of Christ

works.caption: A woman in white throws herself between armies with her arms spread wide, David's neoclassical bodies frozen mid-motion like marble come alive.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Intervention of the Sabine Women

works.caption: A tender nursing Madonna framed by twin arched windows opening onto distant blue mountains, Leonardo's sfumato softening every edge.
works.title: Madonna Litta

works.caption: The famous pomegranate-brocade gown, rendered thread by thread against a saturated ultramarine ground, upstages even the sitter's impassive gaze.
works.title: Portrait of Eleanor of Toledo and her son Giovanni de' Medici

works.caption: A lone sculler drifts beneath a riverbank tree built entirely from shimmering dots, Seurat's pointillism turning a quiet afternoon into pure optical vibration.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Seine at La Grande Jatte

works.caption: Europa sprawls across the swimming bull in a swirl of pink drapery while archer putti dive from the clouds, Rubens's flesh and fabric in full baroque motion.
works.title: The Rape of Europa

works.caption: A congregation wrapped in striped prayer shawls crowds beneath stone arches, the Torah scroll's silver crown catching the only bright light in the scene.
works.title: Jews Praying in the Synagogue on Yom Kippur

works.caption: A lace-draped figure stands before a riot of Chinese-inspired figures and floral roundels, Klimt's late decorative style pushed to its most encyclopedic.
works.title: Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer

works.caption: Three peasant women bend low over the stubble, gleaning fallen grain while distant harvest wealth piles up behind them, Millet's monumental dignity of labor.
works.title: The Gleaners

works.caption: A single goldfinch chained to its feeding perch against a bare plaster wall, Fabritius's illusionistic trompe-l'oeil intimacy still startling centuries on.
works.title: The Goldfinch

works.caption: Grieving angels in blue swoop beside the cross while mourners in jewel-toned robes kneel below, van der Weyden's triptych panels united by a single rolling landscape.
works.title: Crucifixion Triptych

works.caption: Six archers wind their crossbows around a bound saint on a tree-stump post, a sweeping Arno-valley panorama unfolding in crystalline early-Renaissance detail behind them.
works.title: Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Twelve oxen strain against the yoke as they haul a plough through freshly turned earth, Bonheur's anatomical precision giving the animals as much presence as any portrait sitter.
works.title: Ploughing in the Nivernais

works.caption: A Tahitian woman gazes out beside a white bird and a red-eyed lizard against fields of saturated orange and yellow, Gauguin's flattened Symbolist color at its boldest.
works.title: Vairumati

works.caption: Three tiny figures perch on dark boulders watching distant sails cross a glowing dusk sea, Friedrich dissolving the horizon into pure atmospheric quiet.
works.title: Moonrise over the Sea

works.caption: An incestuous kiss between Venus and Cupid unfolds amid writhing allegorical figures of Folly, Jealousy and Time, Bronzino's icy porcelain flesh at its most unsettling.
works.title: Venus, Cupid, Folly and Time

works.caption: Blossoming branches spread flat and graphic across a cloudless turquoise sky, van Gogh's Japanese-print-inspired composition rendered with tender, exacting brushwork.
works.title: Almond Blossom

works.caption: A plunging angel bearing a scroll cuts diagonally through the darkness above a straw-bedded infant, Caravaggio's tenebrism concentrating every ounce of light on the poorest figures.
works.title: Nativity with Saint Francis and Saint Lawrence

works.caption: A woman's face is built from unmixed strokes of green, orange and violet beneath an enormous plumed hat, Matisse's Fauvist color declaring total independence from local tone.
works.collection: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art
works.title: Woman with a hat

works.caption: A shower of gold coins falls from a storm-dark cloud onto the reclining Danaë while her old nurse scrambles to catch it, Titian's late brushwork loosening into pure paint.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Danaë curls fetal-like within a cascade of golden coins, Klimt's gilded ornament fusing eroticism and abstraction into a single swooning form.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Saul lies stunned on his back beneath the belly of an enormous horse, arms flung open to an unseen light, Caravaggio compressing conversion into pure physical shock.
works.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul

works.caption: A winged messenger leans down from a rock ledge to point at a startled, kneeling Mary, Caravaggio's late tenebrism reduced to two figures and near-total darkness.
works.collection: Museum of Fine Arts of Nancy
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: A woman glimpsed only from behind looks out through an open studio window at a ship's mast, Friedrich turning a plain interior into a study of longing.
works.title: Woman at a Window

works.caption: A woman's parasol and veil billow against a wind-scattered sky of loose blue and white strokes, Monet dissolving figure and cloud into the same breezy weather.
works.title: Woman with a Parasol, facing left

works.caption: A tousled boy grins with unguarded, gap-toothed delight inside a tondo frame, Hals's rapid, loaded brush catching pure momentary joy.
works.title: Laughing boy

works.caption: An old fisherman clutching his catch hesitates as a younger apostle gestures toward the sea, Caravaggio isolating three half-lengths against pure blackness.
works.title: The Calling of Saints Peter and Andrew

works.caption: Gaslights streak long golden reflections down the Rhône beneath a sky thick with swirling stars, van Gogh proving night could be painted as vividly as noon.
works.title: Starry Night Over the Rhone

works.caption: The Holy Family twists in a tight spiral of saturated silk within a tondo, nude youths lounging in the background, Michelangelo's sculptural figures compressed into paint.
works.title: Doni Tondo

works.caption: A ringed hand rests thoughtfully against a chin while jeweled bracelets catch the light, Ingres rendering lace, satin and skin with near-photographic precision.
works.title: Portrait of Delphine Ramel

works.caption: Gnarled vine stumps and wild scrub tumble toward a hazy ruined abbey under a churning sky, van Gogh's thick impasto giving the whole hillside a restless pulse.
works.title: Sunset at Montmajour

works.caption: Laurel-crowned poets gather around a reclining nude muse while cherubs crown a poet overhead, Poussin choreographing a crowd with classical, frieze-like clarity.
works.title: Parnassus

works.caption: A woman in mourning black leans forward with opera glasses raised, tiny figures in distant boxes doubling her own act of watching, Cassatt's brushwork loose and immediate.
works.title: In the Loge

works.caption: A single candle flame throws warm light across Job's gaunt, patient face as his wife looms above him, La Tour's nocturnal chiaroscuro reduced to essentials.
works.collection: Musée départemental d'Art ancien et contemporain
works.title: Job Mocked by his Wife

works.caption: A hurdy-gurdy player squares off against a rival musician mid-brawl while onlookers gawk and grin, La Tour's weathered faces caught in vivid, almost comic tension.
works.title: The Musicians' Brawl

works.caption: A shimmering rowboat scene where Morisot's loose, feathery brushwork dissolves the water into flickers of blue-green light around two fashionably hatted women.
works.title: Summer's Day

works.caption: A riotous baroque bacchanal of tumbling putti and fleshy revelers beneath a garland-draped tree, Rubens's rippling flesh tones and swirling composition rewarding long looking.
works.title: The Feast of Venus

works.caption: Venus drifts ashore on a giant scallop shell, her rippling coppery hair and the wind-god's tangle of drapery turning the whole canvas into a study of flowing line.
works.title: The Birth of Venus

works.caption: A woman fastens a pearl necklace before an unseen mirror, Vermeer's cool northern light pooling on the plaster wall and the fur-trimmed yellow jacket.
works.title: Woman with a Pearl Necklace

works.caption: A society woman in blush pink leans in her theater box, Cassatt building the glow of skin and satin from broad, confident strokes against a gilded backdrop of distant spectators.
works.title: Woman with a Pearl Necklace in a Loge

works.caption: Chancellor Rolin kneels before the Madonna in a jewel-box interior that opens onto a sweeping river landscape, Van Eyck rendering every brocade thread and distant rooftop with equal, uncanny clarity.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madonna of Chancellor Rolin

works.caption: Tilted colored planes hover and collide on a white ground, Malevich's Suprematist geometry generating a weightless sense of drift and velocity.
works.title: Suprematist Composition

works.caption: A young woman in violet peers shyly from an ivy-choked archway, Hughes's Pre-Raphaelite botanical detail and jewel-toned dress rewarding close inspection leaf by leaf.
works.title: April Love

works.caption: A thin red band of galloping cavalry cuts across broad striped bands of earth and sky, Malevich flattening a whole steppe into pure horizontal color.
works.title: Red Cavalry Riding

works.caption: Böcklin paints himself mid-brushstroke as a grinning skeleton saws a single string behind his shoulder, mortality made an unnervingly literal studio companion.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Death Playing the Fiddle

works.caption: A nude woman meets the viewer's gaze amid clothed picnickers in a dappled forest clearing, Manet's flat modeling and blunt confrontation still startling in a supposedly pastoral scene.
works.title: Luncheon on the Grass

works.caption: Light pours from the infant Christ himself, Correggio staging a nocturnal Nativity where shepherds and tumbling angels emerge from deep shadow into that single radiant source.
works.title: Nativity

works.caption: A frankly nude woman reclines on green velvet and lace, Goya's direct gaze and unidealized flesh making this one of the boldest nudes in Spanish painting.
works.title: La maja desnuda

works.caption: Bruegel's colossal spiraling tower dwarfs an entire harbor city, its countless arched galleries and swarming construction crews rewarding endless close inspection.
works.title: The Tower of Babel

works.caption: A stormier, more monumental Babel looms against churning clouds, Bruegel's tower here reading almost as a living rock face bristling with tiny scaffolds.
works.title: The Tower of Babel

works.caption: A half-draped woman turns toward the viewer with a knowing half-smile, the armband inscribed with Raphael's name binding painter and sitter together against deep foliage shadow.
works.title: La fornarina

works.caption: A shaft of golden light and a cascade of tumbling cherubs cuts diagonally through a bustling stable scene, Veronese massing rich brocades and animals around the Madonna with theatrical ease.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Peasants share a meal under a single hanging lamp, Van Gogh's murky greens and knotted, weathered hands giving raw dignity to a life of hard labor.
works.title: The Potato Eaters

works.caption: Fishermen and rigged ships stand silhouetted against a hazy amber dusk, Friedrich dissolving a working harbor into pure atmospheric stillness.
works.title: The Port of Greifswald

works.caption: A fishing boat drifts past a distant naval battle, Manet setting billowing gunsmoke against choppy turquoise water rendered in loose, confident strokes.
works.title: The Battle of the Kearsarge and the Alabama

works.caption: The poet leans forward mid-thought, book open on his knee, Manet's economical dark tones and quick highlights capturing an alert, distracted intelligence.
works.title: Portrait of Stéphane Mallarmé

works.caption: Wally's startling blue eyes lock onto the viewer, Schiele's raw, hatched brushwork turning a simple portrait into a study of nervous, unguarded presence.
works.title: Portrait of Wally

works.caption: Two girls glow amid dusk-lit lilies and paper lanterns, Sargent capturing that fleeting violet half-light between sunset and dark with extraordinary tonal control.
works.title: Carnation, Lily, Lily and Rose

works.caption: A young dandy sprawls confidently in his chair, Ingres's crisp linear precision lavishing equal care on gleaming rings, gilt furniture, and a faint knowing smile.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Philibert Rivière

works.caption: A woman reclines against blue velvet in a swirl of cashmere shawl, Ingres turning fabric and flesh alike into passages of cool, porcelain-smooth line.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madame Rivière

works.caption: The enthroned Madonna and Child rise on a gilded architectural throne flanked by tiers of angels, Cimabue's proto-Renaissance modeling just beginning to break from Byzantine flatness.
works.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Angels and Prophets. ˋSanta Trinità Maestà´

works.caption: Three winged, conical-hatted figures hoist a limp man skyward against pitch darkness, Goya turning a folkloric caprice into genuinely unsettling nocturnal horror.
works.title: Witches' Flight

works.caption: A lone Victorian mansion looms beside empty railroad tracks under flat blue sky, Hopper's stark isolation of light and shadow defining a whole vein of American unease.
works.title: House by the Railroad

works.caption: The young Ingres glances back over his shoulder from the easel, brush in hand, his own confident, unblemished draftsmanship already on full display.
works.title: Self-Portrait Aged 24

works.caption: A woman in a black lace mantilla turns with an easy, half-smiling glance, Goya's confident touch making silk, skin, and shadow feel effortlessly alive.
works.title: Portrait of Doña Isabel de Porcel

works.caption: A winged angel strides forward bearing a slender rod, Zurbarán's crisp white and rose drapery sculpted with almost tangible weight against a stormy sky.
works.title: The Archangel Gabriel

works.caption: Fellow painters gather and talk in Bazille's cluttered Paris studio, canvases stacked floor to ceiling in a vivid document of the young Impressionist circle at work.
works.title: Bazille's Studio

works.caption: A woman in mourning black and lace veil sits against a warm ochre ground, Goya's bandaged white glove and steady gaze giving the portrait quiet gravity.
works.title: Portrait of Doña Antonia Zárate

works.caption: Isabella Stewart Gardner stands in severe black against a glowing gold damask halo, Sargent turning a society portrait into something close to an icon.
works.title: Portrait of Isabella Stewart Gardner

works.caption: A solemn girl in gray and white sits before a blossoming backdrop, small red flowers clasped in her hands, Renoir's early style still crisp and porcelain-smooth.
works.title: Romaine Lacaux

works.caption: Klee turns a hillside into rippling bands of orange, blue, and pastel green, the picture plane bending like a folded map of terraced fields.
works.title: Highway and Byways

works.caption: The tender press of cheek to cheek and the Child's grasping hand are rendered with van der Weyden's characteristic linear precision against a jet-black ground.
works.title: Virgin and Child

works.caption: Ingres stages a royal vow as celestial theater, the kneeling king's gesture answered by a golden-lit Madonna and Child borne on billowing cloud and drapery.
works.title: The Vow of Louis XIII

works.caption: A confident sitter in a vivid red shawl fills an oval frame, Ingres's crisp modeling of flesh set against a hazy blue sky backdrop.
works.title: La Belle Zélie

works.caption: Bouts sets the grief of Christ's mourners against a jewel-clear panoramic landscape, the crossbar's stark geometry cutting through a luminous sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lamentation over the dead Christ

works.caption: A sidelong glance and faint smirk emerge from near-total blackness, Antonello's Flemish-honed modeling giving the sitter startling physical presence.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of a Man, called condottiere

works.caption: Zurbarán renders a saint's cascading robes of gold, blue, and burnt orange with sculptural weight, her calm gaze anchoring the tumbling fabric.
works.title: Saint Elizabeth of Portugal

works.caption: A lone woman, seen from behind, opens her arms to a molten orange sky over Friedrich's rolling, mist-softened hills — Romantic contemplation distilled.
works.title: Woman in Front of the Setting Sun

works.caption: A single asparagus stalk lies across a pale ledge, Manet's loose, confident brushwork turning a throwaway vegetable into a still-life tour de force.
works.title: L'Asperge

works.caption: Titian's Magdalene turns her tear-streaked face upward, her golden hair falling like drapery across bare shoulders against a stormy sky.
works.title: Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: Veronese pairs an imposing fur-trimmed nobleman with his small son, the boy's affectionate grip on his father's hand humanizing the formal state portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Iseppo da Porto and his son Adriano

works.caption: Rubens sends the armored Duke forward on a rearing white steed beneath dark storm clouds, a distant cavalry battle glowing at the horizon.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of the Duke of Lerma

works.caption: Veronese fills the canvas with musicians, saints, and tumbling putti in silk and brocade, the mystic marriage staged like a sumptuous Venetian pageant.
works.title: The Mystic Marriage of St. Catherine

works.caption: Fouquet arranges mourners in taut, sculptural stillness around Christ's body, Latin verses inscribed on the original painted border framing the grief below.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: Turner dissolves ship and sea into a whirling vortex of white spray and dark cloud, a single mast the only fixed point in the annihilating storm.
works.title: Snow Storm: Steam-Boat off a Harbour's Mouth

works.caption: Cranach's Madonna sits beneath a fruit-laden apple tree, her cascading golden braids echoing the branches as the plump Child grips an apple of his own.
works.title: Madonna and Child under the Apple Tree

works.caption: Cimabue's monumental Madonna rises in gold-ground splendor, stacked ranks of angels pressing close within the panel's pointed Gothic architecture.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Madonna and Child in Majesty Surrounded by Angels

works.caption: Botticelli arranges the Madonna and adoring angels within a tondo of rose vines and pale sky, the Christ Child's reaching gesture the picture's animating spark.
works.title: Madonna Adoring the Child with Five Angels

works.caption: Van der Weyden nests a nursing Madonna within an elaborate carved Gothic niche crowded with tiny narrative reliefs, stonework rendered with trompe-l'oeil precision.
works.title: Virgin and Child Enthroned

works.caption: A landowning couple pose stiffly beneath an oak, their sprawling wheat fields and pastureland stretching out under a vast, cloud-piled English sky.
works.title: Mr and Mrs Andrews

works.caption: Sargent's Lady Macbeth raises a jeweled crown overhead, her iridescent green gown and braided copper hair blazing against near-black shadow.
works.title: Ellen Terry as Lady Macbeth

works.caption: A dozen dark-suited artists and writers cluster solemnly around a framed portrait of Delacroix, Fantin-Latour's group homage rendered in somber, precise realism.
works.title: Homage to Delacroix

works.caption: Gauguin flattens two Tahitian women into bold, unmodulated fields of ochre and rose, the abstracted river behind them as much pattern as landscape.
works.title: Aha Oe Feii?

works.caption: An enigmatic, jewel-toned gathering on a marble terrace whose meaning still eludes scholars; Bellini's crystalline light and obsessive detail reward endless looking.
works.title: Holy Allegory

works.caption: A ruler's face conjured entirely from fruit, vegetables and grain, Arcimboldo's wit and horticultural precision turning flattery into surreal spectacle.
works.title: Rudolf II as Vertumnus

works.caption: The sitter's confident half-smile plays against the cool marble relief beside her, Titian contrasting living flesh with sculpted stone in one of his great portrait inventions.
works.title: La Schiavona

works.caption: Candlelight glows within the tondo as the Christ child twists to grasp his mother's shoulder, Raphael's warm palette and circular format drawing the eye inward.
works.title: Madonna of the Candelabra

works.caption: Klee builds a glowing sun and archway from thousands of individual mosaic-like dabs, a pointillist meditation that hums with quiet radiance.
works.title: Ad Parnassum

works.caption: Rapt young faces crowd around a glowing orrery, Wright's single candle-source throwing dramatic light across the circle of Enlightenment wonder.
works.title: A Journalist Lecturing on the Orrery

works.caption: A kneeling alchemist gazes in awe at his glowing flask, Wright plunging the vaulted laboratory into near-total darkness but for that one phosphorescent glow.
works.title: The Alchemist Discovering Phosphorus

works.caption: Tarquin's dagger hangs above the recoiling Lucretia, Titian's late, slashing brushwork turning violence into a whirl of red velvet and pale flesh.
works.title: Tarquin and Lucretia

works.caption: A grieving angel props up the dead Christ against a luminous Netherlandish-inflected landscape, Antonello fusing Italian anatomy with northern atmospheric light.
works.title: The Dead Christ Supported by an Angel

works.caption: A cyclist's straining body fractures into interlocking arcs of blue, gold and green, Boccioni translating motion itself into paint.
works.title: Dynamism of a Cyclist

works.caption: Christ's bound, welted body strains against the column in flat gold light, Cimabue's Byzantine severity charged with unusual physical anguish.
works.title: The Flagellation of Christ

works.caption: The Magdalene's upturned face catches a stray shaft of light against a stormy sky, El Greco pairing lush golden hair with the memento mori of skull and flask.
works.title: The Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: Thick, urgent strokes of cobalt sky press down on a field of gold, van Gogh's final wheatfields charged with turbulent, wordless intensity.
works.title: Wheatfield under Thunderclouds

works.caption: Three cowled skeletons tend a walled garden of frail seedlings, Simberg's flat, folk-art palette making mortality feel oddly tender.
works.title: The Garden of Death

works.caption: A striped-skirted sitter's dark eyes meet the viewer through a screen of dappled green, Renoir's foliage dissolving into flickers of light.
works.title: In the Summer

works.caption: Titus leans on his folded hands, quill poised over a stack of papers, Rembrandt catching the boy's unguarded, half-distracted stare.
works.title: Titus at his desk

works.caption: A dove and a burst of black-feathered wings crash into the scene from above, El Greco charging the Annunciation with startling physical drama.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: A shawled sitter's cool, appraising gaze anchors Ingres's crisp linear precision, the fan and jewelry rendered with glassy, almost photographic finish.
works.title: Portrait of Madame Devaucay

works.caption: Rembrandt bathes an aged Jacob's blessing gesture in warm light against near-total darkness, the surrounding family caught between tenderness and quiet apprehension.
works.title: Jacob Blessing the Sons of Joseph

works.caption: A couple dissolves into an embrace of red hair and shadow, Munch's smeared brushwork making tenderness and menace indistinguishable.
works.title: Vampire

works.caption: An unfinished Madonna reveals Michelangelo's process directly, fully modeled flesh beside a ghostly underdrawing of angels that was never painted in.
works.title: Manchester Madonna

works.caption: Susanna twists away in alarm as the elders close in from the shadows, Rembrandt building the scene from deep, glowing darkness around her pale, startled body.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: A ghostly, hollow-eyed man looms in the foreground while a couple embraces beneath a rose arbor behind him, Munch fusing portrait and symbolic vision in one canvas.
works.title: Jealousy

works.caption: An eagle tears into chained Prometheus's straining torso, Rubens rendering muscle and feather with equally ferocious physicality.
works.title: Prometheus Bound

works.caption: Damned souls huddle by a burning lake as a demon and grotesque creatures close in, Bosch conjuring hell from little more than firelight and silhouette.
works.title: Visions of the Hereafter: Hell

works.caption: Christ's slack body is lowered by lamplight from a towering cross, Rembrandt's small figures and vast darkness making the moment feel almost unbearably private.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: A high, oblique view turns a bustling Paris boulevard into rivers of carriages and pedestrians beneath rolling spring clouds, Pissarro's broken brushwork capturing pure atmospheric bustle.
works.title: Boulevard Montmartre, Spring

works.caption: Three scenes from John the Baptist's life unfold within painted Gothic archways, van der Weyden's crisp drapery and clear northern light uniting birth, baptism, and beheading in one sculptural frame.
works.title: The Altar of St. John

works.caption: A grinning skeleton in cross-patterned robes looms beside a tangled mass of embracing bodies, Klimt's mosaic-like color turning mortality into pure ornament.
works.title: Death and Life

works.caption: A scholar's face and body are built entirely from stacked books and a feather duster beard, Arcimboldo's visual pun holding up as both joke and genuine likeness.
works.title: The Librarian

works.caption: Storm clouds boil over a sunlit alpine valley, Bierstadt staging light and darkness in vast, theatrical opposition across the Rockies.
works.title: A Storm in the Rocky Mountains, Mt. Rosalie

works.caption: Golden spirals sprawl across the wall in Klimt's mural design, a black bird perched at the tree's heart amid jeweled eyes and blossoms.
works.title: The Tree of Life

works.caption: The Virgin presses her cheek to Christ's dead face as a skull rests at their feet, van der Weyden setting raw grief against a luminous, radiant sunset.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: A fur-coated opera star strides through a snowy winter fair, Kustodiev packing the background with tiny stalls, sledges, and revelers in candy-bright color.
works.title: Portrait of Chaliapin

works.caption: Juno transfers Argus's hundred eyes to a peacock's tail while his slain body sprawls in the foreground, Rubens massing iridescent feathers against pale, heavy flesh.
works.title: Juno and Argus

works.caption: Ingres doubles his sitter in mirror reflection, her raised hand and appraising gaze anchoring one of the most admired portraits of the nineteenth century. The cool blue-grey palette and satin gown are painted with porcelain smoothness.
works.title: Comtesse d'Haussonville

works.caption: The Madonna and Child are enthroned on a high pedestal between a soldier-saint and a Franciscan friar, a serene Veneto landscape opening behind them. Giorgione's soft sfumato and glowing color established a new lyricism in Venetian painting.
works.title: Castelfranco Madonna

works.caption: A screaming nude figure claws her way out of a well, broom in hand, disturbing the ivy-choked garden around her. Gérôme's Truth turns an academic nude into an unsettling allegory of unwelcome disclosure.
works.title: Truth Coming Out of Her Well

works.caption: A shaft of light falls on the aged Simeon cradling the infant Christ before a crowd receding into cavernous shadow. Rembrandt's chiaroscuro turns a modest interior into a space of overwhelming scale and mystery.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Simeon's song of praise

works.caption: Christ's pale body stretches diagonally across the composition, mourners arranged like a frieze on either side against a luminous, detailed landscape. Van der Weyden's controlled grief and jewel-like color make this an anchor of early Netherlandish painting.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: A boisterous, multigenerational household drinks, smokes, and sings around a cluttered table while a dog begs beneath. Jan Steen turns domestic disorder into a moralizing comedy, rendered with warm, lived-in detail.
works.title: 'As the Old Sing, So Pipe the Young'

works.caption: A smiling woman in a feathered turban saws energetically at a violin, her open mouth and flushed cheeks capturing the exuberance of Utrecht Caravaggism. Honthorst's raking light picks out every fold of yellow satin.
works.title: The Violin Player

works.artist: Willem van de Velde the Younger
works.artistSort: Younger, Willem van de Velde the
works.caption: A Dutch man-of-war fires a salute, its smoke billowing across a glassy sea as small boats row past. Van de Velde's crisp rigging and luminous atmosphere make him the defining marine painter of the Golden Age.
works.title: The Cannon Shot

works.caption: A young man in a broad-brimmed hat turns to meet the viewer's eye against a bare, warm-toned ground. Rembrandt's confident economy of brushwork—so coveted it made this small panel one of the most frequently stolen paintings in history—concentrates entirely on the sitter's alert expression.
works.title: Portrait of Jacob de Gheyn III

works.caption: A laundress pauses at her work, leaning toward a window with weary, unguarded absorption. Toulouse-Lautrec strips away sentimentality, using loose, economical brushwork to dignify an overlooked working life.
works.title: La Blanchisseuse

works.caption: Two young men crouch over sparring roosters while a bare-shouldered woman looks on with detached amusement, a sphinx and Mediterranean coastline behind them. Gérôme's cool, sculptural nudes and archaeological staging made this an early scandal and success at the Salon.
works.title: Young Greeks Attending a Cock Fight

works.caption: A chalk cliff and its famous rock arch rise above a beach where fishing boats lie beached at low tide. Courbet renders the geology with the same weighty, tactile realism he brought to figures.
works.title: The Cliff at Étretat after a Storm

works.caption: Fortune, draped in silver, turns a great wheel that carries a king, a slave, and a poet through rise and fall. Burne-Jones's sculptural, almost monochrome figures give the medieval allegory a haunting, timeless gravity.
works.title: The Wheel of Fortune

works.caption: A dandy in a soft brown suit leans back with theatrical languor, cane and top hat in hand. Boldini's slashing, virtuosic brushwork captures the restless energy of Belle Époque high society.
works.title: Portrait of Robert de Montesquiou

works.caption: Degas builds the twisting back and shoulders from raked strokes of pastel, the toweling dissolving into pure color at the edges.
works.title: After the Bath, Woman Drying Herself

works.caption: Mantegna's sculptural draperies and hard, sunlit contours give the sacred group an almost stone-carved presence against a fruit-laden hedge.
works.title: The Virgin and Child with the Magdalen and Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: A vast neoclassical dream-city unspools beyond a draped loggia, Cole piling colonnade upon colonnade into hazy, golden distance.
works.title: The Architect's Dream

works.caption: Gold mosaic and coffered stone frame the enthroned Madonna, a music-making angel at the altar step tying the whole sacra conversazione together.
works.title: Madonna and Child enthroned with Saints and Angels

works.caption: Eleven bargemen lean into their straps across a blazing stretch of sand, each hunched figure a distinct study of exhaustion and endurance.
works.title: Barge Haulers on the Volga

works.caption: Carved from crystalline light against flat blue, the Doge's damasked robe and shrewd three-quarter gaze make this one of the sharpest state portraits of the Renaissance.
works.title: Portrait of Doge Leonardo Loredan

works.caption: A red cap and cascading auburn curls frame a steady, direct gaze, the boy's face modeled with Botticelli's characteristic cool clarity against pure black.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man

works.caption: Saints and kneeling angels array themselves symmetrically around the enthroned Virgin, the red and blue draperies snapping with Botticelli's linear energy.
works.title: Sant'Ambrogio Altarpiece

works.caption: The Madonna's deep ultramarine mantle billows against a luminous, cloud-streaked landscape, the Christ child modeled with unusual physical weight.
works.title: Contarini Madonna

works.caption: The comic lover Mezzetin serenades an unseen listener, his striped costume and flushed face set against a shadowy garden with a wistful statue.
works.title: Mezzetin

works.caption: Breton women in stiff white coifs kneel before a blazing vermilion field where Jacob wrestles the angel, Gauguin flattening space into pure symbolic color.
works.title: Vision After the Sermon

works.caption: Christ descends in a swirl of red drapery to appoint the plague saint, while below a heap of writhing, half-clothed bodies conveys the epidemic's horror.
works.title: Christ Appointing Saint Roch as Patron Saint of Plague Victims

works.caption: A sagging, sunlit Silenus sprawls amid leering satyrs, Ribera's unflinching flesh-painting turning drunken excess into something almost tragic.
works.title: Drunken Silenus
