works.caption: Three shirtless laborers scrape a Parisian floor in raking window light, Caillebotte turning curling wood shavings into a study of perspective and sweat.
works.title: Les raboteurs de parquet

works.caption: A shark lunges at a naked swimmer as sailors lunge back with harpoon and outstretched hands, Copley building unbearable tension across the crowded gunwale.
works.title: Watson and the Shark

works.caption: An ostrich egg hangs from the coffered apse above the sleeping Christ child, Piero's rigorous perspective ordering saints and courtiers with crystalline calm.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Saints, Angels and Federico da Montefeltro (San Bernardino Altarpiece)

works.caption: Europa sprawls helplessly across the bull's back as cupids swoop overhead, Titian's late brushwork dissolving flesh and drapery into churning motion.
works.title: The Rape of Europa

works.caption: A reclining odalisque commands a jewel-toned harem interior, Ingres balancing her cool ivory flesh against a lutenist's saturated silks.
works.title: Odalisque à l'esclave

works.caption: The Holy Family is dwarfed by a sweeping panorama of jagged crags and a shimmering river delta, Bruegel's world-landscape unfolding for miles.
works.title: Landscape with the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: The aged pope hunches beneath a swag of crimson curtain, flanked by grandsons whose sidelong glances turn a state portrait into a study of courtly intrigue.
works.title: Pope Paul III and His Grandsons

works.caption: Two women in white stroll arm in arm along an endless pale shore, Krøyer capturing the eerie blue luminosity of a Skagen summer night.
works.title: Summer Evening on Skagen's Southern Beach

works.caption: A kitchen maid leans on a windowsill out of deep shadow, Rembrandt catching an unguarded, faintly weary half-smile with warm, thick paint.
works.title: The Kitchen Maid

works.caption: A knife-grinder's whirling motion is shattered into overlapping metallic facets, Malevich fusing Cubist fracture with Futurist speed.
works.title: The Knife Grinder

works.caption: Gilt-robed saints present a kneeling king to the Virgin, an entire flight of blue-winged angels crowding the gold ground on the right panel.
works.title: Wilton Diptych

works.caption: A husband and wife face the light with quiet composure, Rembrandt setting stiff white ruffs and one bright red chair-cushion against near-total darkness.
works.title: A Lady and Gentleman in Black

works.caption: A dramatic wide-brimmed hat and cascading curls frame a knowing half-smile, Gainsborough's feathery brushwork at its most virtuosic.
works.title: Portrait of Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire

works.caption: A distorted perspective box unfolds a sunlit view of church and canal past a musical-instrument seller, Fabritius playing with vision itself.
works.title: A View of Delft

works.caption: Cleopatra dissolves a pearl in vinegar before an astonished Antony, the whole scene staged beneath soaring Veronese-style colonnades rendered in luminous Rococo color.
works.title: The Banquet of Cleopatra

works.caption: Ashen, mask-like faces crowd a fjord promenade beneath a blood-orange sky, the same swirling horizon Munch would reuse for The Scream.
works.title: Anxiety

works.caption: A drowsy soldier polishes his gun beneath a crumbling classical arch, the deep architectural recession staging an unexpectedly intimate genre scene.
works.title: The Sentry

works.caption: A jagged black silhouette juts into a shimmering blue nocturne, stars and a pale moon reduced to smears of paint that anticipate The Scream's turbulence.
works.title: Starry Night

works.caption: Steel gorget and fur cap catch the light against a loosely brushed sky, the sitter's calm gaze anchoring one of Rembrandt's most gifted pupils' rare surviving works.
works.title: Young Man in a Fur Cap

works.caption: Christ's elongated neck and upturned eyes strain against a black void, the crown of thorns and raw wooden beam rendered with mystic intensity.
works.title: Christ with the Cross

works.caption: A single loose lavender sash does most of the work, framing the sitter's frank, faintly amused stare against a shimmering silk backdrop.
works.title: Lady Agnew of Lochnaw

works.caption: The viewer is set at the very brink of the cataract, mist and rainbow dissolving the horizon into a sublime wall of falling water.
works.title: Niagara Falls, from the American Side

works.caption: A stout bather turns her broad back to the viewer, one hand raised toward a seated companion, Courbet's frank unidealized flesh scandalizing Salon audiences in 1853.
works.title: The Bathers

works.caption: A woman in pale yellow and a russet dog face the sea's last light together, the whole beach dissolving into the blue tonality Krøyer made his signature.
works.title: Summer Evening at Skagen. The Artist's Wife and Dog by the Shore

works.caption: A couple strolls the tideline beneath a rising moon, its reflected light and the ghost of a sailboat the only warmth in an otherwise deep blue dusk.
works.title: Summer Evening at Skagen Beach – The Artist and his Wife

works.caption: Slatted sunlight rakes across a deep cobalt wall onto a girl bent over her sewing, a modest domestic corner turned into a study of pure light.
works.title: Sunlight in the Blue Room

works.caption: A nude boy drapes a python around his shoulders before a seated audience of tribesmen, the calligraphic Iznik tilework behind them rendered with photographic precision.
works.title: The Snake Charmer

works.caption: Christ's body hangs stark white against a wall of blazing vermilion tile, the Virgin and John reduced to austere, sculptural drapery on either side.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Crucifixion of Scheut

works.caption: A young Venetian gentleman rests one bare hand beside its gloved twin, soft sfumato modeling making the black doublet seem to breathe.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Man with a Glove

works.caption: Over a hundred Venetian revelers, musicians, and servants crowd a marble loggia around Christ's first miracle, the vast canvas a catalogue of silks, brocades, and blue skies.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Wedding at Cana

works.caption: A single pearl and a half-turned glance are all that is needed, the girl's parted lips and luminous turban set against pure enveloping darkness.
works.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring

works.caption: Pompadour reclines against a garden sculpture in a torrent of pink and gold lace, her spaniel and open fan completing a portrait of cultivated ease.
works.title: Madame de Pompadour

works.caption: A single candle flame, seen through a glass of water, throws warm light across the Magdalen's face and the skull cradled in her lap, penitence reduced to pure geometric stillness.
works.collection: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
works.title: Magdalen with the Smoking Flame

works.caption: Snow blankets a jumble of Parisian chimney pots and mansard roofs seen from above, an almost abstract geometry found in the ordinary rooftop view.
works.title: Vue de toits

works.caption: Arcimboldo builds a woman's profile entirely from spring blossoms, the flesh replaced by petals so cunningly shaded that a rose becomes a cheek.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Spring

works.caption: Gnarled roots and bark stand in for an old man's wrinkled face, with a single sprig of ivy for hair — Arcimboldo's wit at its darkest and most tactile.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Winter

works.caption: A profile stacked from cherries, artichokes, and sheaves of wheat, Arcimboldo's summer harvest turns still-life abundance into an uncanny human likeness.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Summer

works.caption: Turn this vegetable still life upside down and it becomes a grinning peasant's face under a bowl — Arcimboldo's double-image trick at its most playful.
works.title: The Gardener

works.caption: A red-robed Madonna floats inside a golden mandorla thronged with hundreds of tiny musician-angels, Geertgen's obsessive detail rewarding endless close looking.
works.title: The Glorification of the Virgin

works.caption: Two tiny silhouettes watch a golden moon break through cloud over a darkening sea — Friedrich distilling the sublime down to figure, light, and horizon.
works.title: Moonrise over the Sea

works.caption: Manet's model turns her head beneath a wide straw bonnet heaped with flowers, the loose, confident brushwork of foliage and lace announcing late Impressionism at full strength.
works.title: Spring

works.caption: Brueghel crams a princely picture gallery with paintings, busts, and curiosities, each rendered in jewel-like miniature — a cabinet of wonders about the act of collecting itself.
works.title: The Sense of Sight

works.caption: Minerva, laurel-crowned and armored in gold brocade, rests a hand on an open folio — Rembrandt building the goddess from thick, tactile impasto.
works.title: Minerva in Her Study

works.caption: The young Rembrandt stares out from deep shadow, breastplate catching a sliver of light — an early self-portrait already fluent in psychological weight.
works.title: Self-portrait with breastplate

works.caption: Sunlight rakes across an empty room and billowing curtain, the reflection in a tall mirror the only hint of a life just out of frame — Menzel decades ahead of Impressionism.
works.title: The Balcony Room

works.caption: Molten metal glows white-hot at the center of a cavernous foundry, Menzel choreographing dozens of straining workers around the furnace's blaze.
works.title: The Iron Rolling Mill

works.caption: A red silk mantle slips from a youth's shoulders, Bronzino's porcelain-smooth flesh and razor-precise contours turning the figure almost sculptural.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Dürer records his father's every wrinkle and vein with unflinching precision, the rosary beads in his hands a small, human touch against the dark ground.
works.title: Portrait of the artist's father

works.caption: Renoir dissolves a busy Parisian boulevard into flickering dabs of green and grey, carriages and pedestrians barely resolving out of the shimmer.
works.title: The Grands Boulevards

works.caption: A mother in a plumed hat walks between two daughters clutching a doll, Renoir's feathery brushwork softening the group into a single warm, pastel mass.
works.title: Mother and Children

works.caption: A merchant's wife presides over a laden tea table of watermelon and pastries, Kustodiev's saturated color and domed skyline turning genre into folk-art spectacle.
works.title: Merchant wife at tea by B.Kustodiev

works.caption: Troikas race downhill past a snow-blanketed town under a streaked pink-and-green sky, Kustodiev packing the whole panorama with festive, storybook energy.
works.title: Shrovetide

works.caption: A young woman's profile is set like a coin against flat blue sky, Pollaiuolo rendering her brocaded gown in crisp, jewel-hard detail.
works.title: Profile Portrait of a Young Lady

works.caption: Christ and the Samaritan woman converse across a well while apostles peer from a fortress gate, Duccio's gold ground and stylized architecture radiating quiet authority.
works.title: Christ and the Samaritan Woman

works.caption: Perseus swoops down on a winged horse toward a sea-dragon coiled beneath Andromeda's rock, Leighton pitching Victorian myth-painting to full theatrical volume.
works.title: Perseus and Andromeda

works.caption: The newborn Christ radiates the only light in a pitch-dark stable, Honthorst's candlelit faces crowding in with warm, Caravaggesque wonder.
works.title: Adoration of the Child

works.caption: A red squirrel nibbles a nut in the sitter's lap while a starling perches in the branches behind her, the animals rendered with the same crystalline precision as her linen hood. The teal background sets off Holbein's cool, exacting color sense.
works.title: A Lady with a Squirrel and a Starling (Anne Lovell?)

works.caption: The kneeling shepherds and the straw-strewn manger in the central panel show van der Goes's unflinching realism, faces weathered and hands work-worn rather than idealized. Flanking donor portraits and a still life of flowers with symbolic meaning extend the drama across all three panels.
works.title: Portinari Triptych

works.caption: A young suitor vaults a garden wall toward his startled beloved beneath a crumbling statue of Venus and Cupid, the whole scene dissolving into feathery, sun-dappled foliage. Fragonard's loaded brush turns silk, stone, and leaves into a single breathless rustle.
works.title: The Progress of Love: The Meeting

works.caption: A vast panoramic river landscape of jagged rock formations and distant walled towns dwarfs the small baptismal scene in the foreground. Patinir's blue-green atmospheric recession set the template for landscape painting for a century after.
works.title: The Baptism of Christ

works.caption: Sebastian's upturned face and straining torso, pierced by three arrows, twist against a gnarled tree trunk and stormy sky. Rubens gives the martyrdom an athletic, almost erotic physicality rather than pious suffering.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: A flock of sheep grazes precariously along crumbling chalk cliffs above a hazy sea, painted with an almost hallucinatory attention to individual wool and wildflowers. The unguarded animals near the cliff edge carry a quiet allegorical unease beneath the sunlit detail.
works.title: Our English Coasts

works.caption: A dense cluster of triangles, checkerboards, and a radiating target-like disc floats against an almost bare white ground, the black diagonal spine holding the whole composition together. Kandinsky lets empty canvas do as much work as the packed central knot of forms.
works.title: On White II

works.caption: Naked souls climb toward a radiant fountain of light atop a grassy rise, guided by an angel in blazing red, while below them tiny figures embrace among the foliage. Bosch's hallucinatory clarity of detail rewards long, close inspection of every hillside and creature.
works.title: Visions of the Hereafter: Terrestrial Paradise

works.caption: Interlocking bands of yellow, red, and blue tape crisscross the canvas with no black outlines at all, evoking the grid of Manhattan streets seen from above. Painted the year before his death, it shows Mondrian loosening his own strict system.
works.title: New York City

works.caption: The artist looks out from beneath a straw hat heaped with flowers and feathers, palette and brushes in hand, her confident half-smile doubling as a manifesto. Vigée Le Brun's soft cloud-streaked sky and creamy flesh tones show why the self-portrait became her calling card.
works.title: Self Portrait in a Straw Hat

works.caption: Santa Maria della Salute dissolves into a shimmering haze of pink, gold, and turquoise dots, gondolas and mooring poles the only solid anchors in the mist. Signac's Pointillist touch turns the Venetian skyline into pure atmospheric vibration.
works.title: Venice, Grand Canal

works.caption: A woman in white sits absorbed among wave-smoothed boulders at the shoreline, her straw hat resting in her lap as evening light flattens the sea into bands of grey-blue. Munch balances a Whistlerian tonal hush against the coming psychological intensity of his mature work.
works.title: Inger on the Beach

works.caption: Sappho leans on a marble balustrade to listen as Alcaeus plays his lyre, a garland of attendants draped along the sun-warmed stone above a glittering Aegean. Alma-Tadema's obsessive marble textures and languid poses conjure antiquity as pure leisure.
works.title: Sappho and Alcaeus

works.caption: Flora presides over a whirling round dance of mythological lovers and nymphs beneath blossoming trees, cherubs scattering petals from above. Poussin's frieze-like arrangement of bodies turns a garden allegory into a stately, sunlit ballet.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Triumph of Flora

works.caption: A reclining nude twists to glance over her shoulder, her flushed skin set against a tumble of blue satin and a red-trimmed carpet at the bed's edge. Boucher's plush, boneless forms and jewel-box color make the eroticism feel decorative rather than urgent.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Brown Odalisque

works.caption: A woman in a stark white shift grips her own loosened hair while a man collapses in shame behind her, a dense wall of red-black tree trunks sealing off any escape. Munch turns a scene of sexual anguish into one of his most raw and claustrophobic images.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Ashes

works.caption: Smoke curls upward from the cigarette held at chest height, the only crisply lit passage in a face and body otherwise dissolving into shadow. Munch stages his own likeness like an apparition materializing out of darkness.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Self-Portrait with Cigarette

works.caption: The artist stands rigid between a grandfather clock without hands and an unmade bed, flanked by a ghostly painted figure on the wall. Munch's final self-portrait reads as a stark meditation on mortality, time, and the space still left to him.
works.title: Self-Portrait. Between the Clock and the Bed

works.caption: Two lovers merge into a single faceless silhouette against a glowing window, the only light source in an otherwise engulfing darkness. One of Munch's most reproduced images, painted with thick, unresolved brushwork that keeps the embrace ambiguous between tenderness and dissolution.
works.title: The Kiss

works.caption: Rearing white horses and tangled cavalry collapse into a heap of the slain beneath a shaft of divine light where angels rout the Assyrian host. Rubens choreographs the chaos with a diagonal sweep of muscular, foreshortened bodies typical of his most ambitious battle compositions.
works.title: The Defeat of Sennacherib

works.caption: Two angular cocottes in feathered hats and shimmering blue-green coats dominate a jagged, acid-toned Berlin streetscape. Kirchner's nervous, splintered brushwork and lurid palette make this one of the defining images of German Expressionist city life on the eve of war.
works.title: Potsdamer Platz

works.caption: Christ raises two fingers in blessing while cradling a translucent crystal orb, his gaze fixed slightly off-center in the sfumato haze typical of the Leonardo workshop. Whatever the attribution debates, the picture's eerie stillness and the orb's faint internal reflections reward close, sustained looking.
works.title: Salvator Mundi

works.caption: A lone sculler glances back over his shoulder on a glassy river beneath a girdered bridge, autumn trees mirrored in the still water. Eakins renders the crisp light and precise geometry of boats and bridge with an almost scientific clarity that never loses its warmth.
works.title: Max Schmitt in a Single Scull

works.caption: A goldsmith in a dark fur-trimmed robe holds a ring pinched between two fingers, his gaze meeting the viewer's with startling directness. Van Eyck's minute description of stubble, cracked skin, and glinting metal against a pitch-black ground is Northern Renaissance portraiture at its most exacting.
works.title: Portrait of Jan de Leeuw

works.caption: A woman in a white turban and draped robe turns toward the viewer, one breast bared, her steady gaze meeting ours against a bare olive wall. Benoist's spare, sculptural handling of light on skin and cloth gives the sitter a quiet, unforced dignity rare in period portraiture.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Madeleine

works.caption: Peasants stoop through a blazing orange vineyard beneath a huge radiant sun, a canal of reflected yellow light cutting diagonally across the field. Van Gogh's thick, urgent strokes turn a harvest scene into pure color incandescence.
works.title: The Red Vineyard

works.caption: Wheels of cheese, a stoneware jug, a glinting roemer of wine, and coiled pretzels crowd a dark tabletop, each surface catching light differently. Peeters renders the cracked rind and crumbling texture of the cheese with a tactile precision that rivals any of her male contemporaries.
works.title: Still Life with Cheeses, Almonds and Pretzels

works.caption: The artist turns from her easel, brush raised and palette full of loaded pigments, a red velvet ribbon spilling down her chair. Vigée Le Brun's confident half-smile and the visible ghost of the portrait-within-a-portrait announce her mastery with disarming ease.
works.title: Self-portrait of Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun

works.caption: Van Gogh stares out with a heavily bandaged ear beneath a fur cap, a Japanese print of figures by a river glowing on the wall behind him. The flat planes of green coat and mustard wall push the wounded, steady face into raw psychological focus.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear

works.caption: A bandaged, pipe-smoking Van Gogh confronts the viewer against slabs of pure orange and red, curling pipe smoke echoing the bristling brushwork of his fur hat. The scorching complementary palette makes this variant even more confrontational than its Courtauld counterpart.
works.title: Self-Portrait With a Bandaged Ear

works.caption: Towering slabs of pack ice, jagged and stacked like ruined masonry, crush a barely visible ship's hull beneath a pale, indifferent sky. Friedrich's cold geometry of fractured ice turns an Arctic disaster into a meditation on nature's total indifference.
works.title: The Sea of Ice

works.caption: A muscular father hoists his family up a rocky outcrop as floodwaters claim a drowned woman below, lightning splitting the black sky above a gnarled dead tree. Girodet's anatomical bravura and theatrical lighting push Neoclassical drama toward outright horror.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Scene of the Flood

works.caption: The Virgin presents the Christ child to three richly costumed kings amid crumbling brick ruins, while a chorus of angels crowds the sky above and two alert greyhounds flank the foreground. Gossaert layers jewel-bright color and minutely observed textile pattern across nearly every inch of the panel.
works.title: The Adoration of the Kings

works.caption: Mooring poles rise from shimmering water before the hazy domes of Santa Maria della Salute, the whole scene dissolved into lavender and rose atmosphere. Monet lets the Venetian light blur architecture and reflection into near abstraction.
works.title: The Grand Canal

works.caption: Christ gestures gently toward a kneeling Mary Magdalene as a crowd of richly robed onlookers presses in beneath a colonnade. Veronese's saturated pinks, greens, and golds and his crowded, theatrical staging exemplify Venetian High Renaissance narrative painting at its most sumptuous.
works.title: The Conversion of Mary Magdalene

works.caption: A single dominant red square anchors the composition against white fields and one corner of blue and yellow, all locked together by thick black bars. Mondrian's late refinement of the grid distills painting to its most elemental relationships of color, line, and proportion.
works.title: Composition II in Red, Blue, and Yellow

works.caption: Gondolas and cargo boats crowd the mouth of the Grand Canal beneath the great dome of Santa Maria della Salute, tiny figures gesturing across the decks. Canaletto's crystalline light and exacting architectural perspective make this one of his most fully realized Venetian views.
works.title: The Entrance to the Grand Canal, Venice

works.caption: Gondoliers row past a rose-colored church facade as the Grand Canal opens toward a distant cluster of domes and towers under a vast cloud-piled sky. Bellotto's cooler, more atmospheric palette gives his Venice a slightly harder, more weathered edge than Canaletto's.
works.title: Venice: The Grand Canal facing Santa Croce

works.caption: A white villa with a pointed turret nestles among dense riverside trees, its reflection breaking apart in the dark, mirror-still water below. Cézanne's constructive, faceted brushwork already treats foliage and reflection as interlocking blocks of color.
works.title: Along the Banks of the Marne

works.caption: Moonlight falls in a single cold shaft across the sleeping shepherd's marble-smooth body while Cupid parts the branches above him -- Girodet's icy, hyper-polished eroticism at its most seductive.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Sleep of Endymion

works.caption: An impossibly elongated spine anchors Ingres's languid odalisque, her cool porcelain skin set against a deep blue curtain in one of the great manifestos of academic eroticism.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Grande Odalisque

works.caption: The Emperor stands in burnished parade armor with a wolfhound at his side, Titian building an entire theory of imperial authority out of quiet, unhurried brushwork.
works.title: Portrait of Charles V with a Dog

works.caption: Rebecca kneels at the well pouring water while a crowd of statuesque women in jewel-toned drapery looks on, Poussin arranging the whole biblical anecdote like a frieze of classical sculpture.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Eliezer and Rebecca

works.caption: A harbor of galleons and sunlit colonnades frames Cleopatra's arrival, Claude Lorrain's luminous, hazy horizon doing more emotional work than any of the tiny figures on the quay.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Cleopatra Disembarking at Tarsus

works.caption: Thatched cottages huddle beneath restless, sky-reaching trees, Van Gogh's thick, rhythmic strokes turning an ordinary Auvers hamlet into something charged and alive.
works.title: Houses at Auvers

works.caption: Saint George's lance snaps against the dragon while the princess flees in swirling pink and blue drapery, Tintoretto compressing violent motion into a single, luminous instant.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: The Virgin, Child, saints, and kneeling donor share a marble loggia opening onto a jewel-bright landscape, van Eyck rendering every fold of cloth and blade of grass with uncanny, crystalline precision.
works.title: Virgin and Child, with Saints and Donor

works.caption: Thomas Cromwell sits rigid and impassive at his green baize table, Holbein's cool, exacting realism making the sitter's guarded power almost tangible.
works.title: Thomas Cromwell

works.caption: Wisdom in shimmering brocade looks skyward while Hercules, draped in a lion's pelt, gathers up crowns and treasure at her feet -- Veronese at his most opulent and painterly.
works.title: Allegory of Wisdom and Strength

works.caption: The infant Christ grips a lamb's ear while Mary and Joseph look tenderly on, Raphael setting the tightly-knit family group against a serene, silvery river valley.
works.title: The Holy Family with a Lamb

works.caption: The Madonna cradles a squirming, alert Christ Child against her deep blue mantle, Raphael's sfumato modeling giving the pair an unusually tender, lifelike intimacy.
works.title: Madonna d'Orleans

works.caption: Venus tries to hold Adonis back from the hunt while cupids restrain his hounds, Veronese's warm, glowing palette turning the mythological parting into a tender genre scene.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: Feneon strides past a pinwheeling backdrop of Art Nouveau color and stars, offering a cyclamen at arm's length -- Signac's pointillist dots turned into pure decorative rhythm.
works.title: Opus 217. Against the Enamel of a Background Rhythmic with Beats and Angles, Tones, and Tints, Portrait of M. Félix Fénéon in 1890

works.caption: A pale, skull-flanked woman stands wrapped in a robe of glowing gold and jeweled discs, Klimt fusing Symbolist dread with pure ornamental radiance.
works.title: Hope II

works.caption: A footballer's lunging stride shatters into overlapping planes of red, blue, and gold, Boccioni translating pure kinetic force into Futurist fragments of color and light.
works.title: Dynamism of a Soccer Player

works.caption: Two furred, feather-hatted women stride through a crowd of dark-suited men, Kirchner's jagged, acid-toned angularity turning a Berlin street into something predatory and electric.
works.title: Street, Berlin

works.caption: A cat's enormous green-eyed face fills the canvas, a tiny bird hovering ghost-like at its brow -- Klee turning feline hunger into a strange, sun-bleached icon.
works.title: Cat and Bird

works.caption: Gauguin sets Tehamana's steady, direct gaze against a backdrop of invented hieroglyph-like script and a carved idol, fusing portraiture with symbolic invention in flattened, mineral color.
works.title: Merahi metua no Tehamana

works.caption: Bronzino renders Lucrezia's pale, sculptural features and cool gaze with icy precision, the crimson satin sleeves and gold chains crackling with enamel-hard clarity against the void behind her.
works.title: Portrait of Lucrezia Panciatichi

works.caption: Labille-Guiard paints herself mid-stroke at the easel in a plumed hat and shimmering grey satin, two admiring pupils peering over her shoulder as a quiet assertion of professional authority.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Two Pupils

works.caption: A young artist turns from her propped drawing board to fix the viewer with a clear, appraising gaze, the crisp Neoclassical light and glimpsed rooftop couple giving the scene an unusual narrative charge.
works.title: Portrait of Charlotte du Val d'Ognes

works.caption: Bellini sets the Madonna's grave, hooded profile against a hung red cloth and a luminous distant hill town, the Christ child's reaching gesture animating an otherwise still, devotional composition.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: El Greco dissolves the shepherds' bodies into flame-like folds of drapery swirling toward a burst of hovering angels, the whole scene lit as if by the infant's own radiance.
works.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Van Gogh builds his own weathered face and straw hat entirely from directional hatched strokes, complementary blues and oranges vibrating against each other with restless, controlled energy.
works.title: Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat

works.caption: Tiepolo spins a vertiginous ceiling vision of tumbling gods, rearing horses, and allegorical continents around a sunburst center, the illusionistic framing pulling the eye endlessly upward.
works.title: Allegory of the Planets and Continents

works.caption: Klimt fills the entire canvas edge to edge with a dense mosaic of sunflowers, daisies, and poppies, the decorative pattern-making pressing right up against pure abstraction.
works.title: Bauerngarten mit Sonnenblumen

works.caption: Modigliani reduces the reclining figure to sinuous, elongated contours in warm ochre and terracotta, the closed eyes and simplified mask-like face giving the nude a serene, sculptural remove.
works.title: Reclining Nude

works.caption: Grant Wood flattens a moonlit New England village into a toy-like aerial diorama, tiny horse and rider looping through the streets in a wry, folk-art reimagining of American legend.
works.title: The Midnight Ride of Paul Revere

works.caption: Heade presses a black, roiling storm sky against a still, dark-mirrored inlet, the lone seated fisherman and distant sailboat suspended in the eerie hush before the squall breaks.
works.title: Approaching Thunder Storm

works.caption: Church renders the ruined Parthenon in crystalline luminist light, scattered fallen capitals and drums in the foreground contrasting with the still-standing colonnade glowing against a cloudless sky.
works.title: The Parthenon

works.caption: Bare, rook-filled birches lean over a thawing village pond beside a snow-dusted bell tower, Savrasov turning an unremarkable early-spring scene into a quietly monumental image of renewal.
works.title: The Rooks Have Returned

works.caption: Lotto splits the scene diagonally between the Virgin's shadowed study and a sunlit loggia, God the Father plunging from the clouds so abruptly that even the household cat bolts in fright.
works.title: Recanati Annunciation

works.caption: Lotto dresses his sitter in vivid orange-and-green striped satin and a curled headdress, her sidelong glance and the inscribed paper of Lucretia's virtue turning portraiture into moral emblem.
works.title: Portrait of a Woman

works.caption: A single raking light picks Saint Francis's upturned, ecstatic face out of near-total darkness, Zurbarán's stark tenebrism reducing the friar to pure sculptural folds of coarse habit.
works.title: Saint Francis of Assisi

works.caption: Newton crouches at the edge of a rock, compass in hand, tracing a geometric diagram — Blake's iconic fusion of muscular Michelangelesque form with the cold light of pure reason.
works.title: Newton

works.caption: Two entwined bodies dissolve into a nest of crumpled white sheets and mottled olive ground — Schiele's jagged contour line turns embrace into near-abstraction.
works.title: The embrace

works.caption: A grinning skeleton nuzzles a luminous nude while her white drapery whips between them — Baldung Grien's chilling, erotically charged memento mori.
works.title: Death and the Woman

works.caption: Gondolas and rigged boats dissolve into shimmering haze before the Salute's steps — Turner's Venice rendered almost entirely in light.
works.title: Venice, from the Porch of Madonna della Salute

works.caption: The same shrewd, hooded eyes appraise from three angles at once — Champaigne's ingenious triple study of Richelieu, painted as a sculptor's reference.
works.title: Triple portrait of Cardinal de Richelieu

works.caption: Récamier reclines on a gilded chaise before a garden loggia, her white muslin gown and gold shawl catching the light — Gérard's cool Neoclassical poise.
works.title: Portrait de Juliette Récamier

works.caption: Ornate gilt-etched armor catches raking light as a page steadies the marquess's helmet — Titian's virtuoso rendering of metal against near-black shadow.
works.title: Portrait of Alfonso d'Avalos, Marchese del Vasto, in Armor with a Page

works.caption: Jewels and gold brocade are picked out thread by thread against flat blue — Holbein's crystalline precision turns costume into architecture.
works.title: Jane Seymour

works.caption: A towering top hat and white scarf frame Verdi's weathered, unsentimental face — Boldini's economical, confident pastel strokes.
works.collection: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
works.title: Portrait of Giuseppe Verdi

works.caption: A flushed, heavy-lidded Bacchus offers a glass of wine straight at the viewer, grapevine crown slightly askew — Caravaggio's tactile realism applied to myth.
works.title: Bacchus

works.caption: The Madonna's monumental form rises against blazing gold leaf, flanked by ranks of haloed saints — Giotto's weighty, sculptural break from Byzantine flatness.
works.title: Madonna Enthroned

works.caption: Three sisters in cascading white satin lean together on a sofa beneath a gilt-framed portrait — Sargent's virtuoso handling of fabric and easy, confident poses.
works.title: The Wyndham Sisters: Lady Elcho, Mrs. Adeane, and Mrs. Tennant

works.caption: A mother nuzzles her bare-bottomed toddler before an oval mirror, both rendered in loose, breezy strokes — Cassatt's tender, unsentimental intimacy.
works.title: Mother and Child (The Oval Mirror)

works.caption: A field laborer straightens for a moment, his exhausted, sunburned face turned toward the viewer while smoke rises from unseen burning stubble behind him. Millet monumentalizes rural toil without sentiment.
works.title: Man with a Hoe

works.caption: A volcano erupts in the distance beneath a blood-orange sun, its ash cloud mingling with the glow of dawn over a jungle gorge. Church stages geological violence and tropical beauty in the same breath.
works.title: Cotopaxi

works.caption: Four rigid, faceless bathers stand in vertical bands of green, black, gray, and blue, their bodies flattened into interlocking planes. Matisse strips the bathing-nude theme down to its structural bones.
works.title: Bathers by a River

works.caption: Dozens of nudes recline, bathe, and embrace within a crowded circular frame, their bodies compressed into a single sinuous rhythm of curves. Ingres compiles a lifetime of erotic drawing into one obsessive tondo.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Turkish Bath

works.caption: Joseph slips the ring onto Mary's finger before a broken suitor snaps his rod in the foreground, all set against a vast, perfectly symmetrical temple receding into pale sky. Raphael's architecture does as much storytelling as the figures.
works.title: The Marriage of the Virgin

works.caption: A writhing avalanche of bodies tumbles from heaven's light into hellish darkness below, wrestled by demons and serpents. Rubens turns damnation into a single continuous vortex of flesh.
works.title: The Fall of the Damned

works.caption: Mother and child emerge from flat, undefined darkness, the Madonna's downcast eyes and the infant's solemn stare giving the encounter unusual gravity. Raphael pares the subject down to pure contour and quiet feeling.
works.title: Madonna del Granduca

works.caption: Lightning splits the sky as two fleeing figures pause at the edge of a cliff, dwarfed by a wall of fire consuming the cities below. Martin's apocalyptic scale turns catastrophe into spectacle.
works.title: The Destruction of Sodom And Gomorrah

works.caption: The actress sits in profile, her sharp gaze and enormous plumed hat rendered with confident, fluid strokes against dark red drapery. Gainsborough captures celebrity as much as likeness.
works.title: Mrs Siddons

works.caption: A woman in loosened white and rose drapery turns her head aside, her tumbling auburn hair and bared shoulder rendered with Titian's characteristic warmth. The picture reads as pure sensuous presence rather than narrative.
works.title: Flora

works.caption: Sunlight pours through parting storm clouds onto a glacial lake ringed by jagged peaks and grazing deer. Bierstadt stages the American wilderness as a kind of secular cathedral.
works.title: Among the Sierra Nevada, California

works.caption: Jacob sleeps beneath a gnarled tree as a ladder of angels rises unseen into a luminous sky above him. Ribera contrasts the sleeper's earthbound shadow with the vision's cool radiance.
works.title: Jacob’s Dream

works.caption: A lone figure strides across a darkening hillside, flinging seed in a single sweeping gesture that dominates the canvas. Millet turns an ordinary agricultural task into a monumental, almost biblical figure.
works.title: The Sower

works.caption: A hooded, robed figure walks on, purse cut from his belt by a grinning thief crouched inside a glass sphere inscribed with a moralizing verse. Bruegel's circular format and muted palette give an old proverb sly, understated bite.
works.title: The Misanthrope

works.caption: A young woman in profile, her hair bound in an elaborate knotted braid, is drawn with the same silvery precision Leonardo brought to his anatomical studies. The chalk-and-ink technique on vellum gives the portrait an almost sculptural clarity.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Fiancée

works.caption: Adam and Eve stand flanking the tree of knowledge, a serpent coiled overhead, their elongated, faintly mannered bodies set against dense foliage. Cranach's cool, polished nudes make the temptation feel oddly courtly.
works.title: Adam and Eve

works.caption: A boy holds a chained flying squirrel at a polished tabletop, its reflection doubling the animal's alertness. Copley's crisp description of glass, fur, and fabric announces an extraordinary eye for surface.
works.title: A Boy with a Flying Squirrel (Henry Pelham)

works.caption: Fireworks burst over a glowing, indistinct Venice as tiny figures on a rooftop terrace watch the display below. Turner dissolves architecture into pure atmospheric shimmer.
works.title: Juliet and her Nurse

works.caption: Elderly women arrive by cart and wheelbarrow on one side of a pool, emerging as young nudes on the other, with courtiers and a feast awaiting them. Cranach turns a wishful legend into a busy, methodical narrative diagram.
works.title: The fountain of youth

works.caption: The young infanta stands attended by her maids of honor while the painter himself, brush in hand, regards the viewer from behind a towering canvas, and the king and queen appear only as a reflection in a distant mirror. Velazquez turns the studio itself into the picture's real subject.
works.title: Las Meninas

works.caption: A young milkmaid gazes out with parted lips and flushed cheeks, painted in soft, broken strokes that anticipate Impressionism. Goya's late style abandons sharp contour for atmosphere and touch.
works.title: The Milkmaid of Bordeaux

works.caption: Soldiers raise their hands in solemn oath around the dying general's bed while his grieving widow and children look on. Poussin arranges the figures like a frieze, each gesture calibrated to the scene's rhetorical weight.
works.title: The Death of Germanicus

works.caption: Gauguin catches van Gogh mid-brushstroke, his sunflowers blazing in the foreground against the flattened, unnaturally banded river landscape behind.
works.title: Vincent van Gogh Painting Sunflowers

works.caption: A single shaft of light carves the disciples' astonished faces from total darkness at the moment they recognize the risen Christ, Caravaggio's tenebrism at its most theatrical.
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: A gnarled cypress trunk twists in near-black ink across sheets of pure gold leaf, the monumental Momoyama-era scale meant to overwhelm a room.
works.title: Cypress Trees

works.caption: A crowd of top hats and crinolines dissolves into flickers of loose, unblended brushwork under the Tuileries trees, an early manifesto for what painting could become.
works.title: Music in the Tuileries

works.caption: Peter the Great's cold stare locks on his downcast son across a document-strewn table, the checkerboard floor and dim gilt-framed room amplifying the silent accusation.
works.title: Peter the Great Interrogating the Tsarevich Alexei Petrovich at Peterhof

works.caption: A grinning winged Cupid loops a yoke around the newlyweds' shoulders, his mischief cutting through the couple's stiff, jewel-encrusted formality.
works.title: Marsilio Cassotti and His Bride Faustina

works.caption: Every pinned letter, scale, and glass vase on the merchant's green-walled desk is rendered with crystalline precision, cataloguing his trade as sharply as his composed stare.
works.title: The Merchant Georg Gisze

works.caption: The Lady of Shalott stretches restlessly at her loom, the tapestry's threads spilling loose as a distant walled city glimmers through her round mirror.
works.title: "I am half sick of shadows" said the Lady of Shalott

works.caption: Ophelia perches on a fallen branch amid dense water lilies, her red hair and daisy-strewn gown glowing against the murky green pond just before her fall.
works.title: Ophelia

works.caption: A violinist pauses over her sheet music, the instrument's warm varnish and her rustling silk bodice picked out crisply against an almost featureless dark ground.
works.title: Portrait of a violinist

works.caption: Survivors pile into a desperate pyramid of straining bodies toward a speck of rescue on the horizon, Géricault's storm-lit corpses and living men locked together in one convulsive diagonal.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Raft of the Medusa

works.caption: Dürer sets Kleeberger's sharp, unflinching gaze within a trompe-l'oeil bronze medallion, Latin inscription curling around the rim like a real coin.
works.title: portrait of Johann Kleeberger

works.caption: Christ's illuminated body strains against the darkness as men below hoist the cross, Rembrandt inserting his own turbaned self-portrait among the executioners.
works.title: Raising of the Cross

works.caption: Firelight and window glow split the dim room as the risen Christ's presence dawns on a stunned disciple, an early Rembrandt already mastering theatrical shadow.
works.title: The Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: Judas grovels on the floor amid scattered silver coins, his wild anguish spotlit against the priests' cold indifference in the shadowed temple beyond.
works.title: Judas Repentant, Returning the Pieces of Silver

works.caption: A tiny campfire glows at the base of towering black trees, the Holy Family's resting place barely visible against a brooding castle silhouette and stormy sky.
works.title: Nocturnal Landscape with the Holy Family resting on the flight into Egypt

works.caption: A minister glides across the ice in perfect, self-possessed profile, his black silhouette crisp against a hazy monochrome sky and frozen loch.
works.title: The Skating Minister

works.caption: Turbulent, swirling clouds churn over a flowering Provence meadow, van Gogh's thick impasto sky pressing down on tiny figures gathering blossoms below.
works.title: Landscape Under a Stormy Sky

works.caption: Look at the play of raking light across the furrowed brow and the glinting knife blade — Rembrandt builds the whole psychological weight of the apostle from shadow and a few lit passages.
works.title: Saint Bartholomew

works.caption: Note the jewel-precise armor and horse trappings of the riders threading a rocky pass toward a fantastical skyline — this panel of the Ghent Altarpiece was stolen in 1934 and is known today only through photographs like this one.
works.collection: concept of unknown value in Wikibase
works.title: The Just Judges

works.caption: Follow the winding river past the grazing donkey and drowsing Joseph to the fantastical spired city on the horizon — Gerard David's landscape does as much storytelling as the Madonna herself.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: Christ's body is laid diagonally across the canvas like a fallen column, the mourning angel's outstretched wing balancing the composition against a luminous, storm-lit sky.
works.title: The lamentation over the dead Christ

works.caption: A crowd of grinning carnival masks presses close to the picture plane, Ensor's garish greens and yellows turning festivity into something unsettling and grotesque.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: The Intrigue (Ensor)

works.caption: Raphael's saint turns her face to a shaft of unseen light, the sinuous S-curve of her body echoed by the wheel below and a luminous river landscape receding behind her.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: Three red pumps glow like sentinels at dusk against the darkening treeline — Hopper distills American roadside solitude into pure geometric stillness.
works.title: Gas

works.caption: Twin beams of light connect the crucified Christ borne by an angel to the kneeling saint below, Rubens charging the rocky wilderness with visionary electricity.
works.title: Stigmatisation of Francis of Assisi

works.caption: A blazing yellow sun beats down on a solitary reaper swallowed by curling wheat — van Gogh's late Saint-Rémy brushwork turns harvest labor into cosmic drama.
works.title: The Wheatfield behind Saint Paul's Hospital with a Reaper

works.caption: Zurbaran renders the brocaded gown and jeweled clasp with such tactile precision that the saint's sidelong glance almost seems an afterthought to the fabric's splendor.
works.title: Saint Casilda

works.caption: Heavy black contours and a cigarette held mid-air give Beckmann's wife a cool, self-possessed glamour against clashing pink and blue planes.
works.title: Quappi in a Pink Jumper

works.caption: A translucent white veil and fur-trimmed cloak frame the actress's direct, unguarded gaze — Goya's late portraiture at its most intimate.
works.title: Portrait of the Actress Antonia Zarate

works.caption: A single striped hot-air balloon hangs suspended in a vast, cloud-streaked blue sky — Szinyei Merse turns a modern marvel into pure atmospheric wonder.
works.title: The Balloon

works.caption: A garland of tumbling putti along a ruined entablature frames the humble manger scene below, the classical architecture and golden dawn light lending it Poussin-esque order.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Figures and animals dissolve into a swirling vortex of gold and white light — Turner pushes biblical narrative almost entirely into pure atmospheric abstraction.
works.title: Light and Colour (Goethe's Theory) – The Morning after the Deluge – Moses Writing the Book of Genesis

works.caption: Shackled limbs and reaching hands break the surface of a blood-red sea as a ship recedes into the storm — Turner's sublime, furious color makes an atrocity into an overwhelming visual event.
works.title: The Slave Ship

works.caption: A lone standing stone anchors the foreground against tiered, snow-capped peaks and a still fjord — Dahl's Romantic sublime rendered with crystalline northern light.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Winter at the Sognefjord

works.caption: Van Gogh's cadmium-yellow house glows against a deep cobalt sky, everyday Arles street life caught in loose, confident strokes.
works.title: The Yellow House

works.caption: A porcelain-faced Madonna cradles a machine gun instead of a child, ammunition belts wound like rosaries — Padegs fuses religious iconography with interwar menace to jarring effect.
works.title: Madonna with Machine Gun

works.caption: A stern, pipe-smoking man looms over huddled women and a nursing mother, Kazaks flattening the wartime displacement scene into angular, mask-like faces under a bruised sky.
works.title: Refugees

works.caption: The convex mirror on the back wall reflects the whole room in miniature — van Eyck's obsessive, jewel-like precision in every fold of green wool and strand of dog fur rewards a lifetime of looking.
works.title: Arnolfini Portrait

works.caption: A teeming haywain is dragged toward the fiery hell of the right panel while grasping crowds claw for scraps of hay — Bosch's satirical panorama of human folly rewards endless close looking.
works.title: The Haywain Triptych

works.caption: A crown of real flowers spills over her shoulder as she grips a flowering staff — Rembrandt drapes his Flora in richly worked brocade against enveloping shadow.
works.title: Flora

works.caption: Van Gogh strips away his familiar beard and reworks his own face in urgent, radiating strokes of ochre and green, painted in the last months of his life.
works.title: Self-portrait without beard

works.caption: Gentileschi bathes Danaë's reclining body in a cool, sculptural light as a shower of gold coins rains from above, the cupid's outstretched wing catching the last of it.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Rembrandt's only seascape hurls a fishing boat up a wall of black water, the disciples' terror lit by one shaft of gold breaking through the storm.
works.title: The Storm on the Sea of Galilee

works.caption: David poses Paris undressed and languid on a rumpled bed while Helen leans in, the harp between them a pointed emblem of seduction over duty.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Paris and Helen

works.caption: A cobalt-blue foal stands foursquare against hills of raw red and yellow, Marc's animal painted as a vessel of pure, unclouded feeling.
works.title: Blue horse

works.caption: The five-year-old infanta all but vanishes inside her enormous silver-trimmed gown, Velázquez rendering the stiff blue silk with looser, freer strokes the closer one looks.
works.title: Infanta Margarita Teresa in a Blue Dress

works.caption: Three tormentors close around Christ's bound column in near-total black, Caravaggio's raking light carving muscle and rope with brutal, sculptural clarity.
works.title: The Flagellation of Christ

works.caption: Late Vermeer at his most intimate, the young woman's turned head catching the light as a viola da gamba and painted landscape crowd the foreground.
works.title: A Young Woman seated at a Virginal

works.caption: An old man's face, unsparingly lined and half in shadow, turns toward the viewer with a wry, knowing half-smile in one of Rembrandt's last self-portraits.
works.title: Self-portrait as Zeuxis Laughing

works.caption: Three nudes link arms in a slow circling dance beneath a swag of roses, Rubens building their flesh from warm, pearly layers of paint rather than hard outline.
works.title: The Three Graces

works.caption: Angels press in close around the enthroned Madonna in this tondo, the pomegranate the Child grips a quiet symbol of the Passion to come.
works.title: Madonna of the Pomegranate

works.caption: Mary presses her cheek to the Christ child's head while the infant Baptist looks on, Raphael's curtain of deep green setting off the Madonna's coral-red sleeve.
works.title: Madonna della tenda

works.caption: The infant Christ and a small book of Latin verse share the Virgin's lap, Botticelli's deep ultramarine mantle wrapping the pair in one continuous fall of drapery.
works.title: Madonna of the Book

works.caption: A single wicker basket of fruit and leaves, some already spotted and curling with decay, set against a bare wall — Caravaggio's still life as a meditation on time.
works.title: Basket of Fruit

works.caption: A seated man submits to a sham operation for the 'stone of madness' while a mocking crowd looks on, Bosch's satire on quack medicine framed by gilt Gothic lettering.
works.title: Cutting the Stone

works.caption: Peter recoils from his accuser's pointing finger, Caravaggio compressing three half-lengths and one shaft of light into an almost unbearably close confrontation.
works.title: The Denial of Saint Peter

works.caption: The boy's red waistcoat is the single hot note against cool blue-grays, his slouched pose and averted eyes giving Cézanne's portrait its watchful, private mood.
works.title: The Boy in the Red Vest

works.caption: Cézanne arches a grove of ochre tree trunks over a huddle of faceted, monumental bathers, the culmination of decades spent rebuilding the nude from planes of color.
works.title: Les Grandes Baigneuses

works.caption: David straddles the giant's collapsed body to sever the head, Caravaggio's white tunic and the pale corpse the only light against total black.
works.title: David and Goliath

works.caption: Saul lies flat on his back beneath the raised hooves of his own horse, arms flung open to the light that has just struck him blind — Caravaggio's most radical composition.
works.title: Conversion on the Way to Damascus

works.caption: St. Mark plunges headlong from the sky to halt the executioner's raised hammer, Tintoretto throwing the whole crowded piazza into swirling, foreshortened motion.
works.title: Miracle of the Slave

works.caption: Bare-backed brothers present Joseph's blood-stained tunic to a recoiling Jacob; note the sharp diagonal thrust of arms and the small spaniel that grounds the theatrical grief in domestic reality.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Joseph's Tunic

works.caption: Velázquez drapes the kneeling king's golden robe in raking light against a nearly black ground, isolating the Christ child's pale flesh as the composition's sole radiant point.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Juno's milk arcs into starlight as an eagle, peacocks, and tumbling cherubs spiral around her recoiling body — a virtuoso essay in twisting Mannerist movement.
works.title: The Origin of the Milky Way

works.caption: Seurat's dotted pointillist matrix spins bareback rider, acrobat, and ringmaster's whip into a single arc of yellow motion against the tiered, stippled crowd.
works.title: The Circus

works.caption: Raphael turns to meet the viewer's gaze while his companion looks past the frame, the pointing hand and shoulder-clasp binding the two figures into an intimate double portrait.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Self-portrait with a friend

works.caption: A crumbling thatched stable becomes a stage for the Magi's ritual homage, while beggars and hybrid tormentors lurk unnoticed in the shadowed doorway behind them.
works.title: The Epiphany

works.caption: Christ's extended arm ignites a chain reaction of gesture across the huddled mourners, Lazarus's corpse arching upward out of near-total darkness toward the light.
works.title: The Raising of Lazarus

works.caption: Cobalt irises crowd the canvas edge to edge in thick, rhythmic strokes, the single white bloom offsetting the field's insistent blue-green pulse.
works.title: Irises

works.caption: An unfinished corner reveals Raphael's underdrawing, but the pyramidal grouping of Mary and the two infants against a luminous Umbrian landscape is fully resolved.
works.title: Esterhazy Madonna

works.caption: Isaac's scream and the knife at his throat freeze mid-action as the angel's grip halts Abraham's arm, the ram's head entering from the dark like a last-second reprieve.
works.title: Sacrifice of Isaac

works.caption: Exhausted, wounded captives sprawl in the foreground beneath a hazy, smoke-streaked sky while a mounted raider bursts in from the right, Delacroix's broken color anticipating Impressionism.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Massacre at Chios

works.caption: Painted on a convex shield, Medusa's severed head shrieks in the instant of death, writhing serpents and spurting blood rendered with startling anatomical shock.
works.title: Medusa

works.caption: A sallow, ivy-crowned youth offers grapes with a sidelong glance, the greenish pallor of his skin reading as much as illness as invitation.
works.title: Self-Portrait as Bacchus

works.caption: Mars sleeps open-mouthed while mischievous satyrs make off with his lance and blow a conch in his ear, Venus watching with cool, wakeful composure.
works.title: Venus and Mars

works.caption: Golden light floods the bed curtains as Danaë raises a welcoming hand toward the unseen shower of gold, her flesh modeled with Rembrandt's characteristic warm glow.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Three sisters and a governess gather around a chessboard, one girl's raised hand and half-smile catching the instant of a contested move with unusual psychological immediacy.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist's Sisters Playing Chess

works.caption: Gentileschi turns from her instrument to meet the viewer directly, the turbaned head and richly lit blue satin sleeve giving the self-portrait a theatrical, confident presence.
works.title: Self-Portrait as a Lute Player

works.caption: Sebastian stands serenely pierced by multiple arrows against a wide Tuscan panorama, his calm expression at odds with the wounds studding his torso.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: A wheel of vice unfolds around a watchful eye of God, its roundels of gluttony, lust, and wrath surrounded by four smaller scenes of death, judgment, heaven, and hell.
works.title: The Seven Deadly Sins and the Four Last Things

works.caption: An incubus crouches on the sleeper's chest as a wild-eyed horse's head pushes through the curtain, Fuseli's stark chiaroscuro turning dream anxiety into a still, frozen tableau.
works.title: The Nightmare

works.caption: An executioner extends the Baptist's severed head on a platter to an averted, sorrowful Salome, Caravaggio's late style stripped to a few bruised, illuminated faces.
works.title: Salome with the Head of John the Baptist

works.caption: Three faces cluster around the platter in near-total darkness, the old woman's grimace and the youth's blank stare replacing horror with weary resignation.
works.title: Salome with the Head of John the Baptist

works.caption: Two shackled monkeys hunch in a stone window arch above Antwerp's harbor, their chains and captivity implying a quiet allegory of bondage against a free, bustling world beyond.
works.title: Two Chained Monkeys

works.caption: A gnarled, half-dead tree frames a rising crescent moon as two friends pause on a woodland path, Friedrich's Romantic hush turning nature into quiet reverie.
works.title: Two men contemplating the Moon

works.caption: God-the-architect bends from a fiery disc, one arm plunging a golden compass toward the void below — Blake's most iconic image of creative and constraining reason.
works.title: The Ancient of Days

works.caption: Caravaggio's tenebrism isolates Christ's pale, bound torso against near-total darkness, the crown of thorns and reed sceptre rendered with unflinching physical presence.
works.title: Ecce Homo

works.caption: A ruined stable dissolves into shadow while a shaft of light picks out the Virgin laid on straw with her newborn, shepherds crowding in with rough, weathered faces.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Saint Anthony is hoisted skyward in a writhing knot of scaled, horned demons, their fantastical anatomy set against a calm river landscape far below.
works.title: The Torment of Saint Anthony

works.caption: A crowd of grotesque, individualized faces presses around Christ bent under the cross's diagonal weight, a distant walled city glowing coolly behind them.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: Vermeer's checkerboard floor recedes toward a virginal and its tilted mirror, the standing pupil and her teacher held in the cool, exact light pouring through leaded windows.
works.title: The Music Lesson

works.caption: An angel swoops down out of the darkness to guide Matthew's hand across the page, the saint twisting on his stool in startled concentration.
works.title: The Inspiration of Saint Matthew

works.caption: A young musician in a red cap turns three-quarters toward the light, holding a scrap of notated music, his curls and searching eyes rendered with quiet precision.
works.title: Portrait of a Musician

works.caption: A muscular executioner looms over the fallen saint at the altar steps while onlookers recoil in a spiral of violent movement, an angel handing down the martyr's palm from the clouds.
works.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew

works.caption: A locomotive plunges through swirling rain and steam across a bridge, its dark bulk barely resolved amid Turner's dissolving atmosphere of ochre and grey.
works.title: Rain, Steam and Speed – The Great Western Railway

works.caption: The Virgin's pyramidal form anchors two infant boys reaching across her lap, a serene Umbrian landscape of hills and towers unfolding behind them.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: La Belle Jardinière

works.caption: A youthful, calm-eyed martyr in richly patterned brocade holds his arrow like an attribute rather than an instrument of suffering, haloed against a pale Umbrian sky.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: A steady-gazed young woman cradles a small unicorn against her red velvet sleeve, flanked by classical columns opening onto a hazy blue landscape.
works.title: Young Woman with Unicorn

works.caption: Apples and oranges tumble across a rumpled white cloth beside a stoneware jug, Cézanne building form entirely through faceted, weighty patches of color.
works.title: Rideau, Cruchon et Compotier

works.caption: Saints flank an enthroned Madonna beneath a triple-arched loggia painted in pastel pinks and greens, its perspective grid of tiles anchoring the calm, geometric composition.
works.title: Santa Lucia de' Magnoli Altarpiece

works.caption: A vast, dusty crowd of peasants, clergy, and gentry strains forward behind a gilded icon shrine, Repin cataloguing Russian society through dozens of individualized faces.
works.title: Religious Procession in Kursk Province

works.caption: Christ sits hunched and hollow-eyed on a boulder in a barren stony waste, hands knotted together in the grey light before dawn.
works.title: Christ in the Wilderness

works.caption: Dante and Virgil stand rigid in a small boat as the damned claw at its sides, a burning city glowing on the horizon behind roiling, storm-dark water.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Barque of Dante

works.caption: Three nudes stand linked in a gentle rhythm of turned poses, each holding a golden sphere, against a small luminous landscape of hills and water.
works.title: Three Graces

works.caption: Astarte stares out with heavy-lidded, hypnotic directness, swathed in shimmering emerald drapery while two torchbearing attendants gesture behind her against a fiery glow.
works.title: Astarte Syriaca

works.caption: A horse-drawn wain stands mid-stream before a weathered timber cottage, Constable's towering, wind-scattered clouds giving the whole Suffolk scene its living light.
works.title: The Hay Wain

works.caption: The Virgin's folded hands and downcast eyes glow against pitch-black background, her ultramarine mantle and ivory veil modeled with porcelain smoothness.
works.title: The Virgin in Prayer

works.caption: A ruined castle's twin towers stand black against a vast, roiling sky, the Thames estuary stretching flat and silvery toward the horizon after a storm.
works.title: Hadleigh Castle, The Mouth of the Thames--Morning after a Stormy Night

works.caption: A bowler-hatted man leans on his cane, Modigliani flattening him into elongated planes of navy and ochre against a two-toned wall.
works.title: Seated Man with a Cane

works.caption: Monet dissolves his dying wife's face into a blizzard of grey-violet brushstrokes, grief transmuted into pure, restless paint.
works.title: Camille Monet on her deathbed

works.caption: The Holy Family rests by a campfire beneath a night sky dense with accurately observed stars, a full moon doubled in the still river beyond.
works.title: The Flight into Egypt

works.caption: Dürer confronts the viewer frontally with an almost Christ-like poise, his cascading curls and richly gathered sleeves painted with obsessive, jewel-like precision.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: A hermit saint kneels before a crucifix amid Bosch's eroded, fantastical ruins, flanking panels crawling with small grotesque torments and hybrid creatures.
works.title: The Hermit Saint

works.caption: John writes on Patmos beneath a hovering angel and a tiny vision of the Virgin, the panel's reverse showing a strange circular night scene of the Passion around a glowing pelican.
works.title: St. John  on Patmos

works.caption: Christ hangs pale against a wide, luminous Flemish landscape while mourners and a kneeling donor with his patron gather below, a skull and scattered bones underfoot.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Crucifixion with a Donor

works.caption: An old man's disfigured, rhinophyma-scarred nose is rendered with unsparing tenderness as his grandson gazes up at him, a serene valley framed in the window behind.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: An Old Man and his Grandson

works.caption: A woman gathers her golden hair while a man behind her holds up a convex mirror, Titian's warm flesh tones set against deep shadow.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Woman with a Mirror

works.caption: Two sisters lean together against a guitar in a shadowy grove, one holding sheet music, their satin and taffeta rendered in soft, feathery brushwork.
works.title: Elizabeth and Mary Linley

works.caption: A man's weathered face emerges from near-black shadow beneath an elaborately wound crimson chaperon, van Eyck's crackled surface only heightening its startling immediacy.
works.title: Portrait of a Man (Self      Portrait?)

works.caption: Vulcan lifts the sheet from Venus's nude body while Mars hides beneath a table and a small dog barks, a convex mirror slyly repeating the drama across the room.
works.title: Venus and Mars Surprised by Vulcan

works.caption: Mary and Elizabeth clasp hands beneath a carved marble arch opening onto a distant hill town, their vivid blue, red, and gold robes set against the cool stone architecture.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Visitation

works.caption: David looks upward with parted lips, half-dressed and gripping Goliath's severed head by the hair, a plumed helmet and sword propped against the stone beside him.
works.title: David with the Head of Goliath

works.caption: A young woman's face glows against a cracked sky-blue ground; note how the fur boa and mustard gloves loop into a serpentine line across the white muslin dress.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Mademoiselle Caroline Rivière

works.caption: Two dark cypress flames twist upward into a churning, cloud-swirled sky, their brushwork as restless as the flower-strewn ground below.
works.title: Cypresses with two figures

works.caption: A blazing field of red poppies rolls beneath a turbulent blue sky, the thick impasto strokes giving the whole surface a vibrating, electric energy.
works.title: Poppy field

works.caption: Kneeling magi in jewel-toned robes crowd close around the Madonna in a stone grotto, while a distant procession winds down through Mantegna's crisp, sculptural hills.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Tormentors press in on Christ beneath a marble bust of Tiberius, Titian's raking light carving the crossed staffs and straining muscles out of near-total darkness.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Crowning with Thorns

works.caption: A solemn girl's pale face and beaded collar catch the light against a tall black hennin, Petrus Christus rendering every crack in the aged panel with quiet precision.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Girl

works.caption: A grinning street beggar shoulders his crutch against a wide sky, Ribera dignifying the boy's twisted foot and ragged clothes with heroic, life-size scale.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Clubfoot

works.caption: A brooding giant looms over a moonlit landscape where a stampeding crowd flees in miniature panic, Goya's murky brushwork making the colossus feel like a bad dream.
works.title: The Colossus

works.caption: Minerva charges into a swamp of vices beneath fiery orange cliffs while gods watch from a cloud above, Mantegna packing the allegory with tumbling, densely modeled figures.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Triumph of the Virtues

works.caption: A vast battle of thousands of tiny soldiers churns beneath a cosmic sky where sun and moon face off over mountains and sea, Altdorfer collapsing an entire world into one panel.
works.title: The Battle of Alexander at Issus

works.caption: Thomas's grimy finger probes the wound as three heads crowd in under a single beam of light, Caravaggio making doubt itself a tactile, almost uncomfortable act.
works.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas

works.caption: Two curly-haired infants reach across the Virgin's lap for a scrap of paper, Raphael's pyramidal group glowing warmly out of an almost black background.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose

works.caption: The aged king's drooping mustache and weary eyes emerge from loose, almost dissolving brushwork against total darkness, Velázquez's late style at its most economical.
works.title: Philip IV in old age

works.caption: A white rabbit held gently under the Madonna's hand anchors a warm pastoral group, Titian setting the sacred figures against a glowing sunset landscape with grazing sheep.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madonna of the Rabbit

works.caption: A pale, startled Mary shrinks against the wall as Gabriel extends a white lily, Rossetti's near-monochrome palette and stiff medieval poses giving the scene an eerie stillness.
works.title: Ecce Ancilla Domini

works.caption: Pallas grips a wild centaur by the hair, her olive-branch armor and windblown drapery patterned in obsessive linear detail against a calm coastal view.
works.title: Pallas and the Centaur

works.caption: The infant Christ tugs at a sheer green veil as Mary looks on and Joseph watches from shadow, the trio's warm flesh tones glowing against near-black background.
works.title: Madonna of Loreto

works.caption: The young Dürer stares out coolly beneath a red cap, holding a sprig of eryngium, his flowing hair and pleated shirt rendered with startling linear precision against solid black.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of the Artist Holding a Thistle

works.caption: A sleeping boy sprawls against total darkness, his own arrow and quiver cast into shadow beneath him, Caravaggio using stark light to make dormant Cupid feel almost lifeless.
works.title: Sleeping Cupid

works.caption: A skeletal figure in a monk's robe clutches a woman in patterned drapery on a barren, cracked-earth ground, Schiele's jagged linework turning an embrace into a study of dread.
works.title: Death and the Maiden

works.caption: The boy Christ debates a ring of grotesque, wrinkled elders, Dürer packing the panel with expressive hands and faces crowded almost claustrophobically close to the picture plane.
works.title: Christ Among the Doctors

works.caption: Two street boys gorge on grapes and melon against a bare dark wall, Murillo turning ragged clothes and dirty feet into a warmly lit celebration of appetite.
works.title: Grape and Melon Eaters

works.caption: The infant Christ grips a small wooden cross offered by the young Baptist, Raphael's pyramidal Madonna group set with effortless calm against a sunlit Umbrian valley.
works.title: Madonna del Prato

works.caption: John reclines pensively beside a strange fleshy plant sprouting from the rock, Bosch filling the wide, glowing landscape behind him with tiny fantastical creatures.
works.title: St. John the Baptist in the Wilderness

works.caption: The Virgin rises weightlessly on a crescent moon into a swirl of golden cloud and tumbling cherub heads, Murillo dissolving edges into pure luminous atmosphere.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables

works.caption: The praying Virgin stands on a crescent moon amid a swirl of cherub heads, Murillo's warm ochre haze blurring the boundary between figure and cloud.
works.title: Immaculate Conception

works.caption: A disheveled man in a loose white cravat stares out with unsettling directness, Géricault's clinical yet sympathetic study of a psychiatric patient dispensing with any flattery.
works.title: Portrait of a Kleptomaniac

works.caption: Christ and the Pharisee lean close together in profile over the tribute coin, Titian building the whole drama from just two intent faces and a red-and-black color chord.
works.title: The Tribute Money

works.caption: Venus wrings out her wet hair beside a scallop shell, Titian's warm flesh tones set simply against a cool blue sea and sky.
works.title: Venus Anadyomene

works.caption: The infant Christ reaches up from his cradle toward Mary as Elizabeth crowns young John with flowers, Raphael weaving a crowded family group into one warmly lit pyramid.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Holy Family of Francis I

works.caption: An old woman fries eggs in a red earthenware bowl while a boy holds a melon and wine flask, Velázquez rendering copper, glaze, and linen with astonishing tactile precision.
works.title: Old Woman Cooking Eggs

works.caption: A radiant, laurel-crowned Apollo interrupts Vulcan's forge with unwelcome news, the startled blacksmiths' bare torsos and gleaming armor set against dark workshop shadow.
works.title: Apollo in the Forge of Vulcan

works.caption: A quattrocento profile in patterned brocade stands against a dark hedge scattered with flowers and butterflies, Pisanello treating each blossom and insect as a jewel-like emblem.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of a Princess

works.caption: A young Rembrandt stages a jewel-toned half-length: pearls, gold chain, and a bejewelled cup catch a single warm light against near-total darkness, while a shadowy figure lurks behind.
works.title: Judith at the Banquet of Holofernes

works.caption: Van Eyck's obsessive optical precision turns a Bruges canon's private devotion into a hall of mirrored textures — fur, brocade, polished armor, and Persian carpet all rendered with equal, uncanny clarity.
works.title: Madonna with Canon Joris van der Paele

works.caption: Klimt drowns his sitter in a riot of appliquéd floral pattern, her painted face the only calm passage in a shimmering gold-ground field of loose, mosaic-like brushwork.
works.title: Portrait of Eugenia Primavesi

works.caption: Kirchner paints himself in uniform with a stub where his hand should be and a nude model behind him — a raw, garishly colored confession of wartime trauma and thwarted creativity.
works.title: Self-portrait as a Soldier

works.caption: Raphael's straining bearers carry Christ's slack body across a broad landscape in a spiraling arrangement of gesture and drapery, grief radiating outward through every figure's twisted pose.
works.title: The Deposition

works.caption: Renoir dissolves flesh into pearly, sun-warmed color as bathers lounge and splash by a riverbank — a late, sculptural return to classicism after his Impressionist years.
works.title: The Great Bathers

works.caption: Two mothers plead before an enthroned Solomon while a soldier raises his sword over a wailing infant — a taut classical composition built on strict architectural symmetry and gesture.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Judgment of Solomon

works.caption: Two golden-haloed infants reach for a carnation held by a serene Madonna in this small, jewel-like Raphael, framed by twin views of a distant walled town.
works.title: Garvagh Madonna

works.caption: Gauguin folds three flattened, mossy-green Breton women in prayer around a rustic crucifix, the cloisonné outlines and unnatural color turning a roadside calvary into pure Symbolist feeling.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Green Christ

works.caption: Four allegorical dancers whirl hand in hand to Time's lyre while Apollo's chariot wheels overhead — Poussin's most enduringly quoted meditation on the wheel of fortune.
works.title: A Dance to the Music of Time

works.caption: Raphael sets a black-clad Florentine merchant's son against a hazy blue hillscape, the sitter's steady, faintly wary gaze anchoring an otherwise understated portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Agnolo Doni

works.caption: Van Eyck's grisaille trompe-l'oeil convinces the eye these are carved stone statues of Gabriel and Mary in shallow niches — an astonishing feat of illusionistic modeling in near-monochrome.
works.title: Annunciation
