works.caption: Friedrich buries a thatched hut beneath snow-laden gorse and pollarded willows, their gnarled black branches clawing at a flat, colorless sky in a bleak meditation on mortality.
works.title: Snowy cottage

works.caption: Cézanne's bather stands stiffly on a riverbank, his blocky, faceted flesh built from planes of blue and ochre that dissolve the horizon into pure structure.
works.title: The Bather

works.caption: Bryullov stages Pompeii's final hours as operatic catastrophe — collapsing statuary, a blood-red sky, and marble-pale bodies scattered across the paving in theatrical, sculptural poses.
works.title: The Last Day of Pompeii

works.caption: A startled Diana shields herself as Actaeon stumbles upon her bathing nymphs beneath a grand ruined arch — Titian's late poesie at its most sensuous and dramatically charged.
works.title: Diana and Actaeon

works.caption: Christ hangs alone against an unbroken black void, arms taut, blood tracing thin lines down pale, immaculately modeled flesh — Velázquez at his most austere and devastating.
works.title: Christ Crucified

works.caption: Manet surrounds a seated Zola with a Japanese screen, a print of Olympia, and an open book — a portrait of modern taste as much as of the sitter's dark, absorbed profile.
works.title: Portrait of Emile Zola

works.caption: A silver-armored knight on a rearing white horse drives his lance into a coiling dragon while a princess flees — Raphael's small panel compresses maximum drama into minimum space.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: Lictors bear the executed sons' bodies past a grieving mother and sisters while the stony consul Brutus sits apart in shadow — David's stark chiaroscuro and rigid staging turn Roman virtue to ice.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lictors Bring to Brutus the Bodies of His Sons

works.caption: A young Madonna presses her cheek to a wriggling infant Christ against a luminous blue sky — Raphael's tender intimacy and clear color make this a quietly perfect devotional image.
works.title: Tempi Madonna

works.caption: A red-robed cardinal's pale, watchful face and folded hands emerge from deep shadow — Raphael's austere palette concentrates all attention on the sitter's guarded intelligence.
works.title: Portrait of a Cardinal

works.caption: A dandy shields a seated majas from the sun beneath a green parasol while her lapdog naps on her skirts — Goya's tapestry cartoon captures Madrid's fashionable leisure with buoyant color.
works.title: The Parasol

works.caption: Judith stands serenely over Holofernes's severed head, one bare leg propped on the trophy — Giorgione's soft sfumato and pastoral backdrop drain the violence into quiet lyricism.
works.title: Judith

works.caption: Nude bathers, dancers, and lovers populate a flattened arcadia of impossible orange and green — Matisse's radical simplification of form and color announced a new century of painting.
works.title: The Joy of Life

works.caption: Europa is lifted onto a garlanded white bull as putti scatter overhead — Tiepolo's cool blues and airy, theatrical staging turn abduction into weightless spectacle.
works.title: The Rape of Europa

works.caption: Mary and Elizabeth embrace on a garden path before an elaborate Flemish townscape, van der Weyden's crimson and blue drapery and fine architectural detail rewarding close study.
works.title: Visitation

works.caption: Turner dissolves a distant harbor town into swirling light and smoke, birds scattering across a churned, luminous sky that overwhelms the small architectural anchor below.
works.title: Quillebeuf, Mouth of the Seine

works.caption: Dürer stares out frontally in a Christ-like pose, fur collar and flowing curls rendered with obsessive precision against pure black.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Fur-Trimmed Robe

works.caption: A serpentine nude drifts through Klimt's mosaic of gold spirals and jeweled patterning, skin rendered smooth against the ornamental chaos.
works.title: The Hydra

works.caption: A tondo of interlocking golden-haired angels and Madonna, the crowning gesture and the child's grasping hand forming a taut circular rhythm.
works.title: Madonna of the Magnificat

works.caption: Courbet dignifies humble labor: the arc of the sieve and the drowsy sorter's plate anchor a study of rural work rendered with sculptural weight.
works.title: The Wheat Sifters

works.caption: Bosch fills the riverbank with strange incident — a hermit fishing from a barrel-house, a bear up a pole — while the giant saint wades through with the Christ child.
works.title: Saint Christopher Carrying the Christ Child

works.caption: A crush of grotesque, jeering faces packs the panel edge to edge, Christ's serene downcast eyes the sole point of stillness amid the mockery.
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: Adam and Eve flank the tree in cool, unsparing Northern light, the serpent rendered as a lizard-tailed woman offering the apple.
works.title: Vienna Diptych

works.caption: A vast wooded crowd of listeners in exotic dress presses toward the preacher, Bruegel using the forest clearing to stage a panorama of humanity.
works.title: The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Two peasants pause at dusk over a basket of potatoes, heads bowed in silent prayer as a distant church spire catches the last light.
works.title: The Angelus

works.caption: A ghostly old warship is towed to its end by a soot-black steam tug, the sunset dissolving sky and water into blazing, elegiac color.
works.title: The Fighting Temeraire

works.caption: Rembrandt buries the tense banquet in shadow, gold light picking out Esther's jeweled crown and Haman's slumped, doomed posture.
works.title: Ahasuerus and Haman at the Feast of Esther

works.caption: A cobalt-blue horse fills the canvas edge to edge, its curves echoed by rainbow hills — Marc's color-as-emotion system at its purest.
works.title: Blue Horse I

works.caption: Candlelight rakes across Samson's slumped, muscular back as the barber snips his hair, soldiers already massing in the doorway behind him.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: The infant twists to study a butterfly perched on his own hand, Mary's translucent veil and downward gaze giving the pair quiet intimacy.
works.title: Mary and Child

works.caption: Altdorfer dwarfs the biblical bathing scene beneath a fantastical tiered palace, turning a minor Susanna into an excuse for architectural spectacle.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: Maddalena Doni's calm oval face and jeweled pendant sit against a hazy Tuscan valley, Raphael steadying Leonardo's sfumato into crisp clarity.
works.title: Portrait of Maddalena Doni

works.caption: An angel cradles the swooning saint in near-total darkness, a single shaft of light isolating their entwined faces from the void.
works.title: Saint Francis of Assisi in Ecstasy

works.caption: A gypsy fortune-teller reads the young dandy's palm while, unnoticed by him, she slides the ring from his finger — Caravaggio's sly street theater.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Fortune Teller

works.caption: Pope Leo X studies an illuminated manuscript through a magnifying glass, the crimson velvet and gold finial rendered with tactile precision.
works.title: Portrait of Leo X

works.caption: A bare-shouldered youth offers up an overflowing basket of fruit, its bruised leaves and swollen grapes painted with startling immediacy.
works.title: Boy with a Basket of Fruit

works.caption: Madame Récamier reclines barefoot on her neoclassical daybed, the austere setting and her plain white gown distilled to pure linear elegance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Madame Récamier

works.caption: Slender blossoming trees stand against a fence and cypresses under a stippled sky, spring light rendered in van Gogh's dense, textured touch.
works.title: Orchard with Peach Trees in Blossom

works.caption: A single mulberry tree erupts into flame-like yellow foliage against violet sky, its gnarled trunk twisting with the same restless energy as the leaves.
works.title: The Mulberry Tree

works.caption: Massive plane-tree trunks writhe and swell across the canvas, road menders and roadside stones dwarfed beneath their twisting autumnal canopy.
works.title: The Large Plane Trees (Road Menders at Saint-Rémy)

works.caption: Degas charts a family's estrangement through posture alone: the mother's rigid stance, the isolated father in his armchair, the daughters caught between them.
works.title: The Bellelli Family

works.caption: A lark rises above windblown wheat, its tiny silhouette the only incident in a canvas otherwise given over to rippling gold brushstrokes.
works.title: Wheat Field with a Lark

works.caption: A young woman at the virginal glances over her shoulder, a Cupid painting on the wall behind her hinting at the subject of the music.
works.title: A Young Woman Standing at a Virginal

works.caption: A boy fifer in a red-and-black military uniform stands flatly lit against bare gray, Manet stripping away all depth cues but the figure itself.
works.title: The Fif

works.caption: Seven acts of charity collapse into one nocturnal street scene, plunging angels overhead as torchlight picks out a tangle of Naples's poor.
works.title: The Seven Works of Mercy

works.caption: Elisabetta Gonzaga's pale, still face is set against a blue Umbrian landscape, a small scorpion brooch pinned oddly at her hairline.
works.title: Portrait of Elisabetta Gonzaga

works.caption: Saint Catherine leans against her spiked breaking-wheel, sword and palm frond resting on a crimson cushion, lit with Caravaggio's raking clarity.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: David holds Goliath's severed head at arm's length, his sorrowful downcast eyes at odds with the trophy — thought to bear Caravaggio's own likeness.
works.title: David with the Head of Goliath

works.caption: The weathered waterseller hands a glass to a boy, the huge glazed jugs in the foreground rendered with almost sculptural gravity in raking light.
works.title: The Waterseller of Seville

works.caption: The magi present their gifts before crumbling classical ruins, a distant hilltop city and a beetle in the foreground adding Dürer's obsessive detail.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Warm, close-cropped intimacy binds Joseph, Mary, and the wriggling Christ Child into a single triangular knot of gesture and gaze.
works.title: Madonna with Beardless Saint Joseph

works.caption: A pink froth of silk swings out over a stunned suitor's upturned face, Fragonard turning courtly flirtation into pure, glinting motion.
works.title: The Swing

works.caption: Saint Jerome's book and the boy's fish frame a monumental, calmly enthroned Madonna, the drapery falling in the broad, sculptural folds of Raphael's Roman years.
works.title: Madonna with the Fish

works.caption: A cool, arithmetic light falls evenly across walnut tree, standing Christ, and distant hills, Piero's geometry turning a river baptism into something close to architecture.
works.title: The Baptism of Christ

works.caption: A serpent coils twice around Simonetta's bare throat while her elaborate braided hair rhymes with the storm clouds behind her, allegory dressed as portraiture.
works.title: Portrait of Simonetta Vespucci

works.caption: The cardinal's saturated red robes fill the canvas edge to edge, a distant riverside villa glimpsed through the archway offering the only relief from the color.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Alessandro Farnese

works.caption: A churning, nationalist battlefield panorama crowds hundreds of clashing knights and horses into a single sweeping frieze of violence.
works.title: Battle of Grunwald

works.caption: A hazy, golden river valley opens far beyond a wedding party small enough to nearly vanish into Claude's idealized Roman campagna.
works.title: Landscape with the Marriage of Isaac and Rebecca

works.caption: A single half-open rose and a plain silver cup sit on a pewter plate against pure darkness, Zurbarán distilling devotion into austere still life.
works.title: A Cup of Water and a Rose in a Plate of Silver

works.caption: Straining bodies haul Christ's cross skyward across three panels, Rubens turning the altarpiece's diagonal thrust into raw physical effort.
works.title: The Elevation of the Cross

works.caption: Christ buckles beneath the cross's weight as mounted soldiers and grieving women crowd in from every side, Raphael's late style turning to compressed, anxious drama.
works.title: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary

works.caption: Two damned souls grapple nude and mid-air while Dante and Virgil look on, Bouguereau rendering academic anatomy at its most theatrical and infernal.
works.title: Dante and Virgil in Hell

works.caption: Titian, near death, built his own funerary chapel in paint, thick, smoky brushwork dissolving flesh and stone alike into the same grieving twilight.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: Four bear cubs clamber over a fallen pine in the milky light of dawn, Shishkin's dense forest becoming one of Russian painting's most beloved images.
works.title: Morning in a Pine Forest

works.caption: A great white shroud catches the falling body of Christ as it is lowered diagonally across the panel, Rubens's baroque triptych at its most physically charged.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: A ballerina's painted image floats above the bar in the mirror behind two drinkers, Manet fragmenting a Parisian café-concert into overlapping planes.
works.title: Corner of a Café-Concert

works.caption: A top-hatted aristocrat stands in cool, understated grey against a paneled wall, Sargent letting the riding crop and gloved hand do the talking.
works.title: Lord Ribblesdale

works.caption: Velázquez sets the Habsburg king's pale, mustachioed face and heavy gold chain against near-total darkness, courtly grandeur reduced to essentials.
works.title: Philip IV of Spain

works.caption: A winged angel bearing a chalice descends toward a kneeling, luminous Christ, El Greco elongating the rocky garden into currents of nervous, upward energy.
works.title: The Agony in the Garden

works.caption: Thirty-two nearly identical soup cans, each labeled with a different flavor, turn supermarket repetition into a landmark statement on mass production and art.
works.title: Campbell's Soup Cans

works.caption: A blind, ragged Belisarius extends his helmet for alms as a former soldier recoils in recognition, David staging Stoic dignity amid public humiliation.
works.title: Belisarius Begging for Alms

works.caption: A jowled, bejeweled old woman offers a rosebud with startling directness, Massys's grotesque satire of vanity later immortalized as Tenniel's Duchess.
works.title: The Ugly Duchess

works.caption: Two barefoot pilgrims kneel at a doorway before the Madonna and Child, Caravaggio's stark tenebrism collapsing the sacred into an ordinary Roman street.
works.collection: Basilica of Saint Augustine in Campo Marzio
works.title: Madonna di Loreto

works.caption: The Holy Family and infant Saint John gather in a loose pyramid before a luminous Tuscan landscape, Raphael balancing tender domesticity with High Renaissance order.
works.title: Canigiani Holy Family

works.caption: A red-clad young man rests a peach in his palm and turns his gaze slightly off-axis, Raphael's Florentine portraiture at its most quietly self-assured.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man with an Apple

works.caption: The angel's wind-caught robes and the Virgin's swooning recoil charge this Annunciation with unusual physical urgency, a late Botticelli painted after Savonarola's influence took hold.
works.title: Cestello Annunciation

works.caption: Saint Jerome leans hard into an open book, his sunlit torso and bald head modeled with sculptural precision against Caravaggio's characteristic darkness.
works.title: Saint Jerome

works.caption: The Christ Child's bare foot crushes a serpent's head as Mary and Anne look on, Caravaggio grounding theology in the weight of real, aging flesh.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Saint Anne

works.caption: A tiny scholar reads at his desk inside a vast, architecturally exact study, Antonello's Netherlandish precision making solitude itself the subject.
works.title: Saint Jerome in His Study

works.caption: David holds his own severed head at arm's length, Caravaggio's late self-portrait as Goliath turning triumph into an act of confession.
works.title: David with the Head of Goliath

works.caption: A young woman slumps asleep in a chair, her pearls and perfume bottle scattered at her feet, Caravaggio finding penitence in exhausted, unguarded stillness.
works.title: Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: Four leering tormentors close in around Christ's serene, unmoving face, Bosch using grotesque caricature to sharpen the contrast with quiet suffering.
works.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns

works.caption: The future Pope Urban VIII gestures with easy authority from his chair, Caravaggio's early patron captured with unusual warmth and directness.
works.title: Portrait of Maffeo Barberini, later Pope Urban VIII

works.caption: Dappled sunlight breaks across the white dresses as Monet builds shadow entirely from color rather than tone; the empty foreground of grass anchors the whole composition.
works.title: Women in the Garden

works.caption: The satin dress catches light in long unbroken strokes, its brightness set against the near-black background so the reclining pose reads instantly.
works.title: The Clothed Maja

works.caption: Goya paints his own ashen, half-collapsed face held upright by the doctor's steady grip, the inscription below turning the canvas into an act of gratitude.
works.title: Self-portrait with Dr Arrieta

works.caption: Gold and jewels pile at the Virgin's feet as the elderly king kneels bareheaded before the Christ child, every fabric rendered with the crisp specificity of Netherlandish oil technique.
works.title: Monforte Altarpiece

works.caption: The mirror shows a face rather than a reflection of the pose we see, a deliberate contradiction that turns Cupid's ribbon-tying into the picture's real subject.
works.title: Rokeby Venus

works.caption: A hard, coin-like profile set against pure black lets Piero's obsessive rendering of the brocade collar and cropped bowl haircut carry the whole portrait.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta

works.caption: A drift of rose petals nearly swallows the reclining feasters below while the emperor watches from the terrace, Alma-Tadema rendering thousands of individual petals with obsessive marble-smooth precision.
works.title: The Roses of Heliogabalus

works.caption: A black parasol throws deep shade across her face while the trailing black sash cuts a diagonal through the white dress, Renoir already fusing Salon polish with plein-air light.
works.title: Lise with a Parasol

works.caption: The sitter's steady gaze anchors a sweeping hilltop panorama behind her, the red sash and striped dress giving Bazille's careful naturalism a jolt of color.
works.title: View of the Village

works.caption: A profile assembled entirely from candle, flint, cannon and burning kindling, the wit of Arcimboldo's composite portraiture holding up under close, sustained looking.
works.title: The allegory of Fire

works.caption: Fish, coral, crab and octopus interlock into a single profiled head, a pearl earring the only note of stillness in this teeming, wet-eyed assembly.
works.title: The allegory of Water

works.caption: Mosaic-tiled halos frame her head against a burning orange ground while the patterned upholstery below dissolves into pure abstract ornament, Klimt fusing portraiture with decoration at its peak.
works.title: Fritza Riedler

works.caption: Three generations of raw, mottled flesh huddle against a black void, the crouching child at the base grounding Schiele's usually jagged eroticism into something tender and grave.
works.title: The Family

works.caption: A pilfering Cupid begs sympathy from a coyly posed Venus beneath a laden apple tree, Cranach's elongated nude rendered with jewelry-like precision against a fantastical rocky backdrop.
works.title: Cupid Complaining to Venus

works.caption: Bronzino renders black armor with metallic exactitude, the sitter's imposing beard and cool stare set off by a slash of violet drapery.
works.title: Portrait of Stefano Colonna

works.caption: A packed amphitheater watches in hushed attention as Dr. Agnew presides over an operation, Eakins staging clinical realism as high drama through a single shaft of light.
works.title: The Agnew Clinic

works.caption: A wedding party crosses a glassy fjord dwarfed by snow-capped peaks, Tidemand staging Norwegian folk costume against an almost geological grandeur of light and rock.
works.title: Bridal Procession on the Hardangerfjord

works.caption: Peter's tender gesture meets Paul's steady, sword-bearing gaze, El Greco pushing saturated rose, green, and ochre drapery into near-abstract folds against a stormy sky.
works.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul

works.caption: Marie de' Medici descends a gilded gangway amid trumpeting Fame and a churning tangle of sea nymphs and tritons, Rubens fusing state pageantry and mythological spectacle at full Baroque throttle.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Disembarkation at Marseilles

works.caption: Snow-dusted red roofs push through bare winter trees, Pissarro building the hillside village from short, deliberate strokes that read as pure structure from a distance.
works.title: The Red Roofs, Côte Saint-Denis at Pontoise, Winter Effect

works.caption: A young woman glances back over a shoulder wrapped in a loosely brushed floral shawl, Klimt dissolving her figure into the same teal darkness that swallows the background.
works.title: Portrait of a Lady

works.caption: A writhing mass of the damned tumbles through a hellscape of fire and monstrous hybrids beneath Christ enthroned in judgment, Bosch's triptych a nightmare inventoried with obsessive, miniature precision.
works.title: Last Judgement

works.caption: The Annunciation unfolds in a meticulously furnished Flemish parlor flanked by kneeling donors and a carpenter at his bench, Campin's obsessive still-life detail turning a domestic room into sacred space.
works.title: Mérode Altarpiece

works.caption: A couple lounges on a sailboat before a hazy industrial river, Manet's crisp stripes and blunt outlines giving a leisure scene an oddly modern, graphic flatness.
works.title: Argenteuil

works.caption: Saint Luke sketches the nursing Virgin in a richly appointed interior, van der Weyden opening a deep townscape view through the arched loggia behind them.
works.title: Saint Luke Drawing the Virgin

works.caption: Shafts of light rake across a tiled hammam where bathers linger by a pool, Gerome rendering marble, carpet, and skin with near-photographic polish.
works.title: Pool in a Harem

works.caption: David steadies a mahlstick and palette while fixing the viewer with a level, appraising stare, the plain ochre wall keeping all attention on the face.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: A broad-brimmed hat throws the face into shadow while a painted nude glows in the background, Gauguin folding a self-portrait and a fragment of his own work into one flattened composition.
works.title: Self-portrait with hat

works.caption: Two mysterious circles float on the wall behind an aging Rembrandt, his loaded brush and appraising eyes turning old age and craft itself into the picture's real subject.
works.title: Self Portrait with Two Circles

works.caption: A crimson dressing gown consumes the canvas as Dr. Pozzi grips its collar and points, Sargent turning a single saturated color into pure theatrical presence.
works.title: Dr. Pozzi at Home

works.caption: Washington's face is fully resolved in warm, exacting detail while his coat dissolves into a blank, unfinished ground, Stuart's incomplete canvas becoming the most reproduced image of the president.
works.title: Athenaeum Portrait

works.caption: Reni's Saint Sebastian turns martyrdom into pure luminous form — note the pale, softly modeled torso against the black tree trunk and stormy sky.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Reni's second Saint Sebastian repeats the upward gaze and bound wrists with even cooler, moonlit modeling against a dense nocturnal grove.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Titian's late allegory pairs an armored, flag-bearing Spain with a cowering nude Religion beside a serpent-wound tree, smoke and burning ships filling the distance.
works.title: Religion saved by Spain

works.caption: Velázquez lavishes his finest brushwork on the queen's gold-embroidered riding habit and the caparisoned white horse's tack, set against a wide silvery sky.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Elisabeth of France

works.caption: Franz Marc shatters two foxes into faceted red, blue, and green planes, the crystalline Cubist-Expressionist fracturing intensifying rather than obscuring the animals' alertness.
works.title: The Foxes

works.caption: Beached fishing boats in candy-bright red, blue, and yellow sit on tawny sand while van Gogh's restless, wind-blown brushstrokes animate sea and sky alike.
works.title: Fishing Boats on the Beach at Les Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer

works.caption: Metsys crams a moneylender's counter with meticulously rendered coins, scales, and a convex mirror, while his wife's attention drifts from her prayer book to the gold.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Moneylender and his Wife

works.caption: Rubens groups four scholars and himself around a book-piled table, the draped red curtain and a marble philosopher's bust framing their intent, individualized faces.
works.title: The Four Philosophers

works.caption: Late Titian at his loosest: Diana looses an arrow at the transforming Actaeon in a dusky forest built from smeared, half-dissolved brushwork.
works.title: The Death of Actaeon

works.caption: Manet reduces Morisot to essentials — dark, slashing hat ribbons and a black coat against a bare gray ground, her steady gaze the only warm note.
works.title: Berthe Morisot with a Bouquet of Violets

works.caption: Veronese opens a colonnaded courtyard behind a swooning woman in shimmering blue-gray silk, an elder in gold-trimmed crimson leaning in beside a classical statue.
works.collection: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon
works.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath

works.caption: Gentileschi crowns her Catherine in gleaming metal and sets her against near-total darkness, the saint's rich red-and-gold robe catching every drop of light.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: A wide-winged Gabriel gestures upward toward a burst of golden cloud and dove while Mary presses a hand to her chest, Gentileschi's dark ground making the lily and light glow.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: Matisse splits his wife's face with a raw green shadow-stripe, letting flat fields of pink, orange, and teal stand in for modeled light.
works.title: Green Stripe

works.caption: O'Keeffe magnifies an iris into a near-abstract chasm of velvety black and cool violet-white folds that read as pure sculptural form.
works.title: Black Iris

works.caption: A lone rider on horseback faces the colossal weathered head of the Sphinx across an empty desert, Gérôme's crystalline light flattening the vast scale into silence.
works.collection: California Department of Parks and Recreation
works.title: Bonaparte Before the Sphinx

works.caption: Ingres dresses Bonaparte in vivid orange-red velvet against a cool gray interior, a distant cathedral glimpsed through the drawn curtain behind him.
works.title: Bonaparte, First Consul

works.caption: Gros stages Napoleon touching a plague sore beneath a horseshoe-arched courtyard, sunken bodies and mourning figures crowding the shadowed foreground while a minaret glows in the distance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bonaparte Visiting the Plague Victims of Jaffa

works.caption: Filippo Lippi surrounds a kneeling, praying Virgin with a dense gilded forest, God the Father radiating gold rays down through a dove onto the naked Christ child among wildflowers.
works.title: Adoration in the Forest

works.caption: Degas crops a bather curled tightly over her round tin tub, the pastel's chalky oranges and blues catching the awkward, unposed twist of her spine.
works.title: The Tub

works.caption: Mondrian trades his black grid for pulsing rows of yellow, red, and blue squares, the syncopated rhythm evoking Manhattan traffic and jazz alike.
works.title: Broadway Boogie Woogie

works.caption: Potter renders a young bull's individual hairs and the sheep dozing at its feet with near-photographic precision beneath an enormous cloud-piled Dutch sky.
works.title: The Bull

works.caption: A host of tumbling cherubs and a shaft of divine light erupt above the kneeling angel and startled Virgin, late Titian dissolving the upper half into pure golden smoke.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: Modigliani elongates a seated nude's limbs and almond eyes, her flat peach flesh set against a dark wine-red door panel.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Seated Nude

works.caption: Kandinsky flattens a Bavarian village into blocky planes of emerald, coral, and cobalt, the church steeple's rainbow facets pushing the scene toward pure abstraction.
works.title: Church at Murnau

works.caption: Monet dissolves a crowded Paris boulevard into flickering dabs of ochre and gray, bare winter trees and a sea of tiny figures receding into golden haze.
works.title: Carnaval Boulevard des Capucines

works.caption: Canaletto turns a workaday Venetian building site into crystalline theater, sunlit stone facades and a distant campanile framing tiny figures at their chores.
works.title: The Stonemason's Yard

works.caption: Goya sets a bullfighter's mistress in a shimmering rose-and-gold mantilla against near-total darkness, her direct gaze the sole point of psychological heat.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: La Tirana

works.caption: Delacroix's bare-breasted Liberty strides over the barricade with tricolor and musket raised, fallen bodies in the foreground grounding the allegory in real violence.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Liberty Leading the People

works.caption: David poses the young sisters in bee-embroidered crimson velvet, their bejeweled tiaras and locked arms conveying quiet dynastic intimacy against a bare olive wall.
works.title: Portrait of the Sisters Zénaïde and Charlotte Bonaparte

works.caption: Kirchner stacks five angular, sharp-faced streetwalkers in acid green and near-black, their elongated silhouettes turning a city sidewalk into a jagged frieze.
works.title: Five Women on the Street

works.caption: Manet catches Monet at his easel inside a floating studio, loose blue-green brushwork on the water echoing the painter's own broken touch.
works.title: Claude Monet painting in his studio boat

works.caption: Goya's charging Mamluk cavalry cuts diagonally through a chaos of raised sabres and sprawled bodies, the white horse's rearing form the fulcrum of the massacre.
works.title: The Second of May 1808

works.caption: Kandinsky's largest canvas detonates into overlapping arcs and jagged black lines, color fields colliding without a single stable form.
works.title: Composition VII

works.caption: Géricault's cuirassier staggers down a smoke-lit slope, his rearing horse and glinting armor turning a battlefield retreat into monumental Romantic drama.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Wounded Cuirassier

works.caption: Stubbs isolates the rearing chestnut against a bare ochre ground, every muscle and gleam of coat rendered with an anatomist's precision that turns a horse portrait into pure sculpture.
works.title: Whistlejacket

works.caption: Raphael sets the young duke's guarded gaze and black velvet bulk against a luminous Umbrian view glimpsed through a window, the contrast sharpening his gravity.
works.title: Portrait of Guidobaldo da Montefeltro

works.caption: Turner bathes Carthage's founding in a hazy golden sun that dissolves architecture and water alike, classical ruin and myth held together by light alone.
works.title: Dido building Carthage

works.caption: A boy in scarlet holds a magpie on a string while watchful cats and caged finches crowd the shadows, Goya turning a child's portrait into a quiet meditation on vulnerability.
works.title: Don Manuel Osorio de Zuniga

works.caption: Delacroix stages the Crusaders' entry as a wall of banners and armored horsemen advancing over the fallen, Constantinople burning under a vast panoramic sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Entry of the Crusaders in Constantinople

works.caption: Fra Angelico sets a tender Madonna and child against a shimmering gold diaper pattern, flanking angel-musicians below adding a hushed, chapel-like intimacy.
works.title: Madonna of Humility

works.caption: Velázquez sets the young king's plumed silhouette against an open Spanish sierra, the golden-caparisoned horse's raised foreleg the whole picture's pivot.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Philip IV

works.caption: Eckersberg frames a sunlit Roman skyline through three ruined Colosseum arches, weeds and tumbled stone in the foreground grounding the view in observed fact.
works.title: A View through Three of the North-Western Arches of the Third Storey of the Coliseum

works.caption: Ingres reduces the bather to a single unbroken curve of back and thigh, the striped turban and patterned linens the only incident against bare flesh.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Valpinçon Bather

works.caption: A lone figure surveys a sea of fog breaking over jagged peaks, Friedrich's Rückenfigur turning the sublime landscape into pure contemplative silence.
works.title: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog

works.caption: Delacroix fixes the orphan's tear-bright, startled eyes against a pale cemetery sky, grief rendered with startling psychological immediacy.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Orphan Girl at the Cemetery

works.caption: Sunlight streams through leafy shade onto a raised champagne toast, Krøyer catching the exact flicker of dappled light across white linen and clinking glasses.
works.title: Hip, Hip, Hurrah!

works.caption: Campin's donor wings flank a domestic Annunciation of astonishing material detail, firelight and a distant landscape glimpsed through leaded windows.
works.title: Werl Triptych

works.caption: Ingres drowns Madame Moitessier in floral silk and mirrored reflection, her cool, appraising gaze anchoring an almost overwhelming density of pattern and jewelry.
works.title: Madame Moitessier

works.caption: Cézanne locks Pierrot and Harlequin's diamond-patterned costumes into rigid architectural planes, a curtain's zigzag folds echoing their stiff theatrical stride.
works.title: Mardi Gras

works.caption: Two silhouetted figures pause beneath gnarled, moss-hung branches to watch a pale crescent moon, Friedrich turning a quiet gesture into a hushed, private communion.
works.title: Man and Woman contemplating the moon

works.caption: The young Velázquez sets Mary's pink and midnight-blue robes glowing against roiling silver-grey clouds, her downcast eyes lending stillness to the vision.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception

works.caption: Grünewald sets a tender, luminous Madonna and child beneath a rainbow and a burst of angelic light, an oddly Gothic-fantastical city rising behind her.
works.collection: Church of the Coronation of Mary, Stuppach
works.title: Stuppach Madonna

works.caption: Deep blue iris clumps march across gold-leaf panels in flattened, decorative rhythm — Korin's design sense at its most concentrated.
works.title: Irises screen

works.caption: Christ and the apostles gather around a tiled Flemish dining room in the central Last Supper panel, flanked by narrative wings of Old Testament prefigurations rendered with jewel-like precision.
works.title: Triptych: The Last Supper

works.caption: Caravaggio catches the instant of recognition — an apostle's arms flung wide, a basket of fruit teetering at the table's edge, light raking hard across startled faces.
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: A crowned, blind Homer receives his laurel from a winged Victory before a Greek temple, ringed by a pantheon of poets and artists in Ingres's cool, sculptural line.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Apotheosis of Homer

works.caption: A garish carnival crowd of masked, leering faces surges beneath a banner reading VIVE LA SOCIALE — Ensor's caustic, prophetic vision of mob society in raw color.
works.title: Christ's Entry Into Brussels in 1889

works.caption: The crowned Virgin sits enthroned in a bower of climbing roses, ringed by music-making angels against a shimmering gold ground — late Gothic tenderness at its most refined.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose Bower

works.caption: The small Infanta stands rigid in an elaborate pink-and-silver gown beside a flower vase, Velazquez's loaded brush turning lace and ribbon into shimmering abstraction.
works.title: Infanta Margarita Teresa

works.caption: A ribbon of moonlight burns green across a black river beneath a heavy, glowing sky — Kuindzhi's uncanny luminosity still startles.
works.title: Moonlit Night on the Dnieper

works.caption: A laughing young woman in a loosened white blouse turns toward the viewer, Hals's slashing, confident brushwork capturing an unguarded moment of mirth.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Gipsy Girl

works.caption: A dark silhouetted figure charms snakes from the reeds under a full moon, a pink ibis watching from the bank — Rousseau's dreamlike jungle at its most hypnotic.
works.title: La encantadora de serpientes

works.caption: Couples turn slowly across a moonlit shoreline lawn, a woman in white, red, and black repeated as youth, passion, and mourning — Munch's allegory of love's life cycle.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Dance of Life

works.caption: Napoleon presents the eagle standards to his assembled army beneath a vast tented pavilion, David's sea of raised arms and banners choreographed with theatrical precision.
works.title: The Distribution of the Eagle Standards

works.caption: A severed head rests on a white pillow beside red hibiscus blossoms, mourners and a carved idol behind — Gauguin's most unsettling Tahitian symbolist canvas.
works.title: The Royal End

works.caption: The Virgin and Child are flanked by the two Saint Johns amid a bower of lilies and flowering shrubs, Botticelli's line as taut and musical as ever.
works.title: Madonna Bardi

works.caption: The Christ Child clambers affectionately against his mother's shoulder, Raphael's soft sfumato modeling and warm color giving the pair unforced tenderness.
works.title: The Madonna and Child (The Mackintosh Madonna)

works.caption: An old woman in a ruffled bonnet stares out with bloodshot, unsettled eyes — Gericault's clinical, unflinching study of mental illness still reads as startlingly modern.
works.collection: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon
works.title: Insane Woman

works.caption: The mountain's craggy bulk dominates a patchwork valley of red-roofed farms, Cezanne building the whole scene from faceted, interlocking planes of color.
works.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire seen from Bellevue

works.caption: The angel-musicians' lutes and the birdlike detachment of the crumbling shed roof anchor Piero's serene geometry; note the pale, crystalline Tuscan light unifying every figure.
works.title: The Nativity

works.caption: The gutted ray, hung like a grotesque mask, anchors Chardin's meditation on ordinary kitchen matter; watch how the startled cat's arched back animates an otherwise still, silvery composition.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Ray

works.caption: The queen's enormous silver-and-black guardainfante dominates the canvas; Velázquez lavishes his loosest, most brilliant brushwork on the lace and ribbon rather than the impassive young face.
works.title: Portrait of Mariana of Austria

works.caption: The child rider's stiff formality contrasts with the loose, atmospheric handling of the garden fountain and hills receding at left, a hallmark of Velázquez's late equestrian portraits.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Margarita of Austria

works.caption: Bazille turns a quiet moment of looking into the picture's real subject: note how the girl's striped dress and shadowed profile are set against the sunlit hill town she surveys.
works.title: The Pink Dress

works.caption: Monet buries the street beneath a thicket of tricolor flags, the crowd below dissolving into flickering dabs of paint that read, from a distance, as a single jubilant roar.
works.title: La Rue Montorgueil

works.caption: Raphael balances the group in a taut pyramid; the sculptural relief at lower right and the infant Baptist's raised gaze pull the eye through a chain of quiet exchanged looks.
works.title: The Holy Family

works.caption: Bosch's triptych opens from a monochrome Eden into a teeming pink-and-blue paradise of impossible fruit and coupling bodies before collapsing into the musical-instrument hell at right; look at how the middle panel's spheres and towers recur, transformed, on each side.
works.title: The Garden of Earthly Delights

works.caption: The Madonna stands wrapped in blood-red drapery inside a leafless, thorned tree hung with gilt Hebrew letters, Petrus Christus turning a devotional image into something close to a heraldic emblem.
works.title: Madonna of the Dry Tree

works.caption: A furtive kiss stolen at a half-open door is caught mid-motion, Fragonard's fluid brushwork on the woman's shimmering satin gown contrasting with the shadowed, conspiratorial doorway.
works.title: The Stolen Kiss

works.caption: Degas crops the singer in red mid-gesture against the café-concert's gaslit garden, the foreground silhouettes of top hats and a raised double bass pushing the viewer right into the crowd.
works.collection: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon
works.title: Le Café-concert aux ambassadeurs

works.caption: Van Gogh crowds a field of purple bearded irises into the foreground, their dark, curling petals set against a shimmering yellow meadow and the pale spire of Arles beyond.
works.title: View of Arles with Irises in the Foreground

works.caption: Two red-and-blue winged angels support Christ's slumped body on an ornate marble tomb, the distant hillside at right, with its three tiny crosses, quietly narrating the events just past.
works.title: Christ as the Suffering Redeemer

works.caption: Christ and God the Father lower a floral crown onto Mary's bowed head while the dove hovers above in a burst of gold light, cherub heads massing in the clouds below like a second audience.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: A soldier struggles to right the X-shaped cross while Andrew, already bound and resigned, gazes upward; Caravaggio's raking light picks out every strained tendon against near-total darkness.
works.title: The Crucifixion of Saint Andrew

works.caption: Diana's nymphs tend to her feet in a hushed, intimate service scene, a small dog watching from the rocks; Vermeer's rare mythological subject glows with his characteristic soft, enveloping light.
works.title: Diana and her Nymphs

works.caption: The boy's sly, direct smile as he embraces the ram is Caravaggio at his most disarming, flesh and fleece rendered with the same warm, tactile light against total blackness.
works.title: Young Saint John the Baptist with ram

works.caption: Sunlit laundry and hollyhocks frame a mother and child at a washtub, Manet's broken brushwork turning a chore into a shimmer of blue and white.
works.title: Laundry

works.caption: A domed temple in flawless one-point perspective anchors the ring dance of Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Perugino's calm geometry a hinge between Quattrocento and High Renaissance.
works.title: Marriage of the Virgin

works.caption: Mars and Venus preside over a garland-hung bower while nine Muses dance below, Mantegna's crisp, jewel-like linework turning myth into a stately pageant.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Parnassus

works.caption: Isaac's terrified upward glance meets Abraham's grim resolve as the angel intervenes, Caravaggio's tenebrism concentrating all drama into a knot of straining bodies.
works.title: Sacrifice of Isaac

works.caption: A suicide victim slumps across a rumpled bed, the single vivid streak of blood-red drapery the only color note in an otherwise ashen, matter-of-fact scene.
works.title: Le Suicidé

works.caption: A young man locks a bedroom door while his companion swoons across a rumpled bed, Fragonard turning a single gesture into charged rococo theater.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lock

works.caption: A wide plumed hat and a flash of red velvet frame a young woman's direct, slightly amused gaze, Rubens at his most tender and immediate.
works.title: Portrait of Susanna Lunden

works.caption: A boy in a loose smock purses his lips around a soap bubble, Manet dissolving the background into pure dark so the fragile sphere catches all the light.
works.title: Boy blowing bubbles

works.caption: Scarlet poppies scatter across a sunlit hillside as two pairs of strollers echo each other near and far, Monet's Impressionist touch at its most joyfully immediate.
works.title: The Poppy Field near Argenteuil

works.caption: Three nude models undress beside Seurat's own Grande Jatte hung on the studio wall, pointillist dots turning skin and shadow alike into shimmering mosaic.
works.title: The Models

works.caption: Two Tahitian women offer a dish of blossoms against acid greens and golds, Gauguin flattening the figures into bold, symbolic color planes.
works.title: Two Tahitian Women

works.caption: Three bejeweled nudes pose against pitch black in Cranach's cool, linear style, one saucy plumed hat the picture's only real punchline.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Three Graces

works.caption: Concentric rings of saints and angels swirl skyward above a hushed graveside gathering, Botticini's gold-filigreed heaven a dazzling contrast to the sober earth below.
works.title: Assumption of the Virgin

works.caption: Muffled travelers and their laden mule trudge through a driving blizzard, Goya's bent tree and lone spotted dog sharpening the scene's bleak, human chill.
works.title: The Snowstorm (Winter)

works.caption: Bathsheba pauses over King David's summons letter, her downcast eyes carrying the whole moral weight of the story while Rembrandt's warm flesh tones glow out of near-total darkness.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath

works.caption: Moses raises the tablets overhead in a single furious gesture, the Hebrew lettering rendered with startling precision against Rembrandt's molten, earth-toned impasto.
works.title: Moses Smashing the Tablets of the Law

works.caption: An extended family gathers on a dappled terrace beneath a chestnut tree, Bazille arranging each figure with the calm clarity of a group photograph brought to life.
works.title: Réunion de famille

works.caption: The Virgin and Child float on a luminous cloud above a gesturing Baptist and a sprawled, foreshortened Jerome, Parmigianino's elongated Mannerist figures charged with restless energy.
works.title: The Vision of Saint Jerome

works.caption: The nursing Madonna is flanked by saints and donors beneath a canopy held open by angels, van der Weyden's crisp drapery folds and quiet faces defining Early Netherlandish grace.
works.title: Medici Madonna

works.caption: A fresco roundel captures a startlingly informal moment between mother and child, Giotto's Christ tugging at Mary's veil with genuine toddler energy.
works.title: Madonna with the laughing Child

works.caption: The Christ Child reaches for his mother's bodice against a tranquil Umbrian landscape, Raphael balancing tender intimacy with serene classical composure.
works.title: Colonna Madonna

works.caption: The Madonna strides forward through parted curtains on a bed of clouds while two famously bored cherubs lean on the ledge below, Raphael's composition endlessly reproduced for good reason.
works.title: Sistine Madonna

works.caption: A single orange sun hangs over a fog-blurred harbor, Monet's rapid, sketch-like strokes giving the movement its name and Impressionism its start.
works.title: Impression, Sunrise

works.caption: Two grotesque, half-lit faces hunch over bowls of soup, Goya's Black Paintings turning a simple meal into something feral and unsettling.
works.title: Two Old Men Eating Soup

works.caption: Madame de Senonnes reclines in crimson velvet against her own mirrored reflection, Ingres rendering fabric and jewelry with cool, glassy precision.
works.title: Portrait de Madame de Senonnes

works.caption: A young Habsburg queen's frizzed auburn hair spills against a stiff fur collar, Velázquez's fluent brushwork animating an otherwise formal court portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Maria Anna of Spain, Queen of Hungary (1606-1646)

works.caption: Bathers cluster beneath an arch of leaning trees in cool blues and ochres, Cézanne flattening flesh into geometric planes that point straight toward Cubism.
works.title: Bathers (Les Grandes Baigneuses)

works.caption: Rousseau's flat, deadpan self-portrait towers over the Seine, palette in hand, framed by a toy-like fleet of signal flags and a drifting hot-air balloon.
works.title: Myself: Portrait – Landscape

works.caption: A red stag lifts its head against mist-shrouded Highland peaks, antlers spread like a crown against the pale sky.
works.title: Monarch of the Glen

works.caption: Velázquez turns a philosopher-beggar into a sly, sidelong presence, his patched cloak and cracked jug rendered with the same dignity as any court portrait.
works.title: Menippus

works.caption: Napoleon gestures across a snow-choked battlefield strewn with the dead and dying, the smoke-blackened sky pressing down on a scene of grim imperial pageantry.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Napoleon on the Battlefield of Eylau

works.caption: Skeletal oaks and a ruined Gothic window silhouette against a glowing winter sky, a funeral procession threading between graves toward the abbey's dark portal.
works.title: The Abbey in the Oakwood

works.caption: A sweeping, almost photographic panorama of the Andes builds from jungle undergrowth and a hidden waterfall up to snow-capped peaks, epic in scale and detail.
works.title: Heart of the Andes

works.caption: Fallen gladiators are dragged across a shadowy arena floor while a crowd looks on, Luna's tenebrous realism turning a spectacle of death into a monumental indictment.
works.title: Spoliarium

works.caption: A mounted officer wheels back mid-charge, sabre raised, his rearing grey horse and leopard-skin shabraque caught in a storm-lit swirl of Romantic bravura brushwork.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Charging Chasseur

works.caption: A young woman cradles Orpheus's severed head on his lyre with tender melancholy, Moreau's jeweled Symbolist detail set against a hazy Thracian coastline.
works.title: Orphés

works.caption: Philip IV turns to meet the viewer's eye in campaign dress, Velázquez's silvered brushwork on lace and armor dissolving into pure texture up close.
works.title: Portrait of Philip IV in Fraga

works.caption: Pierrot stands baggy-suited and inscrutable against a pale sky, his oversized stillness and blank gaze turning stock commedia dell'arte comedy into quiet melancholy.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Pierrot

works.caption: Vollard sits absorbed in thought, his suit and the surrounding café interior built from Cézanne's faceted, architectonic patches of ochre and slate.
works.collection: Musée des Beaux-Arts de la ville de Paris
works.title: Portrait of Ambroise Vollard

works.caption: Boch's angular, poet-pale face floats against deep ultramarine scattered with star-like flecks, van Gogh turning a portrait into a nocturne.
works.title: Portrait of Eugène Boch

works.caption: A young woman's still, appraising gaze anchors a dazzling architectural headdress of pleated white linen against flat black, van der Weyden's precision at its sharpest.
works.title: Portrait of a Young woman with a Winged Bonnet

works.caption: A Burgundian courtier in furred hat and gold-worked collar of office stares out with crystalline, pore-by-pore realism against pure black, van Eyck at his most exacting.
works.title: Portrait of Baudouin de Lannoy

works.caption: King Charles VII sits framed by drawn curtains like a relic on display, Fouquet's hard-edged clarity giving the sullen face an almost sculptural weight.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Charles VII, King of France

works.caption: Giuliano de' Medici's profile, eyes downcast, is set with crystalline clarity against a pale sky framed like a window, Botticelli's linear grace at its most refined.
works.title: Portrait of Giuliano de' Medici

works.caption: Louis XIV strikes a haughty dancer's pose beneath the coronation robes, ermine and fleur-de-lis blue engulfing him in the definitive image of absolute monarchy.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Louis XIV

works.caption: Napoleon stands rigid in laurel wreath and ermine-lined coronation robes, sceptre and hand of justice raised, David staging raw power as theatrical spectacle.
works.title: Napoleon in Imperial Costume

works.caption: Picasso's features shatter into cool grey-blue crystalline facets, Gris's analytic cubism reassembling a friend's face and palette into rigorous geometry.
works.title: Portrait of Pablo Picasso

works.caption: Margareta van Eyck meets the viewer with faint amusement beneath an elaborate horned headdress, every crimped fold of linen picked out with obsessive precision.
works.title: Portrait of Margareta van Eyck

works.caption: The young Infante Don Carlos emerges from near-total darkness, gold chain and a plumed hat the only glints against Velázquez's dominant blacks.
works.title: Portrait of the Infante Don Carlos

works.caption: Madame de Verninac sits enthroned in a klismos chair, her draped white gown and gold shawl the essence of David's classicizing Directoire elegance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Madame de Verninac

works.caption: Cardinal Bibbiena's scarlet robes swell across the canvas, a letter poised in his ringed fingers, Raphael's virtuosic handling of silk and fur set against deep green-black.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Bibbiena

works.caption: Every crease and vein of an elderly cardinal's face is rendered with unsparing van Eyck precision, red robe glowing against a deep blue-black ground.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Niccolò Albergati

works.caption: Pope Pius VII sits enthroned in gold-embroidered red velvet, David's crisp Neoclassical handling giving the pontiff's mild face an almost startling directness.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Pope Pius VII

works.caption: A garlanded goat stands alone on the salt-crusted shore of the Dead Sea, Holman Hunt's obsessive Pre-Raphaelite detail turning barren desolation into a charged religious symbol.
works.title: The Scapegoat

works.caption: A lantern-lit fishing boat crests a phosphorescent wave under a moon breaking through storm clouds, the young Turner already mastering nocturnal drama.
works.title: Fishermen at Sea

works.caption: Andromeda's chained white flesh burns against the storm-dark rocks while Perseus plunges from the top corner in a slash of red drapery — Titian's late, almost molten brushwork turns myth into pure sensation.
works.title: Perseus and Andromeda

works.caption: Two boxers collide in a single knot of slashing brushwork under the ring lights, the crowd's leering faces pressed up against the ropes — Bellows at his most kinetic.
works.title: Stag at Sharkey's

works.caption: Christ enthroned in jewel-crusted vestments holds the orb and cross-staff, flanked by choirs of angels whose brocade robes and feathered wings are rendered with Memling's obsessive Flemish precision.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Christ with singing and music-making Angels

works.caption: A girl sits rigid on the edge of her bed, her huge dark eyes fixed on the viewer while a looming shadow swells behind her — Munch turns adolescence into quiet dread.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Puberty

works.caption: Ruggiero in gleaming gold armor astride a hippogriff wheels to spear the sea-monster while Angelica's chained, luminous nude twists against dark rock — Ingres's cool linear precision made erotic.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Ruggiero Rescuing Angelica

works.caption: Two women glide in a russet-orange skiff across dappled water, Renoir dissolving the Seine's surface into flickering strokes of violet, gold, and green.
works.title: The Skiff (La Yole)

works.caption: Regatta sails lean into the breeze at Argenteuil, their cream triangles doubled in trembling reflections — Monet distilling a sailing afternoon into pure light and color.
works.title: Régates à Argenteuil

works.caption: A brooding youth turns his shoulder into shadow, his pale flesh and rumpled red cloak the only light in Caravaggio's void — tenebrism distilled to a single figure.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: The young Baptist broods over his reed cross wrapped in vivid red drapery, Caravaggio's raking light carving out muscle and fabric from an almost total darkness.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness

works.caption: Jerome sits absorbed in his books within a fantastical striated rock arch, Mantegna's obsessive stone-carving of every crag rivaling the saint himself for attention.
works.title: Saint Jerome in the desert

works.caption: A bound friar slumps unconscious in an avalanche of white drapery, the small red cross of his order the only bright note in Zurbarán's stark, silent tenebrism.
works.title: Saint Serapion

works.caption: Angular, feather-hatted women in scarlet and blue push through a crowd of dark-suited men, Kirchner's jagged Expressionist brushwork charging the Berlin street with nervous energy.
works.title: Berlin Street Scene

works.caption: Christ kneels bathed in his own inner radiance while an angel descends from darkness above — Correggio's dramatic chiaroscuro turning prayer into a private, glowing vision.
works.title: Agony in the Garden

works.caption: A grieving mother kneels over her son's flayed corpse laid out on stones scattered with skulls, a swan gliding silent on black water — Gallen-Kallela's Kalevala myth rendered with harrowing, symbolist precision.
works.title: Lemminkäinen's Mother

works.caption: Three grotesque Fates hover over a barren landscape holding a doll-like victim and a magnifying glass, Goya's murky black paintings turning fate itself into nightmare.
works.title: Atropos

works.caption: Christ hangs isolated against pure black, his body modeled with restrained, almost clinical realism — Goya stripping the crucifixion of all narrative incident but the wound and the flesh.
works.title: Christ Crucified

works.caption: Adele Bloch-Bauer dissolves into a shimmering field of gold-leaf spirals, eyes, and mosaic fragments, her pale face and hands the only naturalistic anchor in Klimt's jeweled surface.
works.title: Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I

works.caption: A masked Pierrot couple stands amid bare, spindly trees under a full moon, Rousseau's flattened naive style turning a carnival night into pure dreamlike stillness.
works.title: Carnival Evening

works.caption: A man's watchful, faintly wary gaze meets the viewer beneath an elaborate blue chaperon, van Eyck rendering every crease of starched fabric and stubbled chin with crystalline precision.
works.title: Portrait of a Man with a Blue Chaperon

works.caption: A satyr is mobbed by teasing nymphs pulling at his hair and arms in a sunlit glade, Bouguereau's polished academic nudes staging mischief as pure decorative spectacle.
works.title: Nymphs and Satyr

works.caption: Diana and a companion nymph rest after the hunt, pearl-strung and pale against a heap of blue drapery and slain game, Boucher's rococo flesh tones glowing amid the dark grove.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Diana leaving her Bath

works.caption: A coiling sea-dragon and a leaping, armored Perseus anchor a wide theatrical frieze of onlookers, musicians, and rescued captives along a luminous coastline.
works.title: Perseus Freeing Andromeda

works.caption: Velázquez confronts the fabulist head-on, his weathered face and rumpled brown robe built from loose, confident brushwork that dissolves into shadow at the edges.
works.title: Aesop

works.caption: A luminous ochre diamond floats on deep violet-black, scattered with halo-ringed circles and a gray tablet of overlapping spheres in Kandinsky's mature geometric idiom.
works.title: Accent on Pink

works.caption: Eve's raised arm and Adam's reaching hand frame the fatal apple, their monumental fleshy bodies set against a scarlet macaw and a serpent-entwined tree.
works.title: The Fall of Man

works.caption: A rickety wooden shelter shelters the Virgin and Child while a teeming procession of kings, retainers, and mounted riders spills across the hillside in vivid reds and golds.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Gilded gothic arches crown a jewel-bright procession of kings and courtiers in silk robes, their gold halos glowing against a shimmering leaf-gold ground.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A Roman sarcophagus inscribed with Latin verse serves as the manger, while a sweeping panoramic landscape of shepherds, ruins, and a distant cavalcade unfolds behind the kneeling Virgin.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Two haloed figures dissolve into jagged planes of red, blue, and yellow, Kandinsky pushing figuration toward pure chromatic abstraction with heavy black contours.
works.title: Improvisation 6 (African)

works.caption: Weary brothel women slump on a curved crimson banquette, Toulouse-Lautrec's flattened forms and acid pinks capturing their bored, unglamorous intimacy.
works.title: In the Salon at the Rue des Moulins

works.caption: A young halberdier in a plumed red cap and puffed cream doublet stares out with cool self-possession, Pontormo's sharp modeling and gold chain glinting against olive-green shadow.
works.title: Portrait of a Halberdier, Francesco Guardi?

works.caption: A radiant blue ring eclipses a void of black at the center of a swirling dark field, dozens of small circles drifting like planets around it.
works.title: Several Circles

works.caption: A star gleams above the seated nude allegorical figure, her golden compass-vessel and swirling grey drapery rendered with Artemisia's characteristic warm, fleshy modeling.
works.title: Allegory of Inclination

works.caption: A crowded host of tumbling putti frames the tender bedside scene at center, flanked by grave, monumental saints in Dürer's early triptych.
works.title: Dresden Altarpiece

works.caption: A winged Cupid reaches tenderly toward the slumbering Psyche beneath ancient oaks, van Dyck's silvery flesh tones and windswept drapery glowing against a golden dusk sky.
works.title: Amor and Psyche

works.caption: The angel's russet wings and the Virgin's crimson robe frame a deep architectural vista of domed churches and rolling hills glimpsed through twin arches.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: A rose-crowned angel offers a lily-and-blossom sprig to the Virgin, flanked by John the Baptist and Saint Andrew's great wooden cross against a luminous Tuscan hillside.
works.title: Annunciation with Saints John the Baptist and Andrew

works.caption: An ochre dog noses the grass beside two seated Tahitian women in flat planes of vermilion, gold, and green, Gauguin's Edenic color pushing the scene toward pure decorative reverie.
works.title: Arearea

works.caption: Cold steel armor engraved with foliate scrollwork and studded gold rivets encases the young duke, Bronzino's icy precision setting flesh against gleaming metal and deep blue velvet.
works.title: Portrait of Cosimo I de' Medici

works.caption: Palette in hand, Modigliani turns to face the viewer with a mask-like calm, his elongated features and rust-brown coat set against bare, sketchy studio walls.
works.collection: Museum of Contemporary Art, University of São Paulo
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Rubens presents himself with quiet gravitas beneath a broad black hat, a gloved hand resting on his sword hilt against near-total darkness broken only by his pale ruff.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Van Gogh's steady gaze cuts through a churning field of teal spirals, his auburn beard and jacket built from the same restless, rhythmic brushstrokes as the background.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: The young van Dyck leans casually against a stone plinth, his tousled hair and gleaming black satin doublet catching a soft light against a dark, undefined interior.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Van Heemskerck's weathered, close-cropped face looms beside a crumbling, vine-choked Colosseum where a tiny sketching artist records the ruin below.
works.title: Self-portrait with the Colosseum

works.caption: Rembrandt's final self-scrutiny renders his own aging face with unflinching, almost sculptural honesty against near-total darkness.
works.title: Self-Portrait at the Age of 63

works.caption: Gentileschi paints herself mid-brushstroke, torso twisted toward an unseen canvas, turning the act of painting itself into the subject.
works.title: Self-Portrait as the Allegory of Painting

works.caption: Van Dyck positions himself as equal and confidant beside his patron, the two men's clasped gesture and contrasting black-and-silver costumes anchoring an intimate double portrait.
works.title: Self-portrait with Sir Endymion Porter

works.caption: Rembrandt's steady, appraising gaze emerges from a dense weave of golden impasto in the sash and robe.
works.title: Self Portrait

works.caption: A youthful, confident Rembrandt rests his arm on a painted ledge, the broad black hat and fur collar built from thick, assured strokes.
works.title: Self-Portrait at the Age of 34

works.caption: A sprawling wine-soaked revel unfolds beneath billowing clouds, its sleeping nude nymph in the foreground among the most celebrated passages in Venetian painting.
works.title: The Bacchanal of the Andrians

works.caption: Valentin le Desosse's rubber-legged kick anchors a raucous, sketch-like crowd rendered in Toulouse-Lautrec's acid greens and loose, poster-like line.
works.title: At the Moulin Rouge, The Dance

works.caption: A waltzing couple fills the canvas, her satin gown rendered in a cascade of cool white brushwork against the man's severe black suit.
works.title: Dance in the City

works.caption: A churning mass of horses and warriors collapses off a narrow bridge into the river below, Rubens turning combat into a single explosive diagonal.
works.title: The Battle of the Amazons

works.caption: Biomorphic, cartoonish creatures drift weightlessly across a pale blue field, Kandinsky's late Paris style trading geometric abstraction for playful invented organisms.
works.title: Sky Blue

works.caption: Courbet paints himself striding confidently into the countryside to meet his patron, elevating a chance encounter to the scale and dignity of history painting.
works.title: The Meeting, or Bonjour, Monsieur Courbet!

works.caption: Van Gogh renders his shaved head against acid green, the close-cropped severity and darting brushwork a deliberate self-presentation to a rival painter.
works.title: Self-portrait, dedicated to Paul Gauguin

works.caption: A flayed ox carcass hangs starkly lit against near-black surroundings, Rembrandt finding pathos and painterly bravura in raw, unglamorous meat.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: A Slaughtered Ox

works.caption: Riders and hounds converge along sharply receding orthogonals into a dark forest, Uccello turning a night hunt into a rigorous perspective exercise.
works.title: The Hunt in the Forest

works.caption: Christ's raised arm and swirling red-blue robe cut a diagonal through a crowd of recoiling figures, El Greco's elongated forms charged with theatrical energy.
works.title: Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple

works.caption: Matisse reduces a Romanian embroidered blouse to bold black outlines and flat color against a vibrating red ground.
works.title: La Blouse Roumaine

works.caption: A pensive young man in black, hand pressed to his chest, exemplifies the soft, atmospheric sfumato associated with Giorgione's circle.
works.title: Portrait of a Youth

works.caption: A mother nurses and shelters three children at once, Andrea del Sarto's fluid drapery and warm palette elevating an allegorical subject to intimate tenderness.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Charity

works.caption: A carriage with nursing mother, driver, and dog pauses before a racecourse, Degas expanding the frame to nearly half sky in an unconventional composition.
works.title: At the Races in the Countryside

works.caption: Thatched roofs writhe under a turbulent sky, Van Gogh's late Auvers brushwork animating even the humblest cottage into a living, breathing surface.
works.title: Chaumes de Cordeville

works.caption: A lone horseman rides out of shadow into a hazy landscape, his identity and purpose left deliberately mysterious in one of Rembrandt's most enigmatic works.
works.title: The Polish Rider

works.caption: Christ breaks bread as startled monks recognize him, an all-seeing eye in a triangle glowing overhead in Pontormo's psychologically charged mannerist scene.
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: Cleopatra's head tips back in her final moment, her fleshy, illuminated body set against total darkness in Gentileschi's characteristically physical, unidealized nude.
works.title: Cleopatra

works.caption: Mourners crowd around Christ's body beneath jagged Alpine peaks and a walled city, Durer fusing Italianate figures with a meticulously observed northern landscape.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: Grief radiates through carefully choreographed haloed figures gathered around Christ's body, Fra Angelico balancing tenderness with formal clarity.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ

works.caption: An earlier, more compressed lamentation by Durer, its mourners pressed close around the body beneath a distant walled city and mountains.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: Signorelli surrounds the dead Christ with sculptural, sharply modeled mourners, a predella strip of narrative scenes running beneath the main panel.
works.title: Lamentation over the dead Christ

works.caption: Three musicians pause mid-performance, their close, shadowed grouping and psychological tension epitomizing Titian's early mastery of mood.
works.title: The Concert

works.caption: Two clothed musicians and two nude women share an idyllic meadow in one of the founding images of the pastoral genre, its poetic ambiguity endlessly debated.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Pastoral Concert

works.caption: The kneeling angel-child at left and the taut, horizontal drape of the loincloth anchor a frieze of grief staged beneath a coolly rational Renaissance loggia; Perugino balances anatomical study of the dead Christ against the stillness of his architecture.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: Two grieving angels support Christ's slack body, his half-open eyes and the thin trickle of blood at his side rendered with an almost unbearable tenderness against the flat turquoise sky.
works.title: Dead Christ Supported by Two Angels

works.caption: A luminous walled city recedes behind the cross under a double moon, mourners in saturated robes gathered at its foot in one of the most quietly devastating crucifixions of the Renaissance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Crucifixion

works.caption: Suspended alone against a vast, darkening sky, Christ's body hangs with almost unbearable stillness, the taut musculature and drooping head making this one of the most austere crucifixions in Spanish painting.
works.title: Crucifixion of Christ

works.caption: A vast panoramic landscape unfurls dozens of tiny narrative episodes from the life of Christ, walled cities and winding roads knitting the scenes into one continuous, jewel-like panorama.
works.title: Advent and Triumph of Christ

works.caption: An extravagant powdered wig and a satin gown painted in loose, silvery strokes give this sitter an air of cool self-possession that Gainsborough achieves with remarkably economical brushwork.
works.title: Portrait of a Lady in Blue

works.caption: Danaë's outstretched hand catches the golden rain while her maid gathers coins in her skirt below, Gentileschi rendering the myth with a frank, unidealized physicality rare for the period.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: A mother's weary, unidealized face anchors this tender, unsparing family group, Holbein rendering flesh and fabric with a psychological candor well ahead of its time.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist's Family

works.caption: Improbably bright pinks and acid greens swirl through a weightless huddle of mourners, Pontormo dissolving traditional gravity into one of Mannerism's most hauntingly strange masterpieces.
works.title: The Deposition from the Cross

works.caption: Four men strain to carry Christ's limp body down a dark hillside path, Titian's dramatic tonal contrast and diagonal thrust making the corpse's weight almost physically felt.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Entombment of Christ

works.caption: Figures cling to ladders in an impossible, weightless tangle around the cross, Rosso Fiorentino's harsh color and jagged poses making this one of the most radical images of the early sixteenth century.
works.collection: Pinacoteca e Museo Civico di Volterra
works.title: Descent from the Cross

works.caption: Noah's ark rides a churning flood crowded with the drowning and the desperate, Michelangelo staging catastrophe as a study in twisting, muscular bodies across the Sistine ceiling.
works.title: The Deluge

works.caption: A yellow ground erupts with slashing black diagonals and fractured planes of red and blue, Kandinsky's forms still tethered just barely to a recognizable landscape.
works.title: Picture with a Black Arch

works.caption: Bowmen hunt cormorants from gondolas on the lagoon above two elegantly bored patrician women fussing over lapdogs and pets below, Carpaccio's sharp eye for costume and incident uniting the reconstructed panel.
works.title: Two Venetian Ladies

works.caption: Bare-armed women duel with swords before a crowd of soldiers, one already sprawled in defeat, Ribera rendering the violent spectacle with unflinching, tenebrist realism.
works.title: Women Gladiators

works.caption: Two nude wrestlers lock in violent, coiled tension against a burning red sky, Pollaiuolo studying anatomy in motion with an intensity rare for its date.
works.title: Heracles and Antaeus

works.caption: A maid delivers a letter mid-sentence, catching the mistress's hand still raised to her chin, Vermeer freezing an ordinary domestic interruption in a pool of golden light against near-total darkness.
works.title: Mistress and Maid

works.caption: Dozens of tumbling putti harvest apples beneath a garlanded statue of Venus, Titian building an entire canvas from the chaotic, joyful motion of infant bodies.
works.title: The Worship of Venus

works.caption: Slashes of acid pink, teal, and vermilion turn a simple view of a harbor into a wall of pure Fauve color.
works.title: The Open Window

works.caption: Courbet casts himself as a fallen duelist, the blood-stained shirt and slack hand rendered with somber, tactile realism.
works.title: The Wounded Man

works.caption: A Flemish village buried in snow becomes a stage for dozens of tiny, bustling figures, the biblical scene almost hidden in plain sight.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The People's Census at Bethlehem

works.caption: Van Gogh sets sulfurous orange blooms against a stippled cobalt ground, the brushwork as electric as the color.
works.title: Fritillaries in a Copper Vase

works.caption: A curtain pulled back reveals a woman glowing against the dark, her expression somewhere between welcome and wariness.
works.title: A Woman in Bed

works.caption: Rembrandt's loosest, most spontaneous brushwork animates a simple moment of a woman wading and gathering her shift.
works.title: A Woman Bathing in a Stream (Hendrickje Stoffels?)

works.caption: Seurat's pointillist dots coalesce into a quiet dressing-room scene, the powder puff and mirror caught in shimmering, granular light.
works.title: Young Woman Powdering Herself

works.caption: Late Bellini at his most sensuous: a nude arranges her hair before a mirror, a distant landscape glimpsed through the window behind her.
works.title: Naked Young Woman in Front of the Mirror

works.caption: Two women pin down a struggling man and saw through his neck with brutal, unflinching physicality — one of art history's most visceral images.
works.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes

works.caption: Candlelight rakes across two women pausing mid-escape, the severed head glowing between them like a lantern.
works.title: Judith and Maidservant with Head of Holofernes

works.caption: Five maimed beggars propped on crutches and paper crowns, painted with unsparing tenderness and biting social commentary.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Beggars

works.caption: A young man in a plumed cap contemplates a skull, Hals's bravura brushwork loosening even as the memento mori sobers the mood.
works.title: Portrait of a young man with a skull

works.caption: Dancers whirl around a golden idol in Poussin's crisp, sculptural arrangement of figures, choreography as much as painting.
works.title: The Adoration of the Golden Calf

works.caption: A wild-haired child rides a black beast across a field of corpses picked at by crows, naive style making the horror stranger still.
