works.title: La Guerre

works.caption: A magnificently dressed woman in blue velvet and gold chains, Titian's brushwork luxuriating in fabric and flesh alike.
works.title: La Bella

works.caption: A garlanded hat and offered blossoms cast a mythological role over an otherwise intimate, warmly lit portrait.
works.title: Flora

works.caption: A vast panorama of Madrid's holiday crowds on the riverbank, painted with a breezy, sketch-like freedom rare for its time.
works.title: The Meadow of San Isidro

works.caption: Rubens's most intimate portrait of his wife, a fur wrap slipping from her body as she turns to meet the viewer's eye.
works.title: Helena Fourment in a Fur Robe

works.caption: Sailboats doze on a mirror-still basin beneath a huge, cloud-piled sky, Monet's brush already loosening toward Impressionism.
works.title: Le Bassin d'Argenteuil

works.caption: A couple merges into a single dark silhouette against a glowing blue window, Munch dissolving intimacy into near-abstraction.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Kiss by the Window

works.caption: A pointillist harbor scene of extraordinary stillness, the pale sky and water rendered in countless tiny, vibrating dots.
works.title: The Channel of Gravelines, Petit Fort Philippe

works.caption: Small sailboats and a distant lighthouse anchor a hazy, pastel-toned harbor built entirely from Seurat's signature stippled touch.
works.title: The Gravelines Channel, towards the sea

works.caption: A fortress crowns a wooded hill beneath towering, dramatic clouds, Ruisdael exaggerating the height for maximum grandeur.
works.title: Castle Bentheim

works.caption: A gentle, moon-faced Cyclops peers down at a sleeping nymph, Redon's strange tenderness turning myth into reverie.
works.title: The Cyclops

works.caption: A boy in workwear sits with characteristic Modigliani stillness, his almond eyes and elongated form set against flat blue.
works.title: The Little Peasant

works.caption: Degas choreographs an offstage moment — dancers stretching at the barre while onlookers wait in the wings of a grand, sunlit hall.
works.title: Dance Class at the Opera

works.caption: Van Gogh surrounds a wary young gardener with hatched strokes of green and blue, the orchard behind him vibrating with energy.
works.collection: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
works.title: Young Peasant

works.caption: Degas fills a sunlit office with clerks weighing, reading, and lounging amid mountains of raw cotton, an unusually documentary scene from him.
works.title: A Cotton Office in New Orleans

works.caption: The bridge and factories beyond dissolve into lavender fog, Monet pushing dissolution of form almost to abstraction.
works.title: Waterloo Bridge. Effect of Fog

works.caption: Look at the weary dignity in the grandmother's face and the tender huddle of bodies, painted with Daumier's loose, sculptural brushwork.
works.title: The Third-Class Carriage

works.caption: Watch how the black wedge and yellow ground collide with only whispers of figuration surviving, an early landmark of pure abstraction.
works.title: Impression lll (Concert)

works.caption: Follow the crowded tiers of saints and angels in jewel-bright robes framed by gilded Gothic arches, Lippi's crowning altarpiece.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Study the dove hovering above the crowning gesture, set within richly patterned brocade robes against a shimmering gold ground.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Take in the soaring Gothic spires and gilded pinnacles framing the central coronation, a sumptuous polyptych of gold and blue.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Weigh the kneeling donor's velvet blacks against Saint Peter's rose and gold drapery, with a harbor scene glowing behind them.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

works.caption: Notice the elongated neck and almond eyes rendered in Modigliani's signature mustard palette, quietly monumental despite its simplicity.
works.title: Jeanne Hébuterne in yellow sweater

works.caption: Watch the loose, feathery strokes that build Samary's flushed cheeks and tumbling curls against a decorative rose ground.
works.title: Portrait of the actress Jeanne Samary

works.caption: Let the eye drift from the girls' absorbed faces to the loose flowers and curtain behind them, Renoir's warm domestic intimacy at its peak.
works.title: Girls at the Piano

works.caption: Follow the crowded Venetian quayside beneath the wooden Rialto bridge, a panoramic record of the city's daily theater in miraculous detail.
works.title: Miracle of the Holy Cross at the Rialto Bridge

works.caption: Trace the coiling red trunk and branches against a saturated blue night, Mondrian on the cusp between symbolism and abstraction.
works.title: The Red Tree

works.caption: Follow the conical dunce caps and huddled sinners lit by a shaft of light before the tribunal, Goya's biting indictment of the Inquisition.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: The Inquisition Tribunal

works.caption: Notice how the dancers' legs are cropped at the top edge while the musicians' instruments and faces crowd the foreground, Degas's radical framing.
works.title: L'Orchestre de l'Opéra

works.caption: Let the countless dabs of pure color resolve into shimmering iron latticework, Seurat's pointillist ode to a brand-new landmark.
works.collection: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
works.title: The Eiffel Tower

works.caption: Scan the sunlit rehearsal room from the yawning dancer in the foreground to the old ballet master's cane, a masterclass in asymmetric composition.
works.title: The Ballet Class

works.caption: Rest on the vast horizontal calm of tidal flats and dark tree lines beneath a glowing dusk sky, Friedrich's meditation on emptiness.
works.title: The big enclosure

works.caption: Watch the terrified exorcist fling holy water at braying donkey-demons looming from the dark, Goya's nightmare rendered with dry wit.
works.title: The Bewitched Man

works.caption: Follow the swirl of loose brushwork in the woman's white gown as her companion strides ahead into dappled greenery.
works.title: La Promenade

works.caption: Watch dappled light break through the arbor onto a striped promenade dress and a gathered picnic party beyond.
works.title: Under the Arbor

works.caption: Read the absent friend's presence in a lit candle and book left on an empty chair, van Gogh's charged homage to Gauguin.
works.title: Paul Gauguin's Armchair

works.caption: Note the unguarded curve of the bather's spine, sketched in loose, urgent strokes as she pulls on a stocking.
works.title: La Toilette

works.caption: Feel the rearing horse's mane and the dragon's coiled bulk collide in a diagonal surge of Baroque violence and gleaming armor.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: Look at the wary sidelong glance and rakish top hat, Goya presenting himself brush in hand at the easel, backlit by a bright window.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: Self-portrait in the Studio

works.caption: Contrast the gaunt, weeping crone against the glowing mother and child wrapped in Klimt's mosaic of gold spirals and jeweled patterning.
works.collection: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
works.title: The Three Ages of Woman

works.caption: Follow the sinuous, sfumato-soft bodies of Leda and her attendants weaving among putti and swans in a golden grove.
works.title: Leda and the Swan

works.caption: Lose yourself in the thick, agitated impasto of blossoms and leaves crowding the whole canvas, van Gogh working at fever pitch.
works.title: Lilac Bush

works.caption: Follow the synchronized kick-line of cabaret dancers rendered in stippled dots and stylized curves, Seurat's ordered vision of modern entertainment.
works.title: Le Chahut

works.caption: Feel the physical strain of the wrestling match dwarfed by towering oaks, Delacroix's muscular late masterpiece for Saint-Sulpice.
works.title: Jacob Wrestling with the Angel

works.caption: Note the theatrical upturned gaze and glinting dagger against near-total darkness, Parmigianino's Mannerist heroine caught mid-gesture.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: Look past the beard to the tenderly cradled infant, Ribera's unflinching, dignified portrait of a bearded woman defying easy categorization.
works.title: Magdalena Ventura with Her Husband and Son

works.caption: Crane your neck up the vertiginous rope to the aerialist gripping it by her teeth, Degas's daring plunge into steep, circus-tent perspective.
works.title: Miss La La at the Cirque Fernando

works.caption: Study the crisp golden-edged halos and the child's alert upward glance against Bellini's warm marble parapet.
works.title: Lochis Madonna

works.caption: A lone tree and rolling hills open behind the green curtain, the child's downcast eyes echoing his mother's quiet gravity.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: The child's small hand rests on his mother's shoulder as their marbled, careworn faces nearly touch against unbroken darkness.
works.title: Virgin and Child

works.caption: Encrusted gold brocade, pearls, and a trompe-l'oeil fly on the marble ledge showcase Crivelli's obsessive ornamental detail.
works.collection: Victoria and Albert museum prints, drawings, & paintings collection
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: The infant's utterly limp sleep, cradled against his mother's shadowed, grave-eyed face, makes this one of Mantegna's most intimate images.
works.title: Madonna and sleeping child

works.caption: A donor couple rendered with individualized portrait realism kneels beside the Madonna, a sunlit lakeside view opening at left.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Two Donors

works.caption: Two children reach toward each other with soft, smoky sfumato modeling inside a shadowed rocky grotto.
works.title: Madonna and Child with the Young Saint John

works.caption: A flying angel crowns the gathered saints beneath a canopy of trees, the composition alive with quiet motion.
works.title: Madonna and child with Saint Catherine, Saint James the Greater, and an angel

works.caption: The Madonna's carmine sleeves billow beside a white lily as two saints, rendered with weathered gravity, look on.
works.title: Virgin and Child with Saints Jerome and Nicholas of Tolentino

works.caption: A ring of vivid red cherub heads crowns the Madonna against an open, cloud-streaked sky in one of Bellini's most iconic inventions.
works.title: Madonna of the Red Cherubim

works.caption: Two slender saplings frame a luminous river landscape behind the seated pair, their quiet exchange of glances anchoring the whole.
works.title: Madonna of the Small Trees

works.caption: Hovering angels draw back a green canopy above a marble throne crowded with saints and two dancing putti below.
works.title: Madonna of the Baldacchino

works.caption: Madonna, infant Baptist, and Joseph are drawn into a dense, unified grouping beneath deep architectural shadow.
works.title: Madonna of Divine Love

works.caption: A precisely rendered carnation and apple are held out against a flat viridian ground, Dürer's linear clarity at its sharpest.
works.title: The Madonna of the Carnation

works.caption: A garland of cherub heads strings along the marble parapet beneath slender cypress spires and a pale sky.
works.title: Madonna of the Milk

works.caption: A dense rose trellis alive with songbirds surrounds the enthroned Madonna in pure International Gothic gold.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose Garden

works.caption: A fruit-laden tree rises behind the Madonna against distant blue mountains and a walled hill town under a wide sky.
works.title: Madonna of the Orange Tree

works.caption: Hanging grape clusters and taut Ferrarese linearity frame the Madonna's sharply angular features.
works.title: Madonna of the Zodiac

works.caption: A solitary pear rests on the marble parapet beside a sweeping Bergamasque landscape unfolding on either side of the pair.
works.title: Alzano Madonna

works.caption: The child's upward gaze and grasping hand play against a severe architectural niche opening onto a brick wall.
works.title: Bagnacavallo Madonna

works.caption: Byzantine gravity softens as the child's hand cups his mother's cheek, a gesture of tenderness within an austere gold-ground icon.
works.title: Madonna di Crevole

works.caption: Cherub heads mass in golden clouds above a monumental columned throne crowded with saints and floating angels drawing back a canopy.
works.title: Madonna with St. Francis

works.caption: Bellini's Madonna emerges from an inky void, her sorrowful face and the Child's wide-eyed stare rendered with a hushed, almost sculptural tenderness.
works.title: Madonna with the Child

works.caption: Titian's Gypsy Madonna glows with warm reds and golds against a shimmering damask curtain, the Child's downcast gaze lending an intimate, human stillness.
works.title: The Gypsy Madonna

works.caption: Titian's Lucretia gazes upward in anguish, her torn white shift and the dagger's edge lit with a raw, theatrical intensity against near-total darkness.
works.title: Lucretia and her Husband Lucius Tarquinius Collatinus

works.caption: Titian renders Isabella d'Este's elaborate turban and fur-trimmed sleeve with dazzling textural precision, her steady gaze radiating imperious poise.
works.title: Portrait of Isabella d'Este

works.caption: Gentile Bellini fills a Venetian canal with astonishing documentary detail, from swimmers plunging for the sacred relic to the crowded confraternity procession on the bridge.
works.title: Miracle of the Cross at the Bridge of S. Lorenzo

works.caption: Dürer's crystalline northern precision renders every hair and feather of the Madonna, siskin, and tumbling putti with jewel-like clarity against a lush landscape.
works.title: Madonna with the Siskin

works.caption: Renoir's loose, smoky brushwork captures Monet absorbed in his newspaper, pipe smoke curling into the dark ground behind him.
works.title: Monet that reads

works.caption: Gauguin's saturated Tahitian palette of yellow, coral, and blue turns two seated women into a monumental, mask-like icon of island life.
works.title: When Will You Marry?

works.caption: Cézanne builds a quiet still life of onions and a wine bottle from patient, structural brushstrokes, the crumpled white cloth anchoring the composition's geometry.
works.title: Still Life with Onions

works.caption: Cézanne piles apples and oranges across a tumble of white drapery, the tilted perspectives and patterned wallpaper turning still life into pure structure.
works.title: Apples and Oranges

works.caption: Rembrandt isolates Peter's shame in a single shaft of candlelight, the maidservant's accusing finger and Christ's distant, sorrowful glance heightening the psychological drama.
works.title: The Denial of Saint Peter

works.caption: Kandinsky lets biomorphic shapes and jagged black lines collide across a smoky grey field, color accents of red and blue flaring like sparks within the chaos.
works.title: In Grey

works.caption: Jan Steen's chaotic household overflows with revelers, a bandaged foot, spilled cards, and a pig rooting freely — genre painting as moral comedy.
works.title: Beware of Luxury (“In Weelde Siet Toe”)

works.caption: Modigliani's elongated reclining nude fills the canvas with warm ochre flesh against deep red drapery, the sitter's closed eyes lending a languid, almost sculptural calm.
works.title: Nu couché

works.caption: Titian's Noli me Tangere unfolds in a golden pastoral landscape, the gentle twist between Christ's retreating gesture and Magdalene's reach charged with tenderness.
works.title: Noli me tangere

works.caption: Correggio's Magdalene kneels in golden brocade beneath a deep forest canopy, Christ's raised hand and softly modeled torso glowing with the artist's signature sfumato.
works.title: Noli me tangere

works.caption: Modigliani flattens a reclining nude into bold, sinuous contours, the pale body glowing against a dark green backdrop and rumpled white sheets.
works.title: Reclining nude (on the left side)

works.caption: Modigliani's female nude tilts her head against her own shoulder, eyes closed, warm flesh tones set off by a dark red chair and teal wall.
works.title: Female Nude

works.caption: Mantegna carves a fantastical rocky Jerusalem in razor-sharp detail, sleeping apostles sprawled below while angels and Judas's approaching soldiers unfold across the vast landscape.
works.title: The Agony in the Garden

works.caption: Rubens spins a cosmic myth of milk streaming into starry night, Juno's pearly flesh and the peacocks' iridescent plumage radiating baroque exuberance.
works.title: The Origin of the Milky Way

works.caption: Kandinsky dissolves the Bavarian hill town of Murnau into thick, unmixed slabs of cobalt, crimson and acid yellow, the moment his painting tips from landscape toward pure color.
works.title: Murnau, Landscape with a Tower

works.caption: Three monumental saints in sumptuous red velvet, black brocade and rose damask stand shoulder to shoulder against a plain sky, Pollaiuolo's sculptor's eye for weight and drapery on full display.
works.title: Cardinal of Portugal's Altarpiece

works.caption: Botticelli's late religious style: an architectural loggia crowded with saints in muted ochre and rose, the graceful linear rhythm of drapery folds carrying the eye across the whole altarpiece.
works.title: San Barnaba Altarpiece

works.caption: Gnarled oaks lean over a still, lily-padded marsh, Ruisdael building the whole scene from a few deft passages of light breaking through dense, silvery foliage.
works.title: A Wooded Marsh

works.caption: Patinir splits the world in two: a luminous blue-green Edenic bay of tiny bathing figures on the left, Sodom and Gomorrah's fires consuming a rocky shore on the right.
works.title: Landscape with Charon Crossing the Styx

works.caption: Rubens and Brueghel the Elder pack Eden with an encyclopedic menagerie of parrots, tigers and a peacock in full display, Adam and Eve almost lost amid the dense, glossy foliage at the moment of the Fall.
works.title: The Garden of Eden with the Fall of Man

works.caption: Poussin turns a biblical plague into architectural theater, corpses and grieving mourners arranged with sculptural precision against a Roman piazza of colonnades and obelisks.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Plague at Ashdod

works.caption: Canaletto's crisp, sun-bleached rendering of the Piazza and campanile, tiny figures in bright costume scattered across the sunlit pavement with near-photographic clarity.
works.title: The Piazza San Marco in Venice

works.caption: One of Bellini's most devastating images: Christ's dead weight sags against Mary and John, a serene Venetian hill town unfolding behind them in cruel contrast.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: The young Rembrandt paints himself as a small, shadowed figure dwarfed by an oversized blank easel, the empty panel becoming the real subject of the picture.
works.title: Artist in his studio

works.caption: Velázquez paints the court jester with the same unflinching dignity he gave kings, a plain grey backdrop and open book the only props needed.
works.title: Buffoon with books, formerly known as portrait of "el Primo"

works.caption: Titian's soaring Risen Christ bursts through storm clouds at the polyptych's center, flanked by an armored donor, the Annunciation, and a writhing, arrow-pierced Sebastian.
works.collection: Church of Saints Nazarius and Celsus
works.title: Averoldi Polyptych

works.caption: Seurat's pointillist dabs of yellow-green grass and hazy lavender water dissolve a Seine bridge into shimmering, almost dissolving atmosphere.
works.title: Bridge of Courbevoie

works.caption: Claude Lorrain bathes a grand classical harbor in golden late-afternoon light, ships and colonnades receding into a luminous, hazy horizon.
works.title: Seaport with the Embarkation of Saint Ursula

works.caption: Bellini turns a Venetian workshop's fantasy of Alexandria into a vast architectural stage, camels and turbaned crowds gathered before a domed basilica rendered with obsessive perspectival precision.
works.title: Saint Mark Preaching in Alexandria

works.caption: Murillo's Madonna and Child emerge from near-total darkness, the rosary beads in the infant's hand the picture's one crisp, tactile detail.
works.title: Virgin and Child with a Rosary

works.caption: Chassériau's Esther bares herself to attendants preparing her for the Persian court, cool sea-green drapery and a dark-skinned attendant's gold jewelry setting off her pale, luminous flesh.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Toilette of Esther

works.caption: Gentile Bellini's vast processional canvas turns the Piazza San Marco itself into the subject, its golden mosaic facade rendered with documentary precision behind ranks of white-robed confraternity members.
works.title: Procession in St. Mark's Square

works.caption: Manet paints a Parisian street singer mid-stride, cherries held to her lips, the loose, almost sketch-like brushwork scandalizing critics used to smoother finish.
works.title: Street Singer

works.caption: Degas catches ballerinas mid-rehearsal in a warm, sepia-toned haze, dancers stretching and adjusting in loose, unposed clusters across the raked stage.
works.title: Edgar Degas - Rehearsal on Stage

works.caption: Titian's last, most brutal masterpiece: Apollo's satyr-skinning knife glints beside a bucket catching blood, while a musician plays on obliviously and a small dog laps at the gore, all rendered in the loose, smoldering brushwork of the artist's final years.
works.title: The Flaying of Marsyas

works.caption: A single curled-up cherub buries its face in a mustard-yellow lute, the crimson-and-white striped wings the real subject of Rosso's virtuoso color and modeling.
works.title: Angel Playing the Lute

works.caption: Kandinsky lets a bold white void swallow half the canvas, throwing the tangle of colored arcs, wires, and biomorphic shapes on the left into sharper, more urgent relief.
works.title: Painting with White Border

works.caption: An early Cézanne still working in dark, Manet-inflected tones: the pianist's white dress is the single bright note against the somber sofa and mourning figure beside her.
works.title: Jeune Fille au piano (Girl at the Piano - The Overture to Tannhauser)

works.caption: Rembrandt's most unsettling mythological scene: a bawling, chubby infant is hoisted skyward in an eagle's talons, his fright rendered with an almost comic, unheroic realism that scandalized later critics.
works.title: The Rape of Ganymede

works.caption: Rubens takes the same myth and makes it soar — Ganymede's pale, weightless body spirals against a stormy sky, wrapped in the eagle's dark plumage and a swirl of rose drapery.
works.title: The Rape of Ganymede

works.caption: A monumental altarpiece triptych: Christ strides from the tomb in blazing white and red at center, flanked by grisaille-toned Adam and a jewel-colored donor portrait on the wings.
works.title: The Resurrection of Christ

works.caption: Painted with Michelangelo's design input, this crowded, muscular Lazarus scene stages the miracle as a study in twisting bodies and stunned faces beneath a distant classical cityscape.
works.title: The Raising of Lazarus

works.caption: One of the sharpest character studies of the Quattrocento: a faint, knowing smile plays across the sitter's lips beneath a crimson cap that Antonello renders with startling three-dimensional volume.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: Signorelli sets his sitter's severe, weathered profile against a black void, the plain dark robe pushing all attention onto the deeply lined face and probing eyes.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: Van Dyck arranges the five royal children around an enormous mastiff, the future Charles II resting a boyish hand on the dog's head while his sisters' silk dresses cascade in overlapping folds.
works.title: Five Eldest Children of Charles I

works.caption: Goya crowds an aristocratic family into an eerie, undefined brown void, the children's toy carriage and pet dog undercutting the stiff formality of their parents' court dress.
works.title: The Duke and Duchess of Osuna and their Children

works.caption: A merchant holds up an ancient Roman coin between two fingers, Memling's crystalline Flemish detail extending from the man's careworn face to the tiny profile stamped on the coin itself.
works.title: Man with a Roman coin

works.caption: Velázquez catches the powerful minister with a wry half-smile and glinting eyes, the loose, almost impressionistic handling of the ruff and black doublet anticipating centuries of later painting.
works.title: Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares

works.caption: Van Dyck drapes his cardinal in a river of scarlet silk and lace against a great red curtain, the sitter's alert, sidelong glance keeping the opulent setting from overwhelming the portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Guido Bentivoglio

works.caption: Mantegna's sculptural clarity turns a cardinal's face into something close to carved stone, every wrinkle and vein rendered with unflinching precision against a plain dark ground.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Ludovico Trevisan

works.caption: Dürer sets the aging emperor's fur-swaddled bulk against a green field crowded with Latin eulogy and a gilded coat of arms, the pomegranate in his hand a quiet emblem of fertility and empire.
works.title: Emperor Maximilian I

works.caption: The Duchess points imperiously downward at an inscription in the sand reading 'Solo Goya,' her white muslin dress and red sash rendered with a bravura looseness that makes the desert landscape behind her feel almost incidental.
works.title: Portrait of the Duchess of Alba

works.caption: Rembrandt lavishes his richest attention on the lace collar and gold-embroidered stomacher, the sitter's plain, direct face emerging from a deep, almost black penumbra.
works.title: Portrait of Agatha Bas

works.caption: Dürer records his seventy-year-old father with unsparing honesty — every fold of aged skin and wisp of grey hair fixed against a mottled pink ground, the Gothic inscription above dating the sitting exactly.
works.title: Portrait of Dürer's Father at 70

works.caption: Lotto surrounds the collector with a chaos of antique statuary and severed marble heads, the clutter itself becoming a witty, layered portrait of connoisseurship and vanity.
works.title: Portrait of Andrea Odoni

works.caption: A small girl in stiff white satin and heavy gold chains stares out from an intense cobalt ground, Bronzino's icy precision making childhood itself look like a state occasion.
works.title: Portrait of Bia de' Medici

works.caption: One of Mannerism's great portraits: the sitter's slashed crimson sleeves and cool grey doublet are rendered with a hard, enamel-like finish, his sardonic half-smile framed by an architectural backdrop of arches and towers.
works.title: Portrait of Bartolomeo Panciatichi

works.caption: Parmigianino elongates his sitter's neck and fingers with characteristic Mannerist grace, her three sons arranged around her in a pyramid of silk, pearls, and watchful childish faces.
works.title: Portrait of Camilla Gonzaga and Her Three Sons

works.caption: Van Dyck's most enduring image of Charles I: the king turns to meet the viewer's eye beneath a canopy of oak leaves, his palomino mount frozen mid-step in a pose of effortless, unchallenged authority.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Charles I

works.caption: A trompe-l'oeil stone arch frames king and horse like a monument within the painting itself, the royal coat of arms and swagged green drapery turning portraiture into pure state theater.
works.title: Charles I (1600-1649) with M. de St Antoine

works.caption: Charles I steps down from his horse mid-hunt, cane in hand, gazing out with a studied nonchalance that Van Dyck turns into one of the most influential images of aristocratic ease ever painted.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Charles I at the Hunt

works.caption: Two young princes in gleaming half-armor stand before a great swagged curtain, Van Dyck's silvery highlights on the steel plate doing as much character work as their faces.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Charles Louis Elector Palatine (1617-1680) and his brother, Rupert of the Palatinate (1619-1682)

works.caption: Parmigianino's gilded, coiled turban and the sitter's cool, appraising gaze exemplify Mannerist elegance pushed to the edge of artifice.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Woman

works.caption: Titian's Duke of Urbino commands the canvas in gleaming black armor against crimson velvet, the baton and trophies of command framing an unflinching gaze.
works.title: Portrait of Francesco Maria della Rovere

works.caption: Van Eyck's turban coils in improbably crisp folds of vermilion against black, the small, direct eyes among the earliest truly individualized gazes in Western painting.
works.title: Portrait of Giovanni di Nicolao Arnolfini

works.caption: Rubens sends horse and rider rearing beneath a storm-lit sky, the rider's plumed hat and billowing red sash cutting a diagonal of pure Baroque motion.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Giancarlo Doria

works.caption: El Greco gives the miniaturist Clovio a wary, searching stare, his own small painted landscape held up as evidence of his craft within the larger canvas.
works.title: Portrait of Giulio Clovio

works.caption: Dürer renders every silver-white hair of the beard with obsessive clarity, the wide, alert eyes making this one of the most penetrating character studies of the German Renaissance.
works.title: Portrait of Hieronymus Holzschuher

works.caption: Dürer's companion portrait to Holzschuher gives Muffel the same unsparing precision, the braided gold cap-band and fur collar rendered thread by thread.
works.title: Portrait of Jakob Muffel

works.caption: Rembrandt's Jan Six pauses mid-gesture pulling on a glove, the loaded, buttery strokes of scarlet cloak against near-black ground announcing pure painterly bravura.
works.title: Portrait of Jan Six

works.caption: Velázquez lets gold-chased black armor and a rose-pink sash catch the light against a near-invisible dark ground, the count's steady gaze meeting the viewer directly.
works.title: Juan Francisco Pimentel, conde de Benavente

works.caption: Van Dyck poses the Stuart brothers in gold and silver satin, their languid contrapposto and rhyming boots turning aristocratic swagger into pure design.
works.title: Lord John Stuart and His Brother, Lord Bernard Stuart

works.caption: Pisanello's profile portrait sets crisp brocade and jeweled buttons against a deep blue sky sprigged with wild roses, International Gothic ornament at its most exquisite.
works.title: Portrait of Lionel d'Este

works.caption: Cézanne builds his wife's face and dark blue bodice from patient, faceted strokes, the mottled blue-green wall behind her vibrating with the same structural rhythm.
works.title: Portrait of Madame Cézanne

works.caption: Vigée Le Brun softens the queen's image with grey satin and a single rose, the towering plumed headdress and painterly foliage staging a deliberately approachable royal portrait.
works.collection: Museum of the History of France
works.title: Marie Antoinette with a Rose

works.caption: Vigée Le Brun surrounds Marie Antoinette with her children and an empty cradle, the swagged crimson velvet and confident maternal gaze designed to counter public hostility.
works.collection: Museum of the History of France
works.title: Marie Antoinette and Her Children

works.caption: Memling's intricate goldsmith's necklace glints against dark velvet, the sitter's calm, veiled composure a model of Early Netherlandish restraint.
works.title: Portrait of Maria Portinari

works.caption: Dürer records his friend Wolgemut's deeply lined face and pale sea-green eyes against acid green, the inscription above dating the portrait to the sitter's last years.
works.title: Portrait of the Nuremberg Painter Michael Wolgemut

works.caption: Titian catches the aged pope hunched sideways in shimmering red velvet, the loose, almost impressionistic brushwork of cape and cap conveying frailty and shrewd power at once.
works.title: Portrait of Pope Paul III

works.caption: Parmigianino sets the count's fur-trimmed black robe against an intricately damasked gold curtain, a small statuette and landscape glimpsed through the opening beside him.
works.title: Portrait of Pier Maria Rossi di San Secondo

works.caption: Holbein's cool, mottled green ground sets off the sitter's black cap and doublet, the inscribed dates flanking his head with the crisp precision typical of the artist's English court portraits.
works.title: Portrait of Sir Richard Southwell

works.caption: A young knight in burnished armor stands amid a teeming allegorical landscape, herons, a stag, and a jousting rider crowding every inch of the panel around him.
works.title: Portrait of a Knight

works.caption: A tiny oil lamp glows behind the curtain at the sitter's shoulder, its flame the picture's quiet punchline against the young man's introspective stare.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man with a Lamp

works.caption: The plumed red cap and lynx-fur collar are painted with a bravura looseness that anticipates Titian's late style, the face emerging with startling immediacy from the dark ground.
works.title: Portrait of a Man in a Red Cap

works.caption: Bronzino's sitter strikes a deliberately artificial pose against cold architecture, his ink-stained fingers and sardonic half-smile among the sharpest character notes in Mannerist portraiture.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man with a Book

works.caption: Painted in Venice, the sitter's ringlets and pearl-and-garnet necklace are rendered with a linear precision that Dürer's Italian contemporaries never quite matched.
works.title: Portrait of a Venetian Woman

works.caption: Tintoretto plunges the scene into a vertiginous, torch-lit arcade, corpses and grave-robbers receding into a perspective that seems to swallow the viewer.
works.title: Finding of the body of St Mark

works.caption: A ring of tumbling cherubs bursts from the shadows above the cradle, Rembrandt staging the sacred vision as an ordinary Dutch mother glances up from her sewing.
works.title: The Holy Family with Angels

works.caption: Bonnard floods the room with impossible color, vermilion walls set against a blazing green garden, while a cat perched on a chair and a woman at the balcony rail hold the eye at the composition's edges.
works.title: Dining Room in the Country

works.caption: A garish greenish spotlight turns the woman's powdered face into a mask, Toulouse-Lautrec's harsh cropping and acid palette capturing the seedy glamour of Parisian nightlife.
works.title: In a Private Dining Room

works.caption: Christ leans from the cross to embrace the kneeling saint, Murillo's soft, glowing modeling of flesh set against a stormy, indistinct sky.
works.collection: Museo de Bellas Artes de Sevilla
works.title: Saint Francis embracing Christ on the Cross

works.caption: Bellini floods a limestone landscape with an almost supernatural morning light, every rock, vine, and grazing donkey rendered with the same loving precision as the saint himself.
works.title: Saint Francis in the Desert

works.caption: Monet dissolves the Venetian skyline into a single blazing chord of orange and violet, the campanile's silhouette the only firm line left in the picture.
works.title: San Giorgio Maggiore at Dusk

works.caption: Jerome reads beneath an overhanging crag while a lion dozes in shadow and a walled city glows in crystalline light across the valley — an early landscape triumph.
works.title: Saint Jerome Reading in the Desert

works.caption: A turbulent sunset sky of coral and slate dominates over Jerome's still blue robe, the lion curled beside him rendered with Dürer's naturalist precision.
works.title: St. Jerome in the Wilderness

works.caption: Christ dives head-first from a blaze of light to snatch a drowning man from the waves, the whole canvas pitched into diagonal chaos of oar, sail and storm cloud.
works.title: St. Mark rescues a Sarracen

works.caption: A single shaft of light falls on Peter's clasped hands and the ring of keys at his feet, the surrounding cell dissolved into near-total black.
works.title: Saint Peter in prison

works.caption: A procession of gravely dignified Florentine faces, painted with a new sculptural solidity that made this fresco cycle a training ground for generations of painters.
works.title: St. Peter Healing the Sick with His Shadow

works.caption: Rendered entirely in grisaille to mimic carved stone relief, Delilah shears Samson's hair against a strange marbled sky, a Latin inscription warning against womanly wiles.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: Delilah turns away as Samson is dragged from her lap by armored soldiers, the composition compressed into a tense frieze of gesture and gleaming steel.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: Ambrose, gold-vested and immovable, blocks the emperor's path on the cathedral steps — a study in confrontation staged through color, the bishop's darkness against Theodosius's blood red.
works.title: Saint Ambrose Barring Theodosius from Milan Cathedral

works.caption: Circe raises her enchanted cup on a throne flanked by carved lions, her wary reflection and a shipwrecked Ulysses visible in the mirror behind her.
works.title: Circe Offering the Cup to Ulysses

works.caption: God's outstretched hand separates light from water at the ceiling's crown, flanked by nude ignudi and bronze medallions in Michelangelo's dense sculptural program.
works.title: The Separation of the Earth and Waters

works.caption: A crowd of pale, mask-like faces under top hats presses down a twilight boulevard, Munch turning a fashionable evening stroll into something quietly dread-filled.
works.title: Evening on Karl Johan

works.caption: A vast army descends through a mountain pass toward a burning city, Saul's suicide reduced to a tiny incident on a rocky outcrop at the panel's edge.
works.title: The Suicide of Saul

works.caption: Susanna twists away in genuine distress from the elders looming above her, her raised arms and averted face giving the old subject unusual psychological force.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: Susanna bathes at her mirror in a walled garden, unaware of the elder watching from the shrubbery, the scene suffused with warm, breathing evening light.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: A rainbow arcs precisely over Salisbury's spire as a farm cart fords the river below, storm clouds breaking apart to let a shaft of sun through.
works.title: Salisbury Cathedral from the Meadows

works.caption: Demons with feathered wings and animal snouts pile onto the collapsed hermit, the panel's jagged silhouette itself a fragment of the dismembered Isenheim Altarpiece.
works.title: Temptation of Saint Anthony

works.caption: Moses reads his final testament to a crowd beneath a hillside where an angel confronts armed men, nude figures massed with Signorelli's sculptural, muscular clarity.
works.title: Testament and Death of Moses

works.caption: The cathedral spire rises through a screen of dark trees as cattle wade a stream in the foreground, Constable's loaded brush capturing dappled light on foliage.
works.collection: Victoria and Albert museum prints, drawings, & paintings collection
works.title: Salisbury Cathedral from the Bishop's Grounds

works.caption: A red-haired nude stands wound in the coils of a python, her closed eyes and languid pose turning the femme-fatale subject into cool, decorative reverie.
works.title: Lilith

works.caption: The Madonna in a wooden armchair holds a squirming Christ Child while a bustling household scene of St Anne's life unfolds through the doorway behind her.
works.title: Virgin with the Child and Scenes from the Life of St Anne

works.caption: Christ stands radiant between the two prophets on a grassy rise, apostles sprawled below in postures of sleep and shock, a serene Venetian landscape stretching to distant blue hills.
works.title: Transfiguration of Christ

works.caption: Bacchus leaps from his cheetah-drawn chariot toward Ariadne amid a tumbling frieze of satyrs, cupids and drunken revelers spanning the full width of the Farnese ceiling.
works.title: Triumph of Bacchus and Ariadne

works.caption: The same head turns through three angles against identical grey cloud, the lace collars and sidelong gaze making a single sitter feel like three separate character studies.
works.title: Charles I in Three Positions

works.caption: Cobalt and violet irises churn against a flat lemon-yellow ground, van Gogh's restless outlines making even the ceramic vase seem to vibrate.
works.title: Vase with Irises

works.caption: Dawn mist silvers a rutted lane, a loaded hay cart and a hunter with his dog dwarfed by the sweep of Rubens's own Flemish estate stretching to the horizon.
works.title: A View of Het Steen in the Early Morning

works.caption: Venus clings to Adonis as he strains toward his hounds, the twisting embrace and raking diagonal light building one of Titian's most physically charged compositions.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: Domes and campanili dissolve into golden haze over the lagoon, Turner letting atmosphere all but erase the gondolas working the foreground water.
works.title: Venice from the Giudecca

works.caption: Muscular Percherons rear and strain against their handlers along a sunlit avenue of plane trees, Bonheur's sweeping brushwork capturing the horses' raw physical power.
works.title: The Horse Fair

works.caption: A tonsured monk and nun lean toward a suspended pancake aboard an overloaded, half-sinking boat, Bosch turning a folly-of-mankind allegory into grotesque comic theater.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Ship of Fools

works.caption: A girl with a ribboned bow and elongated almond eyes sits with folded hands against slate grey, Modigliani reducing the child sitter to a few calm, sculptural planes.
works.title: Alice

works.caption: A barefoot girl huddles on a boulder at a dark forest pool, her hunched pose and loose auburn hair distilling Russian folk sorrow into a single still figure.
works.title: Alyonushka

works.caption: A pyramid of bleached skulls rises from a scorched plain under circling crows, Vereshchagin dedicating the canvas, per its inscription, to all conquerors past, present and future.
works.title: The Apotheosis of War

works.caption: A raised, chained fist dominates a jostling winter crowd as a boyarina is dragged off in a sledge, Surikov building an entire panorama of faces around her defiant gesture.
works.title: Boyarina Morozova

works.caption: A river bends past a lakeside monastery under a pale evening sky, its onion domes and reflected boats sounding out Levitan's quiet, elegiac stillness.
works.title: Evening Bells

works.caption: A rider on horseback bursts through a snow fortress in an explosion of flying snowballs, Surikov freezing a village festival at its single most kinetic instant.
works.title: Taking a Snow Town

works.caption: A pale, praying boy meets a haloed monk beneath an autumn tree, Nesterov setting the quiet mystical vision against a wide, lovingly detailed Russian valley.
works.title: The Vision to the Youth Bartholomew

works.caption: An empty dirt road cuts straight across flat grassland to the horizon under a vast clouded sky, Levitan's bare composition carrying the weight of the exiles' route it depicts.
works.title: The Vladimirka

works.caption: A gold-mitred bishop and an armored African saint converse in glowing brocade and steel, Grunewald's jewel-toned surfaces rewarding close, patient looking.
works.title: Meeting of St Erasm and St Maurice

works.caption: A girl pauses at a sunlit table scattered with peaches, Serov's broken, luminous brushwork turning an ordinary interior into one of Russian painting's most beloved images.
works.title: Girl with peaches

works.caption: Diana recoils as her nymphs expose the pregnant Callisto beside a gushing fountain, Titian orchestrating a dozen figures in flesh, drapery, and landscape at the height of his late style.
works.title: Diana and Callisto

works.caption: A street vendor grins beneath a wide straw hat, Hogarth's rapid, unfinished brushwork capturing more life and immediacy than most of his polished portraits.
works.title: The Shrimp Girl

works.caption: A colossal archaic statue presides over a shattering ancient world beneath a jagged shaft of light, Bakst's mineral blues and greens giving Symbolist catastrophe a mosaic-like density.
works.title: Terror Antiquus

works.caption: Seated against a searing red-and-yellow ground, a woman holds a single flower with quiet gravity, Gauguin using flat planes of unnatural color to charge a simple portrait with monumental calm.
works.title: Tahitian Woman with a Flower

works.caption: Merlin slumps enchanted in a bower of hawthorn while Nimue reads the spell that binds him, Burne-Jones rendering every blossom and fold with tapestry-like density.
works.title: The Beguiling of Merlin

works.caption: A river bends past birches blazing gold under a high blue sky, Levitan compressing an entire Russian autumn into a single, breath-catching stretch of countryside.
works.title: Golden Autumn

works.caption: A father cradles his mortally wounded son on a blood-soaked carpet, Repin's raw, close-cropped composition making Ivan the Terrible's horror almost unbearable to look at.
works.title: Ivan the Terrible and his son Ivan on November 16, 1581

works.caption: A crowd surges through a Warsaw square hoisting the king aloft beneath a forest of banners, Matejko choreographing dozens of figures into a single patriotic climax.
works.title: Constitution of May 3, 1791

works.caption: The Virgin, infant Christ, young John the Baptist, and Elizabeth cluster around a wicker basket, Raphael balancing intimate warmth against a luminous, architecturally precise background.
works.title: The Holy Family

works.caption: Mariana arches backward from her embroidery in a jewel-toned window bay, stained glass and fallen leaves signaling the stretched, aching patience of Tennyson's poem.
works.title: Mariana

works.caption: A red-robed cardinal glances up mid-sentence, quill in hand, Raphael's characterization of Tommaso Inghirami's alert, slightly cross-eyed gaze making the portrait unforgettable.
works.title: Portrait of Tommaso Inghirami, called Fedra

works.caption: Four racehorses stretch into full gallop under a churning, storm-dark sky, Gericault's impossible flying-legs pose capturing pure velocity before photography could.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The 1821 Derby at Epsom

works.caption: Berthe Morisot reclines along a couch in white muslin, one arm draped over the cushion, Manet's loose, confident brushwork catching an unguarded moment of rest.
works.title: Repose

works.caption: Two flags snap in the sea breeze above a terrace of gladiolas, the whole scene built from clean bands of color that make Monet's early mastery of light unmistakable.
works.title: Garden at Sainte-Adresse

works.caption: A young woman plucks a cittern with a half-smile, her curls and pearls catching the same cool light as the landscape painting hung on the wall behind her.
works.title: The Guitar Player

works.caption: A young widow in unbroken black silk stands against teal, her clasped hands and faint half-smile the only warmth Holbein allows into an otherwise austere design.
works.title: Christina of Denmark, Duchess of Milan

works.caption: A society beauty in a vast plumed hat and sable stole turns to meet the viewer, Serov's loose, glinting brushwork conjuring pure fin-de-siècle glamour.
works.title: Princess Olga Orlova

works.caption: A young bride leans against a classical plinth in shimmering ivory silk, Gainsborough's feathery brush turning satin folds and storm-lit trees into a single silvery harmony.
works.title: The Honourable Mrs Graham

works.caption: A profile of coiled copper hair threaded with pearls stands out against pure black, Botticelli's idealized beauty rendered with linear, jewel-like precision.
works.title: Idealized Portrait of a Lady (Portrait of Simonetta Vespucci as Nymph)

works.caption: Christ's limp body slides across the Virgin's lap under a churning yellow-gold sky, van Gogh translating Delacroix's composition into thick, restless ropes of color.
works.title: Pietà (after Delacroix), The

works.caption: Golden rye ripples beneath a scatter of towering pines, Shishkin's precise botanical detail giving the whole endless field a monumental, almost architectural calm.
works.title: Rye Fields

works.caption: A procession of bejeweled sea-princesses glides toward Sadko through glowing underwater gloom, Repin conjuring a fairy-tale world from deep greens and gold.
works.title: Sadko

works.caption: A single magpie perches on a wattle gate, its black silhouette the only dark note in a field of snow rendered in countless tints of blue and lavender shadow.
works.title: The Magpie

works.caption: Saint Sebastian stands pierced by arrows against a perfectly measured Renaissance piazza, Antonello fusing anatomical calm with mathematical perspective.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Mary Magdalene gazes skyward with tear-streaked cheeks, one hand pressed to her breast beside a skull and open book, Titian's late palette glowing against a stormy landscape.
works.title: Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: A couple whirls close together beneath dappled leaves, her pink ruffled gown swinging outward in Renoir's joyous celebration of movement and open-air light.
works.title: Dance at Bougival

works.caption: A maid carries a tray of water and chocolate with perfect poise, Liotard rendering her starched apron and porcelain cup with almost photographic pastel precision.
works.title: The Chocolate Girl

works.caption: A weathered footbridge leads across still water to onion-domed churches glowing at dusk, Levitan's reflections doubling the scene in soft evening color.
works.title: A Quiet Monastery

works.caption: Navvies dig a trench while flower-sellers, idlers, and gentlemen philosophers crowd a sunny London street, Ford Madox Brown cataloguing all of Victorian society in one arched panel.
works.title: Work

works.caption: A jeweled swan-woman turns her half-human face from a mantle of feathered wings, Vrubel building the fairy-tale figure from thick, faceted strokes of white and silver.
works.title: The Swan Princess

works.caption: A scholar leans over his charts, compass in hand, window light modeling his blue robe while a globe and wall map anchor Vermeer's quiet study of intellect.
works.title: The Geographer

works.caption: Two cloaked figures stand as near-black silhouettes against a glowing band of sunset, Friedrich's Romantic hush pressing the vastness of sea and sky.
works.title: Sunset

works.caption: Holbein arranges the kneeling donor family in tight symmetry around the crowned Madonna beneath a scallop-shell niche, every fabric and face rendered with cool Northern precision.
works.title: Darmstadt Madonna

works.caption: The corpulent Count-Duke fills the canvas in matte black velvet, Velázquez picking out the glint of chain, key, and dagger against the sober costume.
works.title: Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares

works.caption: Van Gogh's cypress claws upward into a sky of churning, luminous spirals, the sleeping village below untouched by the turbulence overhead.
works.title: The Starry Night

works.caption: A pitchfork-wielding farmer and his daughter stand rigid before their Carpenter Gothic house, Grant Wood's stiff verticals and deadpan stares turning American plainness into icon.
works.title: American Gothic

works.caption: A young woman glances over her shoulder from the keyboard, Vermeer's cool north light modeling silk sleeve and pearl-strung hair with characteristic stillness.
works.title: A Young Woman Seated at the Virginals

works.caption: A woman in blue and white silk rests a foot on the globe beside a crucifixion painting and hanging glass orb, Vermeer's allegory dense with symbolic props rendered in his usual cool clarity.
works.title: Allegory of the Catholic Faith

works.caption: A silhouetted officer in a broad hat leans toward a laughing woman lit by window light, Vermeer's map-hung wall and raking perspective drawing the eye straight to her open smile.
works.title: Officer and Laughing Girl

works.caption: Spearmen and onlookers pack a straw-roofed stable around the kneeling kings, Bruegel crowding the small panel with grotesque, individualized faces under a star-lit sky.
works.title: The Adoration of the Kings

works.caption: Adele Bloch-Bauer stands rigid in a wide dark hat against a wall of pink blossoms and Chinese-inflected red, Klimt trading his gold mosaic period for flat, patterned color.
works.title: Adele Bloch-Bauer II

works.caption: A bound lamb lies alone against black, its legs tied and eyes closed, Zurbarán isolating the sacrificial animal with an almost sculptural, spotlit clarity.
works.title: Agnus Dei

works.caption: Two boys carry a blindfolded, blood-spotted angel on a stretcher through a bare spring landscape, Simberg's flat handling and ambiguous narrative unsettling generations of Finnish viewers.
works.title: The Wounded Angel

works.caption: A young woman in a wicker chair mends fishing net against a bright strip of sea, Renoir dissolving her lace collar and the water beyond into loose, sunlit strokes.
works.title: By the Seashore

works.caption: A grinning, dark-winged Cupid straddles a heap of instruments, armor, and laurel, Caravaggio's raking light and audacious nudity announcing love's triumph over every worldly pursuit.
works.title: Amor Vincit Omnia

works.caption: Malle Babbe cackles with an owl on her shoulder and a tankard at hand, Hals attacking the canvas with slashing, virtuosic strokes that seem to move as fast as her laugh.
works.title: Malle Babbe

works.caption: Cecilia Gallerani turns her head sharply while an ermine coils alert in her arms, Leonardo aligning both faces on the same watchful diagonal against flat black.
works.title: Lady with an Ermine

works.caption: Three brothers stretch rigid arms toward their father's raised swords while the women collapse in grief at right, David driving the whole composition through severe verticals and Roman restraint.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Oath of the Horatii

works.caption: A blind beggar girl rests in a field beneath a double rainbow, a young companion asleep against her shoulder, Millais setting minute botanical detail against quiet tragedy.
works.title: The Blind Girl

works.caption: The sleeping Christ Child lies draped across Mary's lap on an elaborately carved throne, Bellini setting the sculptural niche against soft, luminous clouds.
works.title: Enthroned Madonna Adoring the Sleeping Christ Child

works.caption: The Cossacks roar with laughter as they compose an insulting letter to the Sultan, Repin packing dozens of individualized, wheezing, delighted faces into one raucous crowd.
works.title: Reply of the Zaporozhian Cossacks

works.caption: A lone woman in a cloche hat nurses a coffee at a stark automat table, the black window behind her turning the room's own lights into a chain of reflected orbs.
works.title: Automat

works.caption: A married couple exchange a quiet, unreadable glance across a blue garden bench, hemmed in by a dense green wall of conservatory foliage and rendered in Manet's cool, flickering grays.
works.title: In the Conservatory

works.caption: Ribbons of green and red aurora streak a black arctic sky above a tiny icebound ship, dwarfed by dark headlands and the sublime scale of the polar night.
works.title: Aurora Borealis

works.caption: Christ hovers weightless over a luminous dawn landscape, banner in hand, while startled guards and sleepy soldiers stir around the open tomb below in Bellini's crystalline light.
works.title: Resurrection of Christ

works.caption: Mourners cradle the dead Christ beneath a bare wooden cross, the intimate grief in the foreground opening onto one of Bellini's serene, sunlit Venetian river valleys.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ with Joseph of Arimathea, the Virgin and Mary Magdalene, including SS. Martha and Philip Benizi

works.caption: Two ferocious wind and thunder deities burst across gilded folding screens, their sinuous drum-cords and sash the only color breaking a vast field of gold leaf and drifting ink cloud.
works.title: Wind God and Thunder God

works.caption: The Medici court, thinly veiled as the biblical Magi, kneels before the Virgin amid crumbling classical ruins, Botticelli packing dozens of individualized portrait faces into a single dazzling procession.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Danae reclines in a fantastical marble rotunda as a shimmering shower of gold pours from a domed oculus, Gossaert fusing Northern precision with an invented Italianate architecture.
works.title: Danae

works.caption: A patchwork of hayricks, farm carts, and gold fields recedes to distant blue mountains under a wide, high-key Provençal sky, one of Van Gogh's most spatially ambitious plein-air panoramas.
works.title: Harvest at La Crau, with Montmajour in the Background

works.caption: A Breton woman in starched lace headdress is framed inside a golden medallion beside a squatting Peruvian idol, Gauguin colliding regional costume with exotic sculpture against deep indigo.
works.title: La belle Angèle

works.caption: Christ blazes with radiant light atop the cross while a vast, chaotic crowd of soldiers, mourners, and horsemen churns beneath him across Tintoretto's sweeping panoramic stage.
works.title: Crucifixion

works.caption: Strollers wander a fiery avenue of autumn poplars past Roman-era tombs, Van Gogh setting orange path and yellow foliage ablaze against a smoky violet sky.
works.title: Les Alyscamps

works.caption: Two women in white drift in a red rowboat across near-black water beneath overhanging shade, Monet's daring diagonal crop giving the scene a modern, snapshot-like immediacy.
works.title: Boating on the River Epte

works.caption: A red-haired woman leans forward against a marigold hedge, gold jewelry and a marigold-and-apple still life framing Rossetti's frank, sensuous close-up study.
works.title: Bocca Baciata

works.caption: The admiral's aged, bearded head is grafted onto Neptune's nude, muscular body and trident, Bronzino's cool porcelain flesh tones an audacious flattery portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Andrea Doria as Neptune

works.caption: A dizzying bird's-eye view down a Parisian boulevard dissolves the Mardi Gras crowd into a river of flickering color between converging rows of townhouses.
works.title: Boulevard Montmartre, Mardi Gras

works.caption: A wintry Paris boulevard dissolves into flickering dabs of black and white as crowds stream beneath bare trees, seen from a high balcony in one of Impressionism's foundational works.
works.title: Boulevard des Capucines

works.caption: Venus lies asleep in an idealized Venetian landscape, her body's long, unbroken curve echoing the gentle hills behind her in one of the founding images of the reclining nude.
works.title: Sleeping Venus

works.caption: A dog's small head barely surfaces above an engulfing slope of bare earth beneath a vast, empty ochre void, Goya's most radically minimal and desolate image.
works.title: The Dog

works.caption: A flat, mustard-yellow Christ hangs over an autumnal Breton landscape while three peasant women pray at its base, Gauguin's synthetist style fusing folk piety with pure invented color.
works.title: The Yellow Christ

works.caption: Weary hunters and their dogs trudge home through snow as, below, an entire frozen valley of skaters and rooftops unfolds toward jagged mountains, Bruegel's supreme panorama of winter life.
works.title: The Hunters in the Snow

works.caption: A soaring Gothic cathedral rises above a sprawling imaginary medieval city as a rainbow arcs through stormy clouds and a procession winds through the trees below.
works.title: Medieval City on a River

works.caption: Fortune enthroned with globe and caduceus presides over a dense pyramid of nude allegorical figures spinning a great wheel, Bronzino's icy porcelain flesh packed into an elaborate Mannerist puzzle.
works.title: Allegory of fortune

works.caption: A tiny wanderer rests on a rock beneath a vast, complete rainbow arching over darkened mountains, Friedrich's solitary figure dwarfed by the storm's passing grandeur.
works.title: Mountain Landscape with Rainbow

works.caption: A woman in a red hood glances back through a snow-flecked window, glimpsed from inside a shadowed room framed by pale curtains and glazing bars.
works.title: The Red Kerchief

works.caption: Hopper's slabs of urban color — cobalt window, mustard curtain, the red neon glow of the sign — box in two solitary couples lost in their own silences.
works.title: Chop Suey

works.caption: A single shaft of light rakes across weathered flesh and a bare skull, Caravaggio's tenebrism turning an old man's concentration into high drama.
works.title: Saint Jerome Writing

works.caption: Antonello's close, sculptural modeling of tear-streaked skin and taut rope against a crown of thorns makes suffering almost tactile.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Christ at the Column

works.caption: Waterhouse pours acid green across teal water and Circe's shadowed dress, the poison trailing from her bowl in a single glowing thread.
works.title: Circe Invidiosa

works.caption: Rembrandt dissolves the room into velvet darkness so that only the father's two weathered hands, resting on his ragged son's shoulders, hold the light.
works.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son

works.caption: Guo Xi builds a whole cosmology of mist and stone from ink alone, gnarled pines clawing up through fog-wrapped peaks toward a hidden summit.
works.title: Early Spring

works.caption: Goya sets a pregnant young countess against pure black, her feathered bonnet and gauzy white gown the only light in the room.
works.title: Countess of Chinchon

works.caption: Rogier van der Weyden hangs a taut red cloth of honor behind both panels, its flat brilliance making Christ's pale, sculptural body and the mourners' grief almost unbearably precise.
works.title: Crucifixion Diptych

works.caption: Vermeer builds the whole city out of light — sun catching wet rooftops under a vast, dark-clouded sky mirrored in the still harbor water.
works.title: View of Delft

works.caption: Holbein renders the fur, velvet, and chain of office with crystalline precision, but it's More's wary, appraising eyes that carry the portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Sir Thomas More

works.caption: Watteau scatters silk-clad lovers and hovering putti across a hazy, gold-green landscape, the whole scene suspended between arrival and departure.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Embarkation for Cythera

works.caption: Rogier van der Weyden pours the Madonna's crimson robe down through a carved Gothic niche, the child's small hand turning a page as she looks on.
works.title: Durán Madonna

works.caption: Gentileschi turns Judith and her maid into a taut, watchful pair, the severed head barely visible in the basket as they freeze mid-escape.
works.title: Judith and Her Maidservant

works.caption: Waterhouse frames the doomed pair in dense summer foliage, Echo's pink drapery and Narcissus's coral cloak the only warm notes beside the still, reflecting pool.
works.title: Echo and Narcissus

works.caption: Bruegel crams over a hundred literal proverbs into one bustling Flemish village, every rooftop and doorway staging its own small absurd drama.
works.title: Netherlandish Proverbs

works.caption: Sargent throws a flamenco dancer's white skirt and jagged arm into blazing light against a wall of guitarists sunk in shadow.
works.title: El Jaleo

works.caption: Manet paints a courtesan caught mid-toilette in creamy corset and petticoat, her direct gaze at the viewer breaking past the seated gentleman entirely.
works.title: Nana

works.caption: Van Eyck fills a cardinal's study with obsessively rendered clutter — hourglass, astrolabe, lion at his feet — every object catching its own precise light.
works.title: Saint Jerome in His Study

works.caption: Gérôme sets pale, exposed bodies against a glowing red brick wall, the crowd's raised hands turning the auction into a wall of grasping fingers.
works.title: Slave Market in Rome

works.caption: Raphael arranges the sacred family into a tender pyramid of touching hands beneath dark trees, the two infants reaching for each other at the center.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and the infant St. John

works.caption: Courbet lines up an entire village along a bleak horizon for an ordinary man's funeral, the crucifix and gravediggers' dog the only points of focus in a monumental crowd.
works.title: A Burial at Ornans

works.caption: Two pale, identical women sit bathing behind red curtains, one's fingers pinching the other's nipple in a gesture whose meaning still resists explanation.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Gabrielle d'Estrées et une de ses sœurs

works.caption: Golden window light rakes across the astronomer's sleeve as his hand rests on a celestial globe -- Vermeer's quiet drama of intellect and illumination.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Astronomer

works.caption: A tiger claws up onto a rearing horse mid-lunge, riders and big cats locked in a whirlwind of flashing steel and fur that epitomizes Rubens's baroque violence.
works.title: The Tiger Hunt

works.caption: The dead Christ is thrust straight at the viewer in brutal foreshortening, his pierced feet looming largest of all -- one of the boldest perspectival feats of the Renaissance.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: Castiglione's grey-blue gaze meets the viewer with disarming calm, Raphael dissolving costume and flesh into a harmony of silver, grey and black that later inspired Rembrandt and Rubens alike.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione

works.caption: A nude reclines on a parlor sofa improbably transplanted into a moonlit jungle thick with lions' eyes and lotus blooms -- Rousseau's naive vision at its most hypnotic.
works.title: The Dream

works.caption: A line of gas-blinded soldiers, hands on each other's shoulders, shuffles across a field of the fallen beneath a strange pink dusk -- Sargent's monumental elegy for the Western Front.
works.title: Gassed

works.caption: Gentileschi casts herself as Saint Catherine, palm frond in hand and spiked wheel resting against her shoulder, her direct gaze asserting authorship as much as sanctity.
works.title: Self-Portrait as Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: The young Raphael regards the viewer with soft, unguarded features against a plain ground, a portrait of quiet self-possession from his own hand.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: A tailor pauses mid-cut, shears in hand, looking up from his bench with an easy familiarity that makes Moroni's sitter feel startlingly present four centuries on.
works.title: The Tailor

works.caption: A soldier, a scholar and a peasant lie sated beneath a table roofed with cooked eggs and pies in Bruegel's biting satire of gluttonous idleness.
works.title: The Land of Cockaigne

works.caption: The actress Yermolova stands ramrod straight before a mirrored hall, Serov's severe verticals and near-monochrome black dress turning a portrait into a statement of will.
works.title: Portrait of Maria Yermolova

works.caption: A gnarled tree's branches splinter into a lattice of grey and black strokes, Mondrian pushing observed nature to the very edge of pure abstraction.
works.title: Gray Tree

works.caption: The infant Christ and young Baptist exchange a scroll inscribed 'AGNUS' within a perfect tondo, Raphael balancing the Madonna's downward gaze against a luminous distant landscape.
works.title: Terranuova Madonna

works.caption: Mary sits on her mother Anne's lap reaching for the Christ Child as he wrestles a lamb, the pyramidal group set against Leonarda's hazy blue mountains -- his final great compositional experiment.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint Anne

works.caption: Ulysses, lashed to the mast, strains toward bird-women sirens swarming his galley, Waterhouse's sea-green palette and taut rigging heightening the myth's menace.
works.title: Ulysses and the Sirens

works.caption: Kneeling figures, saints and monarchs converge below a blazing 'IHS' monogram in the clouds while the damned are swallowed by a monstrous mouth at right -- El Greco's most feverish vision.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Adoration of the name of Jesus

works.caption: A ragged boy sits in a shaft of light, absorbed in picking through shrimp shells beside a cracked earthenware jug -- Murillo elevating street poverty to tender monumentality.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Young Beggar

works.caption: Christ's limp body is lowered by torchlight from the cross into a sheet held taut by strained onlookers, Rembrandt concentrating all drama into a single pool of illumination.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: A blood-red, storm-torn sky burns above a still mountain lake at dusk, Church turning the Hudson River School sublime into something almost apocalyptic.
works.title: Twilight in the Wilderness

works.caption: Christ's body forms a shallow arc echoed exactly by the swooning Virgin below him, van der Weyden compressing ten figures into a shallow gilded box with unbearable emotional precision.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: Late Rembrandt at his most searching: a weathered, unflinching self-scrutiny rendered in thick, glowing impasto against near-total darkness.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Self-portrait with easel

works.caption: Rubens presents himself and his young bride hand in hand beneath a honeysuckle bower, their fine costumes and easy intimacy radiating marital pride.
works.collection: Johann Wilhelm von der Pfalz collection
works.title: Rubens and Isabella Brant in the honeysuckle bower

works.caption: Game birds, fruit, and a great arc of cardoon hang and curve within a stone window frame, each form isolated by a stark black ground into near-abstract geometry.
works.title: Still Life with Game Fowl,Vegetables and Fruits

works.caption: Van Eyck packs two panels with encyclopedic detail, from the crowded, sunlit Calvary to a writhing, minutely rendered inferno beneath Christ enthroned in judgment.
works.title: Crucifixion and Last Judgement diptych

works.caption: Two Tahitian women sit close together beneath blossoming boughs while a sly, demonic-eyed figure watches from the shadows, Gauguin's flattened color at its most enigmatic.
works.title: Barbarian Tales

works.caption: A tilted white square barely emerges from its white ground through subtle shifts in impasto and edge, Malevich pushing painting to the vanishing point of representation.
works.title: Suprematist Composition: White on White

works.caption: David buries his face in Jonathan's shoulder in a farewell embrace, the richly worked turban and sword contrasting with the raw, quiet grief of the pose.
works.title: Separation of David and Jonathan

works.caption: The dead Narcissus lies stretched beside the pool as Echo dissolves into the rock behind him, a torch-bearing Cupid the only witness in this hushed, autumnal glade.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Echo and Narcissus

works.caption: Oedipus leans in cool concentration over the riddling Sphinx, his sculpted anatomy lit against the cave's darkness while bones litter the ground below.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx

works.caption: Ruined church towers loom over scattered tombs beneath a stormy sky split by a faint rainbow, Ruisdael turning a real cemetery into a meditation on mortality and time.
works.title: The Jewish Cemetery

works.caption: The boy recoils mid-flinch as a lizard bites his finger, Caravaggio freezing the instant of shock with a rose behind his ear and glinting glass of water beside him.
works.title: Boy Bitten by a Lizard

works.caption: A rearing red horse dissolves into streaks of motion amid struggling workers and factory towers, Boccioni fusing animal energy and industrial modernity into pure Futurist force.
works.title: The City Rises

works.caption: Gondolas and cargo boats crowd the Grand Canal beneath crisp light and towering palazzo facades, Canaletto's precise perspective making Venice feel both monumental and lived-in.
works.title: The Grand Canal from San Vio, Venice

works.caption: A painter in slashed sleeves works before a model costumed as Clio, the heavy map, chandelier, and patterned tapestry curtain staging Vermeer's meditation on the art of painting itself.
works.title: The Art of Painting

works.caption: A farmhouse's blocky planes sit beneath the faceted grey-blue mass of Sainte-Victoire, Cézanne building the whole Provençal scene from disciplined, structural patches of color.
works.title: Maison devant la Sainte-Victoire près de Gardanne (House in Provence)

works.caption: Mary floats on a crescent moon amid tumbling putti and a radiant dove, her sky-blue mantle and golden light dissolving into Tiepolo's characteristic airy palette.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception

works.caption: A flame-black cypress spirals against swirling stars and a crescent moon, one of van Gogh's late Saint-Rémy visions fusing loaded, rope-like brushwork with a folkloric wayside scene below.
works.title: Road with Cypress and Star

works.caption: A writhing mass of hybrid monsters, fish, and insect-winged demons tumbles beneath armored angels, Bruegel's hallucinatory bestiary rendered with jeweler's precision across every inch.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels

works.caption: A youthful, armored archangel plants a sandaled foot on a writhing demon, his lance and windblown drapery set against a serene Umbrian landscape.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: St. Michael Vanquishing Satan

works.caption: A straw-hatted peasant woman in a polka-dotted blouse sits before a field rendered in urgent parallel strokes, van Gogh's color contrasts turning a portrait study incandescent.
works.title: Peasant Woman Against a Background of Wheat

works.caption: Elongated Roman officers debate in animated discussion below a choir of musical angels crowning the martyrs, El Greco's acid blues and coiled poses building toward celestial reward.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: The Martyrdom of St. Maurice

works.caption: Three goddesses process past Paris seated beneath a tree, their rhythmic silhouettes and Botticelli's linear grace playing out against a wide Tuscan-Mediterranean panorama.
works.title: Judgement of Paris

works.caption: A young woman parts her fur-lined cloak against a screen of laurel leaves, Giorgione's velvety shadow and enigmatic half-smile epitomizing Venetian High Renaissance portraiture.
works.title: Laura

works.caption: Turbaned kings, mounted soldiers, and camels crowd a torchlit stable in a sweeping frieze of flesh and fabric, Rubens marshaling a cast of dozens around the swaddled infant.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: God the Father surges forward mid-flight, releasing birds and beasts into a teeming shoreline, Tintoretto's diagonal energy and animal inventory turning Genesis into a cinematic burst.
works.title: Creation of the Animals

works.caption: The Trinity and a throng of Old Testament figures ascend through billowing clouds toward a shared golden light, Titian's late, loosely brushed vision of celestial reunion.
works.title: La Gloria

works.caption: A choir of trumpeting angels unfurls a scroll above the manger while barefoot shepherds kneel in awe, El Greco's vertical panel compressing heaven and earth into one flickering column of light.
works.collection: National Museum of Art of Romania
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: A host of angel-musicians floats on cloudbanks above Gabriel and Mary, El Greco's mature style dissolving architecture into pure vertical light and swirling drapery.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Christ's pale body hangs beneath swirling storm-grey clouds as angels catch his blood in chalices, El Greco's electric palette of blue, green, and crimson framing the mourners below.
works.title: The Crucifixion

works.caption: A mother gazes through gauzy curtains at her sleeping infant, Morisot's feathery, translucent brushwork making the veil itself the picture's true subject.
works.title: The Cradle

works.caption: A cluster of sleeping female figures spirals within a riot of floral and geometric patchwork, Klimt's late decorative style folding bodies and ornament into a single pulsing mass.
works.title: The Maiden

works.caption: Mary's swollen, barefoot corpse lies beneath a vast red canopy as apostles grieve in raw, unposed sorrow, Caravaggio's tenebrism turning scandal into devastating humanity.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Death of the Virgin

works.caption: Five black-clad regentesses fix the viewer with unflinching, individualized stares, Hals's late, almost monochrome brushwork stripping institutional portraiture to severe psychological truth.
works.title: Regentesses of the Old Men's Alms House

works.caption: Christ hangs serenely on the cross between sun and moon, saints and mourners arranged in perfect symmetrical calm, Raphael's youthful clarity and pale Umbrian landscape defining early Renaissance harmony.
works.title: Mond Crucifixion

works.caption: A miniature soldier marches past a mock drummer and a boy absorbed in a peep-show box, Goya's early tapestry-cartoon wit on full display.
works.title: Boys playing soldiers

works.caption: Mother and child share a quiet exchange over an open prayer book, Raphael balancing crimson, blue, and a soft Umbrian hillside behind them.
works.title: Solly Madonna

works.caption: Venus clings to her departing lover as his hounds strain at the leash, Titian's late brushwork dissolving flesh and cloth into warm, urgent motion.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: A barn packed with feasting villagers, pies ferried on a makeshift door-tray, a bagpiper eyeing the food -- Bruegel's most beloved slice of rural life.
works.title: The Peasant Wedding
