works.caption: Four vessels in gold, white, and terracotta stand in a row against total darkness, each one a study in the geometry of light on curved clay.
works.title: Still Life with Pots

works.caption: A man looms by a closed door while a woman huddles at the far side of a lamplit bedroom, Degas staging an unresolved, wordless confrontation.
works.title: Interior

works.caption: A boy in shimmering satin poses against a stormy landscape, Gainsborough's virtuoso blues answering the received wisdom against cool-toned focal figures.
works.collection: The Huntington Library, Art Museum, and Botanical Gardens
works.title: The Blue Boy

works.caption: A flat, moon-round face built from warm color blocks and a few incised lines, Klee reducing portraiture to pure geometric wit.
works.title: Senecio

works.caption: A storm breaks over a flooding river valley while an old couple and their divine guests look on from a rocky outcrop, Rubens unleashing weather as protagonist.
works.title: Landscape with Philemon and Baucis

works.caption: A tranquil river bend framed by feathery trees dwarfs the biblical episode below, Claude's golden light doing the real storytelling.
works.title: Landscape with the Finding of Moses

works.caption: A lone tower and a wide estuary glow under a fading sun, tiny figures of Tobias and the angel barely disturbing the hush.
works.title: Landscape with Tobias and the Angel

works.caption: Ships rig their sails before a harbor of imagined classical architecture, Claude's pearly light unifying stone, water, and sky.
works.title: Landscape with the Embarkation of Saint Paula Romana at Ostia

works.caption: Rose petals, a lizard, and a half-open book litter the desk before a melancholy sitter whose sidelong glance seems to interrupt private thought.
works.title: Portrait of a gentleman in his studio

works.caption: Two women in white stride along a clifftop in sea wind, Sorolla dissolving fabric and surf alike into rippling strokes of light.
works.title: Walk on the mountain

works.caption: Tongues of fire descend on a huddled, upturned assembly, El Greco's elongated figures and acid color compressing the scene into visionary intensity.
works.title: The Pentecost

works.caption: Barcelona's city councillors kneel in prayer before an enthroned Virgin beneath a canopy of carved Gothic tracery, an early landmark of Catalan panel painting.
works.title: Virgin of the Councillors

works.caption: Steam and iron trelliswork merge into a single grey haze, Monet finding an industrial subject as atmospheric as any haystack.
works.title: Pont de l'Europe, gare Saint-Lazare

works.caption: A young woman lies face-down on a bed while a shrouded spirit-figure watches from the shadows, Gauguin fusing Tahitian belief with Symbolist unease.
works.title: Manaò tupapaú

works.caption: A jeweled headdress and blue backdrop frame Holbein's famously diplomatic likeness, every pearl and gold thread rendered with forensic precision.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Betrothal portrait of Anne of Cleves

works.caption: A mother anchors a pyramid of climbing children beneath swagged red drapery, a macaw perched nearby, Reynolds at his most grandly domestic.
works.title: Lady Cockburn and Her Three Eldest Sons

works.caption: The queen sits rigid in black velvet and pearls, a single red carnation held between gloved fingers, Mor's cool precision lending her an armored stillness.
works.title: Portrait of Mary Tudor

works.caption: Peace, in the form of a nursing nude, is shielded from armored Mars by Minerva's raised aegis, Rubens crowding the canvas with allegorical abundance.
works.title: Minerva Protects Pax from Mars

works.caption: Saint Anne looks on as the infant Christ nurses, El Greco's acid blues, reds, and yellows bound together by his signature elongation.
works.title: Holy Family with Saint Anne

works.caption: Mary, Joseph, and the infant Christ crowd close beneath a churning sky, El Greco's cool blues and hot reds vibrating against one another.
works.title: The Holy Family

works.caption: An emaciated old fisherman-saint, hand resting near his fish, emerges from darkness lit only by a raking, sculptural light.
works.title: Saint Andrew

works.caption: A bishop-saint in glittering gold-brocade vestments and a towering mitre reads from an open book, the pattern-work rendered with jeweler's precision against a turbulent sky.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Saint Ildefonso of Toledo

works.caption: A single candle flame throws warm light across Saint Irene's grieving attendants as they tend the arrow-pierced Sebastian, La Tour's nocturnal stillness at its most affecting.
works.title: Saint Sebastian tended by Saint Irene

works.caption: Rubens's Saturn bites into his own child with wild-eyed horror, muscular anatomy and raw psychological terror fused into one of the era's most unforgettable images.
works.title: Saturn

works.caption: Two fashionable young women in black lean close in quiet conversation, Renoir dissolving hats and lace into loose, luminous brushwork.
works.title: Young Girls in Black

works.caption: Lavoisier pauses his experiments to glance up as his wife leans over his shoulder, David rendering silk, marble, and laboratory glassware with equal crystalline precision.
works.title: Portrait of Antoine-Laurent Lavoisier and his wife

works.caption: Angels and shepherds crowd a ramshackle stable while a panoramic Flemish landscape unfolds beyond, Campin packing luminous detail into every inch of the scene.
works.title: Nativity

works.caption: A vision of angels descends over a bird's-eye Toledo while a youth unfurls a blank map at right, El Greco fusing cartography and apparition in one restless panorama.
works.title: View and Plan of Toledo

works.caption: Christ rises weightless above a tangle of startled, straining soldiers, El Greco's elongated bodies and flag-like drapery spiraling upward in pure Mannerist energy.
works.title: The Resurrection

works.caption: Two lovers embrace amid a crumbling, rose-choked ruin, Burne-Jones steeping the whole scene in a cool, dreamlike green twilight.
works.title: Love Among the Ruins

works.caption: Ruskin stands poised on the rocks beside a rushing Scottish waterfall, Millais rendering every wet stone and eddy with obsessive Pre-Raphaelite precision.
works.title: John Ruskin

works.caption: Lady Howe strikes a confident pose in shimmering pink silk and lace under a wide straw hat, Gainsborough's feathery brushwork animating both figure and stormy landscape.
works.title: Portrait of Mary, Countess Howe

works.caption: Semele swoons in the radiant embrace of a jewel-encrusted Jupiter, Moreau piling on gilded ornament and mythic figures until the whole throne room glitters like an icon.
works.title: Jupiter and Semele

works.caption: A flock of crows scatters up from a wheatfield under a churning, stormy blue sky, three paths vanishing into the grain in one of Van Gogh's final, most turbulent canvases.
works.title: Wheatfield with Crows

works.caption: A sprawling Roman orgy unfolds beneath towering marble colonnades and impassive statues, Couture staging decadence as a vast academic set-piece of flesh and architecture.
works.title: The Romans of the Decadence

works.caption: Marat's arm hangs limp over the bathtub's edge, his assassin's letter still in hand, David distilling revolutionary martyrdom into an austere field of near-total darkness.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Death of Marat

works.caption: A dense crowd of pilgrims trudges beneath an overhanging cliff, Goya's late, smoky brushwork turning a festive procession into something ominous and half-dissolved.
works.title: Pilgrimage to the Fountain of San Isidro

works.caption: A grinning procuress reaches for coin as a soldier fondles a courtesan, Vermeer's early Caravaggesque scene rich with pattern-woven carpet and glowing yellow satin.
works.title: The Procuress

works.caption: A slender suspension bridge arcs over the Seine toward a sunlit riverside village, Sisley layering crisp white clouds and rippling water in classic Impressionist calm.
works.title: The Bridge at Villeneuve-la-Garenne

works.caption: A sumptuous banquet crowds beneath towering Corinthian colonnades, Veronese arraying dogs, dwarfs, and richly dressed guests across a stage of pure Venetian spectacle.
works.title: The Feast in the House of Simon the Pharisee (Veronese, Turin)

works.caption: A nobleman presses his hand to his chest, the gesture and lace ruff catching the only light in an otherwise sober black costume, El Greco at his most restrained and psychologically direct.
works.title: The Nobleman with his Hand on his Chest

works.caption: A king lays his crown aside to gaze up at a barefoot beggar maid enthroned above him, Burne-Jones layering armor and drapery in dense, jewel-toned Pre-Raphaelite splendor.
works.title: King Cophetua and the Beggar Maid

works.caption: A lady pauses her letter-writing as her maid glances toward the window, Vermeer setting the quiet domestic moment beneath a large mythological painting-within-the-painting.
works.title: Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid

works.caption: A dizzying trompe-l'oeil corridor of Venetian architecture, gold light striking down through the clouds while a peacock and Persian carpet crown the loggia above.
works.title: The Annunciation, with Saint Emidius

works.caption: Four sisters scattered into the shadowy depths of a Boston parlor, the giant blue-and-white Japanese vases looming as silent, almost human presences beside them.
works.title: The Daughters of Edward Darley Boit

works.caption: Ingres renders Joan of Arc as a gleaming steel icon at the altar, cold armor and hot fleur-de-lis banner set against near-black tapestry.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Joan of Arc at the Coronation of Charles VII

works.caption: Fireworks dissolve into pure atmosphere over the Thames, gold sparks scattered across a near-abstract field of nocturnal blue-black.
works.title: Nocturne in Black and Gold – The Falling Rocket

works.caption: A young kitchen maid broods over pots and garlic in the foreground while the Supper at Emmaus glows faintly through a hatch behind her.
works.title: Kitchen Scene with the Supper in Emmaus

works.caption: Rubens revels in horror as a nest of writhing snakes and small reptiles swarms the severed, still-beautiful head of Medusa.
works.title: Head of Medusa

works.caption: Holbein's courtesan meets the viewer's gaze with cool detachment, her hand resting beside a small pile of coins against rich orange and crimson silk.
works.title: Lais of Corinth

works.caption: Titian's virtuoso handling of scarlet silk moiré wraps the young cardinal, whose direct, faintly wary gaze anchors the whole portrait.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Alessandro Farnese

works.caption: Schongauer's Madonna sits enthroned in a bower of roses rendered with jeweler's precision, angels lowering a golden crown above her head.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose Bower

works.caption: A late van Gogh panorama of Auvers farmland, quilted furrows of green and violet racing toward a distant train under a shimmering teal sky.
works.title: Landscape with a Carriage and a Train

works.caption: Bellini's hermit saint reads calmly at the mouth of a sculpted rose-colored cave, an obedient lion at his feet and a serene blue valley beyond.
works.title: Saint Jerome in the Desert

works.caption: The Madonna and Child rest beneath a fruit-laden tree while a garland of tumbling putti gathers game birds and a green parrot looks on.
works.title: Madonna with Partridges

works.caption: El Greco's elongated, sagging Christ is cradled by God the Father against a searing gold sky, angels in acid violet and green pressing close around them.
works.collection: Monastery of Saint Dominic of Silos
works.title: The Holy Trinity

works.caption: Christ descends in a mandorla of angels above the dying Virgin, the apostles' grief rendered in a dazzling arc of jewel-toned robes around her deathbed.
works.title: Death of the Virgin

works.caption: Leonardo's court beauty emerges from pure black, her jeweled brow band and crimson-gold sleeves rendered with sculptural clarity.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: La Belle Ferronnière

works.caption: Copernicus kneels rapt beneath a starlit sky on a moonlit terrace, his outstretched hands and armillary sphere framing a moment of astronomical revelation.
works.title: Astronomer Copernicus, or Conversations with God

works.caption: The court jester slumps in scarlet motley, his troubled private grief lit against the distant, oblivious revelry glimpsed through the doorway.
works.title: Stańczyk

works.caption: Rembrandt arranges the surgeons' ruffed faces in a taut pyramid of attention around the cadaver's exposed forearm tendons, the whole scene lit like a stage.
works.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp

works.caption: Demuth's blazing gold '5' bursts across a fractured Precisionist cityscape of lights and lettering, a jazz-age homage to a passing fire truck.
works.title: I Saw the Figure 5 in Gold

works.caption: Caravaggio choreographs a con: hidden fingers signal a card behind a sharper's back while the naive mark studies his own hand, oblivious.
works.title: The Cardsharps

works.caption: A woman's bare back and its mirrored reflection form a quiet double portrait, Eckersberg's Danish Golden Age precision lending the intimate scene a cool, sculptural stillness.
works.title: A nude woman doing her hair before a mirror

works.caption: Bruegel buries the fallen Saul in a teeming column of pikemen and cavalry threading a vertiginous Alpine pass, faith reduced to one small drama among hundreds.
works.title: Conversion of Paul

works.caption: A peasant strides obliviously toward a ditch while a boy plunders a bird's nest overhead, Bruegel's proverb unfolding in crisp, sunny detail.
works.title: The Peasant and the Nest Robber

works.caption: Bierstadt bathes Yosemite's granite cliffs in golden haze, the valley floor receding into a luminous, almost religious distance.
works.title: Looking Down Yosemite Valley, California

works.caption: Pisanello crowds his forest vision with jewel-like deer, hounds and birds, a tiny crucified Christ appearing between a stag's antlers.
works.title: The Vision of Saint Eustace

works.caption: Two Tahitian women lounge with a sleeping cat, one smoking with languid defiance, Gauguin's title a wry jab at colonial expectations of labor.
works.title: Not to work

works.caption: A funerary wisp of smoke curls beside a man swinging an axe as peacocks strut through blazing orange hillside beneath a leaning palm.
works.title: Matamoe (Death), Landscape with Peacocks

works.caption: The Christ Child reaches up to touch his mother's chin, Bellini's tender gesture set between a green curtain and a pale, luminous landscape.
works.title: Willys Madonna

works.caption: Byzantine gold-ground severity softens into tenderness in the child's grasp at his mother's veil, a hinge moment between icon and portrait.
works.title: Madonna with Child and six Angels

works.caption: Flat cobalt ground and slashing vermilion pattern flatten the sitter into pure color incident, the red headscarf ringing like a bell against the blue.
works.title: Madras Rouge

works.caption: Clashing reds and greens turn a billiard hall into what Van Gogh called a place where one can ruin oneself or go mad; watch how the floor tilts and the lamps halo in sickly yellow.
works.title: The Night Café

works.caption: A serene, closed-eyed Christ is crushed by a ring of grotesque, snarling faces, Bosch's catalogue of human cruelty painted with caricaturist's glee.
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: Dappled sun through dark foliage falls in broken patches on a white dress, an early experiment in painting light itself rather than form.
works.title: Woman in the Garden

works.caption: Ochre quarry walls are built from flat, faceted planes that echo the mountain behind them, blurring the line between geology and geometry.
works.title: Mountains Mont Sainte-Victoire Seen from the Bibémus Quarry

works.caption: Sunlight falls through leaves in mottled blue-violet patches across a crowd of dancers; the shadows on faces and straw hats are painted in color, never black.
works.title: Bal du moulin de la Galette

works.caption: Three straining bodies form a diagonal wheel around the old saint's upturned, unflinching gaze, his executioners' faces hidden from view.
works.title: Crucifixion of Saint Peter

works.caption: Christ collapses under the cross in the lower right, all but lost in a teeming panorama of hundreds of figures indifferent to his suffering.
works.title: The Procession to Calvary

works.caption: An austere arrangement of black, gray, and white; note the framed etching and patterned curtain that turn a portrait into a study in tonal harmony.
works.title: Whistler's Mother

works.caption: Rank upon rank of saints, martyrs, and kings kneel in concentric arcs beneath the crucified Christ, a virtuoso display of massed, individualized portraiture.
works.title: Adoration of the Trinity

works.caption: Ancient ruins dissolve into golden haze, ochre and pearl-gray light nearly erasing the architecture it illuminates.
works.title: Modern Rome – Campo Vaccino

works.caption: A teeming town square splits between feasting and fasting, hundreds of tiny figures rendered with encyclopedic, wry detail.
works.title: The Fight Between Carnival and Lent

works.caption: A windswept pine frames the mountain like a proscenium arch, its dark branches set against pale rock built from overlapping color planes.
works.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire with Large Pine

works.caption: Red tree trunks snake through impossibly blue and orange hillsides, pure unmixed color standing in for light and shadow alike.
works.title: Mountains at Collioure

works.caption: A tiny solitary figure faces an overwhelming void of sea and sky, one of art history's starkest meditations on human insignificance.
works.title: The Monk by the Sea

works.caption: Over two hundred children swarm a town square playing dozens of distinct games, an exhaustive, slightly unsettling catalogue of childhood.
works.title: Children's Games

works.caption: The Christ child himself is the sole light source, his glow illuminating Mary's face from below in one of painting's earliest nocturnes.
works.title: Nativity at Night

works.caption: A twisting, reaching infant strains toward a flower held just out of frame; note the crystalline distant mountains glimpsed through the loggia.
works.title: Madonna of the Carnation

works.caption: A vast red curtain swallows the upper half of the canvas, weighting the composition toward the pleading, upturned hands below.
works.title: Madonna of the Rosary

works.caption: Cattle and drovers trudge home under a darkening autumn sky, the vast river valley beyond rendered in cooling, atmospheric blues.
works.title: The Return of the Herd

works.caption: Gold leaf and mosaic pattern swallow two embracing bodies almost entirely, leaving only faces, hands, and feet as flesh.
works.title: The Kiss

works.caption: A collector displays his wares with theatrical pride, the antiquities dealer's outstretched red sleeve leading straight to a marble statuette.
works.title: Portrait of Jacopo Strada

works.caption: The artist's hand balloons grotesquely in the foreground, painted on an actual convex panel to mimic the barbershop mirror he used.
works.title: Self-portrait in a Convex Mirror

works.caption: A curtain, framed drawing, and fruit bowl push into the foreground, the reader's face lit by unseen daylight from the left.
works.title: Girl Reading a Letter at an Open Window

works.caption: Io dissolves into an embrace with a barely visible cloud-god, her rapture painted with a softness that borders on the erotic.
works.title: Jupiter and Io

works.caption: A dagger hovers at her breast as Lucretia's upturned eyes fix on something beyond the frame, Gentileschi's favored image of female resolve under violence.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: A radically off-kilter composition scatters figures and a dog across an empty square, capturing the restless drift of modern Parisian life.
works.title: Place de la Concorde

works.caption: Thames twilight dissolves into near-monochrome blue, a lone figure and faint lights the only anchors in a hushed tonal harmony.
works.title: Nocturne: Blue and Silver – Chelsea

works.caption: Pearls cascade down brocaded crimson and gold as a mountain landscape opens behind her; a posthumous portrait built entirely from memory and other likenesses.
works.title: Portrait of Isabella of Portugal

works.caption: Acid green ground vibrates against the sitter's dark bonnet and coat, a tender study built from Van Gogh's characteristic urgent hatching.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist's Mother

works.caption: Reclining flesh, tousled hair, and a knowing gaze turn a mythic subject into frank, unabashed portraiture; the small dog and busy maids behind only heighten the intimacy of the foreground.
works.title: Venus of Urbino

works.caption: Ropes strain against a hoisted, twisting body, its anatomy lit with unflinching, sculptural clarity against a pale Roman sky.
works.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Philip

works.caption: Planted squarely and staring straight out, the court dwarf is painted with the same gravity and dignity as any grandee.
works.title: Portrait of Sebastián de Morra

works.caption: A marble processional stair overflows with garlands and flower-strewn crowds, sunlit stone rendered with obsessive, almost photographic finish.
works.title: Spring

works.caption: Geometric solids and a suspended crystal rhombicuboctahedron turn a mathematician's portrait into a meditation on proportion itself.
works.title: Portrait of Luca Pacioli

works.caption: Chalky cliffside crowds watch a fleet of white sails cut across turquoise water, painted in the loose, sunlit strokes soon to define Impressionism.
works.title: Regatta at Sainte-Adresse

works.caption: Grief contorts every mourner's face and gesture around Christ's pale, slumped body, the composition's rhythmic drapery folds channeling collective sorrow.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ

works.caption: A reclining nude meets the viewer's eye with cool, unapologetic directness, the arched black cat and offered bouquet sharpening the painting's scandalous frankness.
works.title: Olympia

works.caption: Snow settles over a martyr's sprawled body in the forum as doves circle above, the pale palette turning violence into eerie stillness.
works.title: Saint Eulalia

works.caption: A powerfully modeled nude figure gestures skyward against a luminous landscape, the lamb at his feet almost an afterthought beside the muscular anatomy.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Deep shadow and a wide-brimmed fur hat frame a weathered, unflinching gaze, painted with the loaded, textured brushwork of Rembrandt's late maturity.
works.title: Self Portrait

works.caption: An angel's bare back turns toward the viewer as it plays violin for the sleeping family, Joseph steadying the score with a battered peasant's hands.
works.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: A youth gazes into his own dark reflection, the composition split almost symmetrically between flesh and its watery double.
works.title: Narcissuss

works.caption: A court jester's crooked smile and searching eyes are rendered with startling psychological immediacy against a shadowy void, the loose, almost abstract brushwork of his black doublet melting into the darkness.
works.title: The Jester Calabacillas

works.caption: Silvery trees feather against a pearl-toned sky above a still lake, three tiny figures gathering flowers beneath — the quintessence of Corot's misty, elegiac souvenir landscapes.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Recollection of Mortefontaine

works.caption: Sunlit young men lounge, dive, and swim from a stone quarry ledge, Eakins arranging bodies into an almost classical frieze while keeping the sensation thoroughly American and outdoors.
works.collection: Amon Carter Museum of American Art
works.title: Swimming

works.caption: A pajama-clad man and a seated woman face off across an electric cobalt room, a wrought-iron balcony and glimpse of garden the only relief from Matisse's saturated, airless blue.
works.title: The Conversation

works.caption: Sunlight rakes across a brick archway and cobbled yard as a mother and child pause in a doorway, de Hooch building an entire world of quiet domestic order from receding thresholds of light.
works.title: The Courtyard of a House in Delft

works.caption: A greenish, cadaverous Christ hangs against a bare ochre ground while Mary and John gaze up in restrained grief, ter Brugghen's Caravaggesque light modeling flesh with unflinching, almost clinical precision.
works.title: The Crucifixion with the Virgin and St John

works.caption: Ships wait at anchor in a glowing harbor framed by classical ruins and a grand palace, the low sun dissolving into golden haze across the water — Claude's idealized seaport at its most luminous.
works.title: The Embarkation of the Queen of Sheba

works.caption: The defeated Persian royal family kneels before Alexander amid a marble colonnade thronged with Venetian courtiers, Veronese turning ancient history into a pageant of silk, armor, and pearl.
works.title: The Family of Darius Before Alexander

works.caption: A fox flounders through deep snow as crows wheel down to attack, Homer flattening the composition into stark bands of white, brown, and slate that read as pure winter menace.
works.collection: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
works.title: Fox Hunt

works.caption: Eighteen women in flowing silver-gray robes descend a great spiral stair in single file, Burne-Jones dissolving narrative into pure rhythmic pattern of drapery and step.
works.title: The Golden Stairs

works.caption: A lone sailor lies stranded on a dismasted boat as sharks circle in turbulent, wine-dark water and a waterspout looms on the horizon — Homer's starkest vision of man against an indifferent sea.
works.title: The Gulf Stream

works.caption: King Arthur lies beneath a gilded, tapestry-hung canopy while mourning women in jewel-toned robes crowd around him; note the obsessive detail in the carved gold frieze overhead.
works.title: The Last Sleep of Arthur in Avalon

works.caption: A bargeman strains at a lock gate beneath a towering, wind-tossed oak, storm clouds massing behind a luminous stretch of Suffolk sky — Constable's cloud studies made monumental.
works.title: The Lock

works.caption: A sorceress traces a fiery circle in the sand, crows and a skull at her feet; the acid greens and coppers of her robe against the scorched landscape carry the picture's uncanny charge.
works.title: The Magic Circle

works.caption: Bound figures, a hanging lamp, a strangled woman on a table — Beckmann's angular, claustrophobic tableau of postwar violence is one of German Expressionism's defining images.
works.title: The Night

works.caption: Three figures in white and black stand rigid behind green iron railings, their gazes not meeting — Manet's cool, enigmatic surfaces make an ordinary balcony scene feel unresolved and modern.
works.title: The Balcony

works.caption: Christ's raised hand commands the shrouded corpse to rise from a dark tomb, onlookers recoiling in astonishment; Rembrandt's spotlight isolates the miracle from an engulfing shadow.
works.title: The Raising of Lazarus

works.caption: A Shoshone encampment spreads across a valley floor beneath snow-capped peaks and a plunging waterfall — Bierstadt's grandiose, luminous vision of the American West.
works.title: The Rocky Mountains, Lander's Peak

works.caption: Reapers break for a midday meal beneath a single pear tree while others cut wheat down a golden slope to a distant harbor — Bruegel's panoramic view of labor and season is endlessly legible.
works.title: The Harvesters

works.caption: An Ottoman tortoise trainer stands hunched over his slow charges before a tiled mosque niche — Osman Hamdi Bey's crisp, ironic riposte to Orientalist painting, now an icon in its own right.
works.title: The Tortoise Trainer

works.artist: Jan Vermeer van Haarlem the Elder
works.artistSort: Elder, Jan Vermeer van Haarlem the
works.caption: A woman at a table hesitates over her wine as a cavalier leans in, stained glass casting colored light across the room — Vermeer's quiet study in unspoken persuasion.
works.title: The Wine Glass

works.caption: St John emerges from total darkness, one finger raised toward heaven, his knowing half-smile lit by an impossibly soft glow — Leonardo's sfumato pushed to its ambiguous limit.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: A gravely ill prince reclines while a physician reads his pulse and secretly watches his stepmother across the room — Ingres stages the diagnosis of lovesickness with crystalline, frieze-like precision.
works.title: Antiochus and Stratonice

works.caption: Dozens of Old Master paintings and antique statues crowd a red-walled octagonal gallery while connoisseurs cluster around a reclining Venus — Zoffany's catalogue-like record of the Uffizi's most prized room.
works.title: The Tribuna of the Uffizi

works.caption: A reclining Venus turns from an organist mid-performance, the garden fountain and avenue of poplars stretching out the window behind her — one of Titian's several variations on music and desire.
works.title: Venus and Music

works.caption: Two women, one richly dressed and one nude, flank a marble sarcophagus-turned-fountain in a golden Venetian landscape — Titian's most debated and most purely beautiful allegory.
works.title: Sacred and Profane Love

works.caption: A woman's downcast face and cascading curls emerge from bare wood ground in soft ochre and umber, barely more than underpainting — Leonardo's famously unfinished 'Scapigliata'.
works.title: Head of a Woman

works.caption: A wreathed, androgynous Bacchus points into the shadows while seated in a dim grotto, ivy and leopard skin draped over pale, sculptural flesh — a Leonardesque fantasy of ambiguous sensuality.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bacchus

works.caption: Seen sharply from behind, the top-hatted flaneur is dwarfed by the geometric grid of Haussmann balconies and windows outside; the crimson armchair anchors the near-photographic perspective.
works.title: Young Man at His Window

works.caption: A vast pageant painting split between courtly stillness on the left and straining rope-and-pulley labor on the right, the great bronze bell suspended mid-hoist as the true protagonist.
works.title: The Hanging of the Sigismund bell at the Cathedral Tower in 1521 in Kraków

works.caption: A lone armored woman strides through a hellscape of grotesque monsters and burning towns, plunder in her arms, Bruegel's nightmare crowded with tiny, ghoulish incident in every corner.
works.title: Dull Gret

works.caption: Manet at his easel, brush raised, is ringed by a somber cluster of black-suited admirers against a wall hung with pictures — a manifesto of the new painting disguised as a group portrait.
works.title: A Studio at Les Batignolles

works.caption: A crowded Renaissance dinner table becomes a stage for concealed cruelty — watch the foot crushing the dog beneath it while Isabella and Lorenzo share an orange in oblivious tenderness.
works.title: Isabella

works.caption: A wife shields her freed prisoner-husband's face against her shoulder as she hands over his release papers, her red shawl and the loyal collie the only warm notes in a scene of prison-yard relief.
works.title: The Order of Release

works.caption: Monet paints his wife from behind in a swirl of black and viridian striped silk, the fabric's sheen and weight rendered with a virtuosity that outshines the sitter's half-turned face.
works.title: Camille

works.caption: Venus unbuckles the sandal of a bare, cloak-draped Mars amid billowing cloud and marble, cupids fussing with his weapons — David's coolly erotic late-career return to classical myth.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Mars Being Disarmed by Venus

works.caption: A churning double spiral of ascending saints and plunging damned fills the canvas from a small enthroned Christ, Rubens piling flesh upon flesh into a vertiginous baroque vortex.
works.title: The Great Last Judgement

works.caption: Mother and child stand before a jewel-toned cloth of honor held by hovering angels, a bronze fountain in the foreground — van Eyck's obsessive clarity turning brocade and feather into near-tactile fact.
works.title: Madonna at the Fountain

works.caption: Three late-night customers and a soda jerk sit lit up like a stage set inside a wedge-shaped diner, the empty street outside rendered in the same cool, sourceless glow that makes the whole scene feel suspended in time.
works.title: Nighthawks

works.caption: A young woman glances toward a shuttered window while tuning her lute, the map on the wall behind her and the pearl light along her sleeve exemplifying Vermeer's hushed interior stillness.
works.title: Woman with a Lute

works.caption: A sleeping woman curls within a vast cascade of saffron drapery, her pose a coiled spiral that Leighton frames against a hazy Mediterranean horizon and a single spray of oleander.
works.title: Flaming June

works.caption: Two sinuous nudes drift through a decorative sea of jeweled flowers and gold filigree, Klimt flattening water, hair, and skin into one continuous ornamental surface.
works.title: Water Serpents II

works.caption: The Madonna's impossibly elongated neck and fingers, an oversized sleeping Christ child sprawled across her lap, and a lone column receding beside a tiny distant figure make this Mannerism's most unsettling icon.
works.title: Madonna with the Long Neck

works.caption: A young noblewoman in gold-and-white brocade holds a marten-fur zibellino, its jeweled head glinting against her gloved hand — Parmigianino's cool, enameled precision at its height.
works.title: Antea

works.caption: Sea nymphs cluster around Icarus's fallen, wing-draped body on a rock above the waves, the enormous feathered wings dominating the composition more than the youth's slack limbs.
works.title: The Lament for Icarus

works.caption: Skaters and a bird trap share a frozen village pond rendered in bleached ochre and grey, Bruegel scattering tiny black figures and crows across the ice with encyclopedic patience.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Winter Landscape with a Bird Trap

works.caption: Three men of different ages and dress study the coming dawn from a wooded hillside, Giorgione leaving their identities and dialogue deliberately unresolved.
works.title: The Three Philosophers

works.caption: Two women shield a candle with cupped hands, its warm light modeling the swaddled newborn's face with an almost sculptural clarity against the surrounding darkness — La Tour's candlelit stillness at its most tender.
works.title: The Newborn

works.caption: A swaggering young burgher in black lace-collared finery leans on his rapier before a swagged red curtain, Hals loosening his brushwork just enough to animate the stiff formal pose.
works.title: Willem van Heythuysen posing with a sword

works.caption: A triptych of quiet Nativity devotion flanked by donor portraits, the central stable scene opening onto a detailed Flemish townscape beyond its ruined timber roof.
works.title: Bladelin Triptych

works.caption: A crucifix atop a fir-crowned rocky peak catches the last rays of a setting sun that fan out across the sky like a halo — Friedrich's radical substitution of landscape for altarpiece narrative.
works.title: Altarpiece Tetschen

works.caption: A blindfolded, bowed figure perches on a globe, plucking a single unbroken string on an otherwise stringless lyre — Watts's allegory rendered in murky, glowing blue-green.
works.title: Hope

works.caption: A seamstress pauses over her sewing as a maid draws back a green curtain to reveal a seascape beyond, a spaniel poised on the threshold between the two women — Metsu's hushed narrative of interrupted domestic time.
works.title: Woman Reading a Letter

works.caption: Gauguin's sprawling frieze moves from a swaddled infant to an old woman near death, a blue idol presiding over the Tahitian figures in between — his summation of life's arc painted, by his own account, as a final testament.
works.title: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?

works.caption: Seen from behind with wings spread, a cupid carves his bow atop an open book while two putti wrestle beneath his standing leg — Parmigianino's cool enamel finish applied to a startlingly physical pose.
works.title: Cupid Making His Arch

works.caption: An extravagant white ostrich plume curls from a black beret, its softness set against the hard glint of a gold chain and medallion — Rembrandt's self-fashioning as swaggering, costumed bravado.
works.title: Self-portrait wearing a white feathered bonnet

works.caption: A brooding, half-shadowed youth reclines against a ram with a scarlet cloth pooled at his hip, Caravaggio's raking light and ambiguous, almost profane sensuality overriding any devotional register.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Grieving nymphs cradle the slain Adonis's pale body while a putto restrains two straining hounds, Rubens contrasting the cool, dead flesh against the women's warm, tear-streaked faces.
works.title: The Death of Adonis

works.caption: El Greco's elongated Magdalene twists toward a stormy sky, her hand pressed to her breast above a skull and open book.
works.title: The Penitent Mary Magdalene

works.caption: A bishop-saint stands rigid within a dazzling gilt-Gothic canopy, every inch of the cope embroidered with tiny narrative scenes.
works.title: Santo Domingo de Silos entronizado como obispo, de Bartolomé Bermejo (Museo del Prado)

works.caption: Saul weeps into a curtain while David plays the harp beside him, Rembrandt's thick impasto turban and pooling shadow charged with unspoken menace.
works.title: Saul and David

works.caption: Tahitian women sit in a row on a market bench, their flat, cloisonne-outlined silhouettes and clashing oranges and greens announcing Gauguin's Symbolist palette.
works.title: We Shall Not Go to the Market Today

works.caption: Eve hands Adam the apple beneath a winged putto in the Tree of Knowledge, Titian's fleshy nudes set against a luminous cloudscape.
works.title: The Fall of Man

works.caption: Gauguin's own weathered face looms before his painted Yellow Christ, fusing self-portraiture with martyrdom in flat Synthetist color.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist with the Yellow Christ

works.caption: Bacchic revelers whirl in a chain around a garlanded herm, Poussin's classical figures caught mid-step in a frieze of pagan abandon.
works.title: A Bacchanalian Revel Before a Term

works.caption: Soldiers press a crown of thorns onto Christ's brow, Rubens contrasting his luminous flesh against slashing diagonals of scarlet cloth.
works.title: Crown of Thorns

works.caption: A grave young woman in green and burgundy holds a small book, Raphael's clear, sculptural modeling giving her an almost mute stillness.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Woman

works.caption: River gods and their nymphs sprawl among a crocodile and tiger amid overturned urns, Rubens allegorizing the world's four continents as a riot of tawny flesh.
works.title: The Four Continents

works.caption: The royal family stands in unflattering, glittering array before a dim canvas of Goya himself at his easel, court portraiture turned quietly subversive.
works.title: Charles IV of Spain and His Family

works.caption: A grinning black banner looms over whirling masked dancers at Madrid's Ash Wednesday festival, Goya's crowd dissolving into feverish, gestural paint.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: The Burial of the Sardine

works.caption: A double row of slender poplars marches toward a distant village spire, Hobbema's plunging perspective and vast Dutch sky a landmark of landscape painting.
works.title: The Avenue at Middelharnis

works.caption: A maid arranges fruit at a table that dissolves into the same crimson arabesque as the wall behind her, Matisse flattening an entire dining room into pure decorative color.
works.title: The Dessert: Harmony in Red (The Red Room)

works.caption: A miraculous storm scatters onlookers down a plunging Venetian piazza as men bear the saint's rescued body, Tintoretto's radical perspective and stormy light electrifying the scene.
works.title: St Mark's Body Brought to Venice

works.caption: The Marchioness reclines in loose white muslin beside an ancient lyre, Goya's rapid, silvery brushwork animating the folds of drapery against deep red.
works.title: Portrait of the Marchioness of Santa Cruz

works.caption: Vermeer's only biblical scene: watch how the raking light models Christ's outstretched hand and Martha's basket of bread while Mary listens rapt at his knee.
works.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary

works.caption: One of art history's great enigmas: a lightning bolt splits a brooding sky over a soldier and a nursing woman, their meaning still unresolved after five centuries.
works.title: The Tempest

works.caption: Bosch imagines the afterlife as a luminous tunnel of swirling blue light, angels ferrying naked souls upward toward the radiant source.
works.collection: Palazzo Grimani di Santa Maria Formosa
works.title: Visions of the Hereafter: Ascent of the Blessed

works.caption: Gauguin flattens two Tahitian women into bold blocks of pink and vermilion against a striped sea, the patterned cloth doing as much work as the faces.
works.title: Tahitian Women on the Beach

works.caption: Painted in an asylum cell over nine obsessive years, Dadd crams a fairy court and a woodcutter mid-swing into a thicket of grass blades and hazelnuts.
works.title: The Fairy Feller's Master-Stroke

works.caption: Late Caravaggio at his starkest: a single unseen light rakes Christ's flank while his tormentors' faces stay half-swallowed by shadow.
works.title: Christ at the Column

works.caption: Van Dyck stages the betrayal as pure theater of gesture, Delilah's raised hand signaling the barber while Samson sleeps unaware in her lap.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: Fra Angelico's gilded polyptych glows with an almost architectural clarity, the enthroned Madonna flanked by saints under spired Gothic canopies.
works.title: Perugia Altarpiece

works.caption: Boccioni dissolves a Milan street scene into shards of motion and color, a shying horse and construction scaffolding fracturing into the crowd around them.
works.title: The Street Enters the House

works.caption: Rembrandt builds the old scholar's face from thick, worked light against a near-black robe, the quill and open book anchoring the quiet concentration.
works.title: Scholar at his desk

works.caption: Rubens tangles Venus and Adonis in a farewell embrace, cupid tugging at his cloak and the hunting dogs already straining toward the hunt that will kill him.
works.title: Venus and Adonis (Rubens, 1614)

works.caption: Titian's late pastoral idyll interrupts a sleeping Antiope with satyr and hunter, a huntsman blowing his horn while the landscape recedes into pale blue mountains.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Jupiter and Antiope

works.caption: Matejko crams a national trauma into one crowded chamber: Rejtan throws himself across the doorway while the assembled nobles recoil in a blaze of red velvet and gilt.
works.title: Rejtan

works.caption: Poussin choreographs a desert crowd's mix of gratitude and desperation as manna falls, each figure a distinct study in relief against a moody sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Israelites gathering Manna in the Desert

works.caption: Rubens variant of his Antwerp masterpiece: mourners lower Christ's pale body on a sheet, the diagonal composition pulling the eye down toward Mary Magdalene's grip.
works.title: Descent from the Cross

works.caption: A single dark cypress spears upward through a field of wind-blown green wheat, Van Gogh's brushwork as restless as the clouds above.
works.title: Green Wheat Field with Cypress

works.caption: Rembrandt catches Susanna mid-flinch, one hand clutching her shift, her wary glance out of the canvas doing all the narrative work.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Susanna

works.caption: Memling arranges Gabriel and Mary in a jewel-box interior, the dove descending in a golden roundel above a richly patterned tapestry bed.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: El Greco pairs the two apostles in quiet debate, Paul's open book and burning red robe set against Peter's earthen gold, hands gesturing mid-argument.
works.title: Saints Peter and Paul

works.caption: An early Netherlandish gem: John the Baptist broods alone in a meticulously observed wood, deer and birds scattered through the rolling, sunlit hills behind him.
works.title: John the Baptist in the Wilderness

works.caption: Rembrandt's late double portrait dissolves Matthew and his angel into a single mass of shadow, only the evangelist's lined face and writing hand fully lit.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Saint Matthew and the Angel

works.caption: Gierymski sets a weathered street vendor and her basket of oranges against a hazy, atmospheric view of Warsaw's rooftops and spires.
works.title: Jewess with Oranges

works.caption: Correggio's eagle carries a swooning Ganymede skyward in a dizzying upward diagonal, his dog left barking helplessly on the cliff below.
works.title: Ganymede Abducted by the Eagle

works.caption: Monet breaks the Seine into dabs of turquoise and gold at a popular bathing spot, the floating island's crowd and the moored boats melting into shimmer.
works.title: La Grenouillère

works.caption: Menzel bathes a glittering rococo concert hall in candlelight, the king's flute solo drawing every courtier's attention beneath twin crystal chandeliers.
works.title: Frederick the Great Playing the Flute at Sanssouci

works.caption: Caravaggio dresses the Grand Master in gleaming articulated armor, the young page's plumed helmet a soft counterpoint to all that hard metal.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Alof de Wignacourt and his Page

works.caption: Perugino sets his sitter's calm, direct gaze against a serene Umbrian landscape, the scroll reading 'Timete Deum' held loosely in his hand.
works.title: Portrait of Francesco delle Opere

works.caption: El Greco splits the canvas between an earthbound crowd of somber Spanish nobles and a swirling, elongated heaven above, the count's soul carried up between the two realms.
works.title: The Burial of the Count of Orgaz

works.caption: Raphael renders the veiled sitter's silk sleeve with more bravura brushwork than her composed, level gaze, gold embroidery catching every fold.
works.title: La velata

works.caption: Duccio's Madonna sits enthroned in gold-ground splendor, ranks of angels stacked in tender pairs down both sides of the towering gabled panel.
works.title: Rucellai Madonna

works.caption: El Greco elongates and unsettles his sitter, a poet-priest, with a spectral pallor and a black cowl that swallows the chair beneath him.
works.title: Fray Hortensio Félix Paravicino

works.caption: Botticelli's line describes the Christ Child's reaching arm and the Virgin's downcast gaze with a tenderness set against jewel-bright roses and gold haloes.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madonna and Child with the Young St. John the Baptist

works.caption: Veronese stages a riotous Venetian banquet beneath soaring loggias, every column and costume dissolving the biblical subject into pure theatrical splendor.
works.title: The Feast in the House of Levi

works.caption: Four young women toss a straw dummy skyward in Goya's tapestry cartoon, the clown-faced figure a sly emblem of women's power over men.
works.title: The Straw Manikin

works.caption: Bruegel crams a village kermis with stumbling dancers and gossiping drinkers, every gesture and thatched roof rendered with earthy, comic precision.
works.title: The Peasant Dance

works.caption: Cézanne builds the sitter's blue dress from faceted, architectural strokes, her folded hands as solid and still as the wallpaper panels behind her.
works.title: La Femme à la cafetière (Woman with a Coffeepot)

works.caption: West stages the general's death as a modern-dress pietà on the Plains of Abraham, redcoats and a solemn Native American witness framing the fallen hero.
works.title: The Death of General Wolfe

works.caption: Van Gogh dignifies a single worn pair of boots with thick, laboring impasto, dirt and creases painted like a portrait of hard-earned experience.
works.title: A Pair of Shoes

works.caption: Brown packs a pair of emigrants into a tondo composition, the woman's anxious face and gloved hand clutching her husband summing up Victorian anxieties about departure.
works.title: The Last of England

works.caption: Mantegna opens a startlingly deep river vista behind the apostles gathered at Mary's deathbed, perspective lines converging with mathematical rigor.
works.title: Death of the Virgin

works.caption: Two windswept figures hover above a distant cavalry skirmish in this Black Painting, Goya's murky ochre haze turning myth into hallucination.
works.title: Asmodea

works.caption: Millais renders Christ's carpentry-shop family with unsparing, almost forensic detail — real wood shavings, dirty fingernails, and a dove-lit window beyond.
works.title: Christ in the House of His Parents

works.caption: Rousseau's naive jungle explodes into flat, decorative leaves and grasses around a snarling tiger, self-taught invention rivaling any academic exoticism.
works.title: Tiger in a Tropical Storm

works.caption: Hals catches an unnamed gentleman mid-smirk beneath an enormous hat, virtuoso zigzag brushwork animating the embroidered sleeve and ruff.
works.title: Laughing Cavalier

works.caption: Mantegna crowds saints and a kneeling patron beneath a bower of fruit and coral around an enthroned Madonna, ornament and armor rendered with jewel-like density.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madonna della Vittoria

works.caption: Raphael compresses mother and children into a tight tondo, the Virgin's cheek pressed to her son's head in one of art history's most imitated poses of maternal tenderness.
works.title: Madonna della Seggiola

works.caption: Degas frames a bather bent double over her tub in raking pastel strokes, the awkward, unposed angle turning private ritual into pure form.
works.title: Woman in a Tub

works.caption: A grinning skeleton grips a nude young woman's hair in Baldung's memento mori, decayed flesh and youthful pallor locked in an unbreakable dance embrace.
works.title: Death and the Maiden (Baldung)

works.caption: David arranges Leonidas's doomed Spartans as a frieze of heroic nudes garlanding themselves for death, Neoclassical anatomy staged like a marble relief come to life.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Leonidas at Thermopylae

works.caption: Botticelli stacks heaven, earth, and a golden apocalyptic sky in tiers above the Nativity, dancing angels and embracing devils compressed into one radiant, anxious vision.
works.title: The Mystical Nativity

works.caption: Rossetti's Proserpine grips the fatal pomegranate in a shaft of light, her cascading hair and sea-green robe filling the canvas with brooding, claustrophobic sensuality.
works.title: Proserpine

works.caption: Holman Hunt's late tondo traps the doomed Lady mid-turn, her hair a storm around her as the fatal mirror's spell finally breaks, Pre-Raphaelite detail pushed to jewelled extremes.
works.title: The Lady of Shalott

works.caption: Velázquez layers a mundane tapestry workshop over a mythic scene glimpsed beyond, the spinning wheel's blurred spokes among the most audacious passages in Spanish painting.
works.title: Las Hilanderas

works.caption: Hals catches a lute-playing jester glancing sideways with an open, gap-toothed grin, loaded brushwork snapping the striped sleeve into motion.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Jester with lute

works.caption: A red-haired young man meets the viewer's eye while holding a devotional roundel of a saint, Botticelli's precise linear style at its most poised and intimate.
works.title: Young Man Holding a Roundel

works.caption: Friedrich silhouettes a crowd of moored fishing boats against a pastel dusk, masts and rigging etched delicately over a sliver of setting sun.
works.title: Boats in the Harbour at Evening
